text.body:
<1> 1.1 yajñaṃ vyākhyāsyāmaḥ| sa tribhirvedairvidhīyate | ṛgvedena yajurvedena sāmavedena sarvairjyotiṣṭomaḥ | ṛgvedayajurvedābhyāṃ darśapūrṇamāsau | yajurvedenāgnihotram | vidhilakṣaṇāni karmāṇi | mantrabrāhmaṇayorvedanāmadheyam | karmavidhānaṃ brāhmaṇāni | taccheṣo'rthavādaḥ | nindā praśaṃsā | parakṛtiḥ purākalpaśca | ato'nye mantrāḥ | laukikāḥ prayujyamānā amantrāḥ | yajñakarmārthā mantrāḥ | rūpavipratiṣedhāllaukikeṣu | yathā gṛhṇāmi te suprajāstvāya hastamimāṃ khanāmyoṣadhīṃ vaha vapāṃ jātavedaḥ pitṛbhya iti | yathopadiṣṭaṃ brāhmaṇavanto yathārūpamitare | śeṣasya vinidhānam | pāriplavārthā dāśatayyaḥ | uttarayoḥ pavamānayoḥ stomābhyāse sāmāni | tūṣṇīkeṣu prākṛteṣu yajuḥ | vedaḥ karmanāmadheyena śrūyamāṇastadarthaḥ | yathā vājapeyo yājyopuronuvākyāśca | upāṃśu yajurvedena kriyate | anyatra pravarasaṃvādāśrāvaṇasaṃpraiṣebhyaḥ | uccairitarābhyām | sarvairupāṃśu || 1 || jyotiṣṭome prāgagnīṣomīyāt | yāvadartho'pavṛjyate sa ekamantraḥ | ādipradiṣṭā mantrā bhavanti| uttarāsyā''dinā pūrvasyāntaṃ vidyāt 2. mantrāntena karma saṃnipātayet | kriyamāṇe hautrāṇyucyante | ekamantrāṇi karmāṇi | samabhyuccīyeranhautrāṇi | anyatra yājyānuvākyābhyaḥ | yatraikasmindravye viceṣṭāpṛthaktvenārtho niṣpadyate sakṛdeva tatra mantraṃ brūyāt | yathā prokṣe yūpacchedane ca | dravyapṛthaktve'bhyāvartate | yathā''jyagrahaṇe lavane staraṇe ca | arthapṛthaktvātkaṇḍūyanamantro'bhyāvartate | parārthānyekena kriyeran | yayā kapālenopavapati yajamānena samitaudumbarī bhavatīti | yajurvedenādhvaryuḥ karoti | ṛgvedena hotā | sāmavedenodgātā | sarvairbrahmā | vacanalakṣaṇā itare | asaṃbhavādvā | yayā'śvamedhe paśukarmasu | āhavanīya āhutayo juhvā hūyante | uttarataupacāro vihāraḥ || 2 || prāṅnyāyānyudaṅnyāyāni vā pradakṣiṇaṃ yo karmāṇi karoti | na yajñāṅgenā''tmānamanyaṃ vā'bhipariharati | na vihārādupaparyāvartate | antarāṇi yajñāṅgāni bāhyāḥ kartāraḥ | prācīnāvītī pitryāṇi karoti | yajñopavītī darśapūrṇamāsayoragnihotre ca | aniyamo'nyatra | codanāsaṃyogātpradhānānyekakālāni | teṣāṃ vibhavanti tantramaṅgānyavibhavantyāvartante | nānākāleṣu pṛthak | yaḥ pradhānasya kālaḥ so'ṅgānāṃ sa deśaḥ sa kartā so'gniḥ | .ādhānaprabhṛti yāvajjīvaṃ pātrāṇi dhāryante | teṣāṃ pratitantraṃ saṃskāro'bhyāvartate | sarvakāmau darśapūrṇamāsau | tau samānavidhānau| nirdeśādvyavatiṣṭhete | tābhyāṃ yāvajjīvaṃ yajate trim̐śataṃ vā varṣāṇi | ekasminprayoge sarvānkāmānkāmayeta prayogapṛthaktve vaikaikam| pūrvā paurṇamāsyuttarā'māvāsyā| paurṇamāsyāṃ paurṇamāsyā yajate'māvāsyāyāmamāvāsyayā | āgneyo'ṣṭākapāla upāṃśuyājaścāgnīṣomīyo vaiṣṇavaḥ prājāpatyo vā'gnīṣomīyaścaikādaśakapālaḥpaurṇamāsyāṃ pradhānāni | nāsomayājino brāhmaṇasyāgnīṣomīyaḥ puroḍāśo vidyata ityekeṣāmāgneyo'ṣṭākapāla aindrāgna ekādaśakapālo dvādaśakapālo vā'māvāsyāyāmasaṃnayata āgneyaḥ sāṃnāyyaṃ ca saṃnayataḥ | tadaṅgamitare homāḥ | pūrvāṃ paurṇamāsīmupavaset | saṃpūrṇāṃ vā | pūrvāmamāvāsyām | yadaharvā na dṛśyate || 3 || iti hiraṇyakeśisūtre prathamapraśne prathamaḥ paṭalaḥ || 1 || 1.2 prātaragnihotraṃ hutvā'nugamayitvā''gnihotrikamapoddhṛtya vodita ādityaṃ gārhapatyādāhavanīyamuddhṛtya mamāgne varca ityanvādadhātyuttarayā gārhapatyamuttarayā dakṣiṇāgnim | sarvābhirvā''havanīyam | avaśiṣṭā vikalpārthāḥ | vyāhṛtībhiranvādadhātītyekeṣām | iti vaitābhiḥ | palāśaśākhāṃ śamīśākhāṃ vā''harati | prācīmudīcīṃ prāgudīcīṃ vā'hīnāṃ bahuparṇāmaśuṣkāgrām | yaṃ kāyayetāpaśuḥ syādityaparṇāṃ tasmai śuṣkāgrām | yaṃ kāmayeta paśumānsyāditi bahuparṇāṃ tasmai bahuśākhāmaśuṣkāgrām | iṣe tveti śākhāmācchinatyūrje tveti saṃnamayatyanumārṣṭi vā | imāṃ prācīmudīcīmiṣamūrjamabhisaṃskṛtām | bahuparṇāmaśuṣkāgrāṃ harāmi paśupāmahamityāharati | vāyavaḥ stheti tayā ṣaḍvatsānapākaroti || 4 || darbhairvā sadarbhayetyekeṣām | apākṛtānāmeka śākhayopaspṛśati | devo ca iti gocaramabhi mātṝḥ prasthāpayati | indraṃ nigameṣūpalakṣayedindrayājino mahendraṃ mahendrayājinaḥ| | darbhairvā sadarbhayetyekeṣām | apākṛtānāmeka śākhayopaspṛśati | devo ca iti gocaramabhi mātṝḥ prasthāpayati | indraṃ nigameṣūpalakṣayedindrayājino mahendraṃ mahendrayājinaḥ| | dhruvā asminniti yajamānasya gṛhānabhi paryāvartate | yajamānasya paśūnpāhityagniṣṭhe'gnyagāre vā purastātpratīcīṃ śākhāmupagūhati paścātprācīmityekeṣām | devasya tvetyaśvaparśumasidaṃ vā''datte | yajñasya ghoṣadasīti gārhapatyamupatiṣṭhate | pratyuṣṭamityāhavanīye gārhapatye vā niṣṭapati | preyamagādurvantarikṣaṃ prehītyanyatareṇa prācīnamudīcīnaṃ vā'bhipravrajya yataḥ kutaściddarbhamayaṃ barhirāharati | viṣṇostūpo'sītyabhipretānāmekaṃ stambamutsṛjatīndrasya pariṣūtamasītyanyaṃ pariṣauti devānāmiti vā | taṃ sarvaṃ dāti | api vā paśūnāṃ tvā bhāgamutsṛjāmīti pariṣūtasyaikāṃ dve vā darbhanāḍyāvutsṛjati| idaṃ devānāmiti pariṣūtamabhimṛśatīdaṃ paśū- nāmityutsṛṣṭamavasṛṣṭo gavāṃ bhāga iti vā | devasya tvā savituḥ prasave'śvinorbāhubhyāṃ pūṣṇo hastābhyāṃ barhirdevasadanamārabha iti viśākheṣvabhipadyate | devebhyastvordhvabarhirbhya ityūrdhvamunmārṣṭi | devabarhirmā tvā'nvaṅmā tiryagityasidaṃ nidadhāti mādho mopari parusta ṛdhyāsamiti vā || 5 || yā jātā oṣadhayo devebhyastriyugaṃ purā | tāsāṃ parva rādhyāsaṃ paristaramāharannityabhimantrya | ācchettā te mā riṣamityācchinatti | sanakhaṃ muṣṭiṃ dāti | sa prastaraḥ | srugdaṇḍamātramurvasthikulmimātraṃ vā | etenaiva kalpenetarāndāti | yadanyatpariṣavaṇādutsarjanācca | sarvaṃ yathārthaṃ lutvā | devabarhiḥ śatavalśaṃ virohetyālavānabhimṛśati | sahasravalśā vi vayaṃ ruhemetyātmānamatyabhimṛśati | ayujo yujo vā muṣṭīnnidhanāni vā lunoti | adityai rāsnā'sīti pradakṣiṇaṃ śulbamāveṣṭayati | ayupitā yoniriti pratinidadhāti tridhātu pañcadhātu vā dhātau dhātau mantramāvartayati | pṛthivyāḥ saṃpṛcaḥ pāhīti prāgagramudagagraṃ vā śulbaṃ nidadhāti | aparimitānāṃ parimitāḥ saṃnahye sukṛttāyakam| eno mā nigāṃ katamaccanāhaṃ punarutthāya bahulā bhavantvityabhimantrya atha susaṃbhṛtā tvāsaṃbhāramīti śulbe nidhanāni saṃbharati | alubhito yonirityuttame nidhane prastaramādadhāti | indrāṇyai saṃnahanamiti saṃnahyati pūṣā ta iti pradakṣiṇaṃ granthimāveṣṭya | sa ta iti purastātpratyañcamupakarṣati paścādvā prāñcam | āpastvāmaśvinau tvāmṛṣayaḥ sapta māmṛjuḥ | barhiḥ sūryasya raśmibhiruṣasāṃ ketumārabha ityārabhate | indrasya tvā bāhubhyāmudyaccha ityudyacchate | bṛhaspateriti śīrṣamadhinidhāya harati | yau gamanau tau pratyāyanau | adityāḥ sada āsīdeti paridhideśe'ntarvedyanadhaḥ sādayati | devaṃgamamasītyāsannamabhimantrayate | pālāśaṃ khādiraṃ vaikaviṃśatidārumidhmaṃ saṃnahyati | paccadaśa sāmidhenyarthāni | trayaḥ paridhayo'niyatavṛkṣāḥ satvakvāḥ | ārdrā bhavanti te hi sarasā iti vijñāyate śuṣkā bhavanti medhyatvāyeti vijñāyate | sthaviṣṭho madhyamo'ṇīyāndrāghīyāndakṣiṇārdhyo'ṇiṣṭho hrasiṣṭha uttarārdhyaḥ | dve āghārasamidhau | anūyājasamidekaviṃśīti | samūlānāmamūlānāṃ vā darbhāṇāmayugdhātu śulvaṃ kṛtvā prāgagramudagagraṃ vā nidadhāti | yatkṛṣṇo rūpaṃ kṛtvā prāviśastvaṃ vanaspatīn | tatastvā mekaviṃśatidhā saṃbharāmi susaṃbhṛtā | trīnparidhīṃ- stisraḥ samidho yajñāyuranusaṃcarān | upaveṣaṃ mekṣaṇaṃ dhṛṣṭiṃ saṃbharāmi susaṃbhṛteti śulba idhmaṃ saṃbharati | kṛṣṇo'syākhareṣṭho deva puraścara saghyāsaṃ tveti saṃnahyati | pūṣā ta iti pradakṣiṇaṃ granthimāveṣṭya tenaiva kalpena yathā barhiṣi | vipratipādya vā | tenaiva mantreṇa | barhiṣā saha nidadhāti | vedo'si yena tvaṃ deva vedadevebhyo vedo'bhavastena mahyaṃ vedo bhūyā iti darbhāṇāṃ vedaṃ karoti | vatsajñuṃ mūtakāryaṃ paṅktikāryaṃ trivṛtaṃ vā | vatsajñuṃ paśukāmasya mūtakāryamannādyakāmasya paṅktikāryaṃ prajā- kāmasya trivṛtaṃ brahmavarcasakāmasya trivṛcchirasaṃ bruvate | tṛṇṇātprādeśe parivāsayati | idhmapravraścanāni vedaparivāsanāni ca saha nidadhāti || 7 || iti hiraṇyakeśisūtre prathamapraśne dvitīyaḥ paṭalaḥ || 2 || 1.3 atha tṛtīyaḥ paṭalaḥ | antarvedi śākhāyāḥ palāśāni praśātya sarvāṇi mūlataḥ parivāsya | upaveṣo'si yajñāya tvāṃ pariveṣamadhārayan | indrāya haviḥ kṛṇvantaḥ śivaḥ śagmo bhavāsi na iti tamupabeṣaṃ karoti | tasyāṃ trivṛddarbhamayaṃ pavitramavidalaṃ karoti | trivṛtpalāśe darbha iyānprādeśasaṃmitaḥ | yajñe pavitraṃ potṛtamaṃ payo havyaṃ karotu ma iti mūle mūlamupasṛjatyagre'graṃ na granthiṃ karoti | vasūnāṃ pavitramasi śatadhāramiti vā | sāyaṃ hute'gnihotre | dvaṃdvaṃ sāṃnāyyapātrāṇi prakṣālya nyañci prayunakti | agnihotrahavaṇīmukhāmupaveṣaṃ śākhāpavitramabhidhānīṃ nidāne dohanamayaspātraṃ dārupātraṃ vā pidhānārtham | samāvapracchinnāgrau darbhau prādeśamātrau pavitre karoti | pavitre stho vaiṣṇavī vāyurvāṃ manasā punātviti tṛṇaṃ kāṣṭhaṃ vā'ntardhāya chinatti | na nakhenemau prāṇāpānau yajñasyāṅgāni sarvaśaḥ | āpyāyayantau saṃcaratāṃ pavitre havyaśodhana ityabhimantrya | viṣṇormanasā pūte stha ityadbhirunmārṣṭi | agnihotrahavaṇyāṃ pavitrāntarhitāyāmapa ānīya | devo va iti paccho gāyatryodagagrābhyāṃ pavitrābhyāṃ trirutpunāti | āpo devīrityanumantryate || 8 || āpo devīḥ śuddhāḥ sthemā pātrāṇi śundhata | upā- taṅkyāya devānāṃ parṇavalkamuta śundhateti vā | śundhadhvamiti triḥ sarvābhiruttānāni pātrāṇi prokṣati śundhantāṃ viśvakarmāṇi devayajyāyai daivyāya karmaṇe śundhadhvaṃ yadvo'śuddhāḥ parājagmustadva etena śundhatāmiti vā | etā ācaranti madhumadduhānāḥ prajāvatīryaśaso viśvarūpāḥ | bahvīrbhavantīrupajāyamānā iha va indro ramayatu gāva iti gā āyatīḥ pratīkṣate | dhṛṣṭirasītyupaveṣamādāya | nirūḍhaṃ janyaṃ bhayaṃ saha tena yaṃ dviṣmaḥ subhūtāya śrayadhvamiti tena gārhapatyādudīco'ṅgārānnirūhya | mātariśvana iti teṣu kumbhīmadhiśrayati | aprasraṃsāya yajñasyokhe upadadhāmyaham | paśubhiḥ saṃnītaṃ bibhṛtāmindrāya śṛtaṃ dadhīti vā | bhṛgūṇāmaṅgirasāṃ tapasā tapyasvetyaṅgāraiḥ parīndhe | upasṛṣṭāṃ me prabrūtāditi saṃpreṣyati | vasūnāṃ pavitramasi sahasradhāramiti kumbhyāṃ prāgagraṃ śākhāpavitramādadhāti | anvārabhya vācaṃ yacchati dhārayannāste | adityai rāsnā'sītyabhidhānīmādatte || 9 || trayastriṃśo'si tantūnāṃ pavitreṇa sahā''gahi | śiveyaṃ rajjurabhidhānyaghniyāmupasevatāmiti vā | pūṣā'sīti vatsamupasṛjati | dhāvantaṃ vā'numantrayate | vihāraṃ gāṃ copasṛṣṭāmantareṇa mā saṃcāriṣṭeti saṃpreṣyati na duhyamānāmantareṇa yanti vihāraṃ gāṃ ca | yadi vyaveyātsāṃnāyyaṃ mā vilopīti brūyāt | ayakṣmā vaḥ prajayā saṃsṛjāmi rāyaspoṣeṇa bahulā bhavantīrityupasṛṣṭām | ūrjaṃ payaḥ pinvamānā ghṛtaṃ ca jīvo jīvantīrupa vaḥ sadeyamityupasannām| dyauścemaṃ yajñaṃ pṛthivī ca saṃduhānāṃ dhātā somena saha vā tena vāyuḥ | yajamānāya draviṇaṃ dadhātviti duhyamānāmutsaṃ duhanti kalaśaṃ caturbilamiḍāṃ devīṃ vadhumatīṃ suvarvidam | tadindrāgnī jinvataṃ sūnṛtāvattadyajamānamamṛtatve dadhātviti dhārāghoṣamanumantrayate | dogdhā harati | taṃ pṛcchati kāmadhukṣaḥ pra ṇo brūhīndrāya havirindriyam | amūṃ yasyāṃ devānāṃ manuṣyāṇāṃ payo hitamityasāviti godhugācaṣṭe | sā viśvāyuriti pratyucya | devastvā savitā punātu vasoḥ pavitreṇa śatadhāreṇa supuveti kumbhyāmānayati | yadanyatsaṃpraiṣāttenottare dohayati | sā viśvavyacā iti dvitīyāṃ sā viśvakarmeti tṛtīyām | tisro dohayitvā bahu dugdhīndrāya devebhyo havyamāpyāyatāṃ punarva tasebhyo manuṣyebhyaḥ punardohāya kalpatāmiti triḥ saṃpreṣyati | visṛṣṭavāgananvārabhya || 10 || uttarā dohayati tūṣṇīṃ vā | sarvāsu dugdhāsu hutaḥ stoka iti vipruṣo'numantrayate | dyauścemaṃ yajñamiti sāṃnāyyam | dohanaṃ saṃkṣālya saṃpṛcyadhvamiti kumbhyāmānayati | śrapayitvā tūṣṇīkena sarpiṣā'bhighārya | dṛṃha gā bṛṃha gopatiṃ mā vo yajñapatī riṣaditi prācīnamudīcīnaṃ prāgudagvā karṣannivodvāsayati | pūrvedyurdugdhaṃ dadhi ddavirātañcanamekasyā dvayostisṛṇāṃ vaikāhe dvyahe tryahe vā satatamabhidugdhamaupavasathādbhavati | somena tvā''tanacmīti tena śītaṃ budhnaṃ kṛtvā''- tanaktīndrasya svā bhāgaṃ somenā''tanacmīti vā | taṇḍulaiḥ parṇavalkaiḥ kvalairbadaraiḥ pūtīkairvā | yajñasya saṃtatirasi yajñasya tvā saṃtatimanusaṃtanomītyagnihotroccheṣaṇamānayati tūṣṇīṃ vā | āpo haviḥṣu jāgṛta yathā deveṣu jāgratha | evamasminyajñe yajamānāya jāgṛtetyapidhānārthe pātre'pa ānayatyadastamasi viṣṇave tvā yajñāyāpidadhāmyaham | adbhirariktena pātreṇa yāḥ pūtāḥ pariśerata ityapidadhāti | yadi mṛnmayaṃ syāttṛṇaṃ kāṣṭhaṃ vā'nupravidhyet | imau parṇaṃ ca darbhaṃ ca devānāṃ havyaśodhanau | prātardheyāya gopāya viṣṇo havyaṃ hi rakṣasītyunmucya śākhāpavitraṃ prajñātaṃ nidadhāti | viṣṇo havyaṃ rakṣasveti sānāyyaṃ gārhapatyadeśa upari nidadhāti || 11 || iti hiraṇyakeśisūtre prathamapraśne tṛtīyaḥ paṭalaḥ || 3 || iti satyāṣāḍha hiraṇyakeśisūtravyākhyāyāṃ prayogavaijayantyāṃ mahādevakṛtāyāṃ prathamapraśne tṛtīyaḥ paṭalaḥ || 3 || 1.4 atha caturthaḥ paṭalaḥ | anyāṃ śākhāmāhṛtya tenaiva kalpena tayā darbhairvā prātardohāya vatsānapākaroti yathā sāyaṃdohāya | upadhāya kapālāni prātardohaṃ dohayati tasya sāyaṃdohena kalpo vyākhyātaḥ | aprasraṃsāya yajñasyokhe upadadhāmyaham | paśubhiḥ saṃnītaṃ vibhṛtāmindrāya śṛtamiti mantrāntaṃ saṃnamati | udagagraṃ śākhāpavitramādadhāti | nā''tanakti | nāsomayājī saṃnayedato khalvāhuḥ kāpeyāḥ saṃneyamevāsomayājineti | aindraṃ sāṃnāyyaṃ someneṣṭvā mahendraṃ yajeta | api vā saṃvatsaraṃ dvau vendramiṣṭvā'gnaye vratapata- ye'ṣṭākapālaṃ nirupya kāmaṃ mahendraṃ yajeta | auvā gautamo bhāradvājaḥ śuśruvāngrāmaṇī rājanya iti sarvatra kāmaṃ mahendraṃ yajeran | paristṛṇīta paridhattāgniṃ parihito'gniryajamānaṃ bhunaktu | apāṃ rasa oṣadhīnāṃ suvarṇo niṣkā ime yajamānasya santu kāmadughā amutrāmuṣmim̐lloka iti saṃpreṣyati | darbhairagnīnparistṛṇāti | āhavanīyaṃ paristīrya gārhapatyamatha dakṣiṇāgniṃ gārha patyaṃ vā paristīrya dakṣiṇāgnimathā''havanīyam | udagagrāḥ paścātpurastācca bhavanti | etatkṛtvopavasatyamāvāsyāyām | paurṇamāsyāṃ tu | pūrvedyuragnyanvādhānamagniparistaraṇaṃ ca | śvo bhūta idhmābarhirvedaṃ ca karoti | sadyo vā | sarvaṃ kriyate. || 12 || sadyaskālāyāmupariṣṭādvedakarmaṇo'gnīnparistṛṇāti | saṃgrahaḥ -- śvaḥpadaṃ pṛthivyā saṃbhaveti vā | atra devayajanādhyavasānameke samāmananti | prāgvaṃśasya madhyamaṃ sthūṇārājamālabhyainaṃ mantraṃ japati | ekarātraṃ dīkṣito rājānaṃ krīṇāti dvayahe tryahe caturahe'parimite vā| prattaṃ padaṃ tote rāya iti patnyai prayacchati tava te rāya iti vā | krīyamāṇasya rājño dakṣiṇata āste| krīte some maitrāvaruṇāya daṇḍaṃ prayacchati | śvaḥ sutyāyāṃ vā kriyamāṇāyām | vayaḥ suparṇā iti pratyaporṇute śiro'gre'nupūrvamitarāṇyaṅgāni | mitro na ehi sumitradhā ityūrāvāsannaṃ rājānamupasvaja upaiva gṛhṇīte | udāyuṣetyuttiṣṭhati | urvantarikṣamiti gacchati| śakaṭaṃ prāpyādhvaryave rājānaṃ pradadāti| namo mitrasya varuṇasya cakṣasa iti prāgvaṃśamohyamānaṃ pratīkṣate | anu me dīkṣāṃ dīkṣāpatirmanyatāmiti tānūnapraṃ samavamṛśati | tattriṣu vrateṣu pratipanno bhakṣayati yadadhvaryurnāvajighrati | agne vratapata ityavāntaradīkṣāmupaiti | saṃtarāṃ mekhalāṃ samāyacchate saṃtarāṃ muṣṭī kurute taptavrato bhavati madantībhirudakārthānkurute||10|| . vyākhyātaṃ pāṇiprakṣālanamāpyāyanaṃ nihnavanaṃ ca| yā te agne rudriyā tanūriti vratayati | daikṣametadaharvrataparimāṇaṃ bhavati | aupasado'ta ūrdhvaṃ vratakalpaḥ| catuḥstanametāṃ rātriṃ vrataṃ vratayati tristanaṃ madhyame'hani dvistanaṃrātrāvekastanamuttame'hani | ārāgrāmavāntaradīkṣāmupeyāditi brāhmaṇavyākhyātāni kāmyāni vrataparimāṇāni teṣāṃ yāthākāmī | pratadviṣṇuḥ stavate vīryāyeti saṃmitāddhavirdhānātprāgupaniṣkramya taireva mantrairyathānyuptaṃ dhiṣṇiyānupatiṣṭhate | samrāḍasi kṛśānurityāhavanīyaṃ pariṣadyosi pavamāna iti yatra bahiṣpavamānena stuvate pratakvā'si nabhasvāniti cātvālamasaṃmṛṣṭo'si havyasūda iti paśuśrapaṇamṛtadhāmāsi suvarjyotirityaudumbarīṃ brahmajyotirasi suvardhāmeti brahmasadanamajo'syekapāditi prājihitaṃ gārhapatyamahirasi budhniya iti śālāmukhīyaṃ kavyo'si kavyavāhana iti dakṣiṇāgniṃ samūhyo'si viśvavyacā ityutkaraṃ samudro'si viśvabharā iti sadaḥ sadasyo'si malimluca iti sadasyāyatanaṃ raudramanīkaṃ sarvatrānuṣajati || 11 || iti hiraṇyakeśisūtre daśamapraśne tṛtīyaḥ paṭalaḥ| 10.4 atha daśamapraśne caturthaḥ paṭalaḥ | yatra havirdhāne brahmā rājānaṃ prapādayati tasmikāle pūrveṇa dvāreṇa havirdhāne praviśyaiṣa vo deva savitaḥ soma iti śakaṭe rājānamāsannamabhimantrayate | idamahaṃ manuṣyo manuṣyāniti pradakṣiṇamāvartate | namo devebhya iti prācīnamañjaliṃ karoti svadhā pitṛbhya iti dakṣiṇā | idamahaṃ nirvaruṇasya pāśādityupaniṣkrāmati | suvarabhivikhyeṣamiti sarvaṃ yajñamanuvīkṣate vaiśvānaraṃ jyotirityāhavanīyaṃ parekṣate | agne vratapata ityavāntaradīkṣāṃ visṛjate | vitarāṃ mekhalāṃ samāyacchate vitarāṃ muṣṭī kurute | svāhā yajñaṃ vāci vāte visṛja iti muṣṭī vācaṃ ca visarjayitvā yathāsukhamata ūrdhvaṃ hastābhyāṃ carati| vartate'nyā dīkṣitavṛtiḥ | jāgartyetāṃ rātrim | na vrataṃ bhavati daikṣo'ta ūrdhvaṃ vratakalpaḥ | saptahotrā grāvasvāsannaṃ rājānamabhimṛśati | yatra havirdhānamapaḥ prapādayīta tā anu prapadyate yaśa enamupanāmukaṃ bhavati | dvādaśa dhenūḥ paṣṭhauhīrvā garbhiṇīḥ kṛttyadhīvāsaṃ cāṃśāvadhvaryave dadātyevamadābhye | dhruve gṛhīte na mūtraṃ karotyāvanayanāt | vasvyai hiṃ kuru tasyai prastuhi tasyai me'varuddhyā iti purastādbahiṣpavamānādvyāhṛtīrdaśahotāraṃ ca japati | śyeno'si gāyatrachandā anu tvā''rabhe svastimā saṃpārayeti || 12 || stūyamānamanvārabhate | madhyamāyāṃ stotrīyāyāṃ vā| stutasya stutamasīti sarvāṇi stotrāṇi stutaṃ stutamanumantrayate| śastrasya śastramasīti sarvāṇi śastrāṇi | indriyāvanto vanāmaha iti sarvatrānuṣajati | bhūrasi śreṣṭho raśmīnāmityaindravāyave hūyamāna ādityamupatiṣṭhate | | yo na indravāyū ityaindravāyave hute'ṅguṣṭhamavabādheta | yadi śreyasā spardhetāṅguṣṭhenāṅgulīṃ yadi pāpīyasā | yo no mitrāvaruṇāviti maitrāvaruṇe yo no'śvināvityāśvine | acchinnasya te rayipate suvīryasyendreṇa sayujo vayamiti śukraṃ hūyamānamanvārabhate | yatrāsmai camasamāharati taṃ bhakṣayati | yathetare camasāḥ| gṛhapate yajetyucyamāne hotaretadyajeti saṃpreṣyati svayaṃ vā niṣadya yajati | jyotiṣe hiṃ kuru tasyai. prastuhi tasyai me'varudyād iti purastādājyānāmekaikasya stotrasya vyāhṛtīścaturhotāraṃ pañcahotāraṃ ca japati | iḍāyai hiṃ kuru tasyai prastuhi tasyai me'varuddhyā iti purastānmādhyaṃdinātpavamānādvyāhṛtīścaturhotāraṃ pañcahotāraṃ ca japati| suparṇo'si triṣṭupcchandā anu svā rabhe svasti mā saṃpārayeti stūyamānamanvārabhate || 13 || vyākhyātaṃ śukrasyānvārambhaṇam | sanneṣu nārāśaṃseṣu dakṣiṇena vedimavasthitā dakṣiṇā dadāti | gavāṃ saptakaviṃśatiścaturviṃśatiḥ ṣaṣṭiḥ śataṃ sahasraṃ dvādaśaśataṃ sarvavedasamaparimitā vā | manthaudanatilamāṣā hiraṇyaṃ vāso'virajā ca niyuktānyetāni bhavanti | ano ratho'dhīvāso'śvaḥ puruṣo hastī vā'niyuktāni | tā rūpeṇa vo rūpamabhyaimīti hiraṇyamājyaṃ cā''dāyābhyeti| tutho vo viśvavedā vibhajatviti madhyamavakramya vibhajati | dvādaśa dvādaśa madhyataḥkāribhyaḥ ṣaṭ ṣaḍarṣibhyaścatasraścatasrastṛtīyibhyastisrastisraḥ pādibhyaḥ| evaṃ śeṣam | hotā'dhvaryubrahmodgātā ca madhyataḥkāriṇaḥ | maitrāvaruṇaḥ pratiprasthātā brāhmaṇācchaṃsī prastotā cārdhino'cchāvāko neṣṭā''gnīdhraḥ pratihartā ca tṛtīyinaḥ śeṣāḥ pādinaḥ | etatte agne rādha aiti somacyutamiti vibhaktā ānayati | agreṇa prāgvaṃśamapareṇa sado dakṣiṇenāgnīdhrīyamantareṇa cātvālotkarāvudīcīrutsṛjati | ṛtasya pathā preta candradakṣiṇā iti gacchantīranumantrayate|| brāhmaṇamadya rādhyāsamṛṣimārṣeyamiti hiraṇyaṃ dakṣiṇābhāgaṃ cā''dāyā''gnīdhramabhyeti | etenaiva mantreṇa hiraṇyaṃ dakṣiṇābhāgaṃ cā''gnīdhre dadāti | vi suvaḥ paśya vyantarikṣamiti sadaḥ prekṣate | asmaddātrā devatrā gacchateti dakṣiṇāḥ | pūrveṇa dvāreṇa sadaḥ praviśya || 14|| ātreyāya hiraṇyamuttamaṃ dadāti tenaiva mantreṇa yenā''gnīdhre | tasminnavidyamāne ya ārṣeyo'nūcāno'nūcānaputrastasmai tāṃ dakṣiṇāṃ dadyāt | athartvigbhyo dakṣiṇābhāgānbrahmanmanaste dadāmi tadanena niṣkrīṇāmīti brahmaṇe brahmasadana āsīnāyedaṃ dadāmīti yaddāsyanbhavati tadanudiśati brahmaṇe | evamitarebhyaḥ | hotarvācaṃ te dadāmi tāmanena niṣkrīṇāmīti hotre hotṛṣadana āsīnāya | adhvaryo prāṇaṃ se dadāmi tamanena niṣkrīṇāmītyadhvaryave havirdhāna āsīnāya || udgātaścakṣuste dadāmi tadanena niṣkrīṇāmītyudgātra audumbaryāmāsīnāya | hotrakāḥ śrotraṃ vo dadāmi tadanena niṣkrīṇāmīti hotrakebhyo'ntaḥsadasaṃ yathādhiṣṇiyamāsīnebhyaḥ| pratiprasthātre ca havirdhāna āsīnāya | yathāśraddhaṃ sadasyāya camasādhvaryubhyaḥ prasarpakebhyaśca dadāti | sadasyā''tmānaṃ te dadāmi tamanena niṣkrīṇāmīti sadasyāyāntaḥsadasaṃ dakṣiṇā āsīnāya | camasādhvaryavo'ṅgāni vo dadāmi tānyanena niṣkrīṇāmīti camasādhvaryubhyo havirdhāna āsīnebhyaḥ | prasarpakā lomāni vo dadāmi tānyamena niṣkrīṇā... mīti prasarpakebhyo'ntaḥsadasaṃ dakṣiṇārdha āsīnebhyaḥ | idaṃ dadāmīti sarvatrānuṣajati | na bhīto dadāti | na yācamānāya | na kaṇvakāśyapebhyaḥ | na vīṇāgāthibhyaḥ| nānṛtvije| na jñātaye | nāprasṛptāya| nāśrotriyāya | nābrāhmaṇāya | vedavide dadyāt | yāmanyo dīyamānāṃ pratyācakṣīta yaṃ dviṣyāttasmai tāṃ dakṣiṇāṃ dadyāt | sa hānyayā pratigṛhṇīyāt | antataḥ pratihartre dadātyātreyāya vā| na marutvatīyayoranūktā dadyāt | yadi dadyādanūbandhyāvapāyāṃ hutāyāṃ dadyādudavasānīyāyāṃ veṣṭau || 15 || iti hiraṇyakeśisūtre daśamapraśne caturthaḥ paṭalaḥ | 10.5 atha daśamapraśne pañcamaḥ paṭalaḥ || nītāsu dakṣiṇāsu hariṇasya raghuṣyato'dhiśīrṣāṇi bheṣajaṃ sakṣetriyaṃ viṣāṇayā viṣūcīnamanīnaśadityunmucya kṛṣṇaviṣāṇāmanu tvā hariṇo mṛgaḥ padbhiścaturbhirakramīnmā'hirbhūnnā pṛdākuriti cātvāle prāsyati | rathaṃtare varaṃ dadāti| vāmadevye varaṃ dadāti | niṣkevalye varaṃ dadāti | ādityagrahaṃ hūyamānamanvārabhate | āyuṣe hiṃ kuru tasyai prastuhi tasyai me'varuddhyā iti purastādārbhavātpavamānādvyāhṛtīḥ pañcahotāraṃ ca japati | saghā'si jagatīchandā anu tvā''rabhe svasti mā saṃpārayeti stūyamānamanvārabhate | yatra svaṃ camasaṃ nyante trīnpuroḍāśaśakalāndakṣiṇata upāsyati | tatkṛtvā prācīnāvītaṃ kṛtvā ṣaḍḍhotāraṃ vyākhyāya dānaprabhṛtīnpratyāyanāntānpiṇḍapitṛyajñamantrāñjapati | yajñāyajñiye varaṃ dadāti | purastādagniṣṭomastotrādvyāhṛtīḥ saptahotāraṃ ca japati | subhūrasi śreṣṭho raśmīnāṃ priyo devānāṃ saṃsādhanīyaḥ| taṃ svā(tvā) subho devā abhisaṃviśantviṣo'si tveṣo'si nṛmṇo'si yahvo'si vrato'si svo'si cāraṇo'si śūdro'syāryo'si tasya ta iṣasya tveṣasya nṛmṇasya yahvasya vratasya svasya cāraṇasya śūdrasya cā''ryasya ca bhukṣiṣīya yathā tvaṃ sūryo'si viśvadarśata evamahaṃ viśvadarśato bhūyāsamityagniṣṭomaṃ niṣpādyā''dityamupatiṣṭhate yadyastamitaḥ syādāhavanīyamevā''dityopasthānenopatiṣṭhate || 16 || dadhidrapsaḥ | apsuṣomaḥ| mindayopasthānam | śakalābhyādhānam | sakhyavisarjanaṃ ca | huteṣu samiṣṭayajuḥṣu agninā devena pṛtanā jayāmīti jāgatānviṣṇukramānkrāmati | upasṛjandharuṇaṃ mātre mātaraṃ dharuṇo dhayan | rāyaspoṣamiṣamūrjamasmāsu dīdharadityupaniṣkrāmannaudumbarīmutkhidati | ava te heḍo varuṇetyunmucya kṛṣṇājinaṃ cātvāle prāsyati | udu tyaṃ citramiti dvābhyāmādityamupatiṣṭhate yadyastamitaḥ syādāhavanīyamevā''dityopasthānenopatiṣṭhate | vyākhyātaṃ nidhanopāyanam | sumitriyā ca mārjanam | indriyāya jyeṣṭhyācchraiṣṭhyānmā yoṣamityunmucya kṛṣṇājinamabhyukṣya nidadhāti yadi purastādaprāstaṃ bhavati | sumitrā na ityabhipragāhyānupamajjantau sahaśiraskau snāto'nyonyasya pṛṣṭhaṃ prakṣālayataḥ pratīpamāplavamānau gāhete | vi te muñcāmi raśanā iti mekhalāṃ yajamāno visraṃsayate | imaṃ viṣyāmīti yoktrapāśaṃ patnī| mekhalāṃ yoktraṃ jālaṃ dīkṣitavasane ca praplāvya somopanahanaṃ yajamānaḥ paridhatte somapariśrayaṇaṃ patnī | tāvahatavāsasāvuditaḥ || te udayanīyāyāmadhvaryave dattaḥ || 17 || vyākhyātamunnayanam | samidabhyādhānam | upasthānaṃ ca | apareṇa śālāmukhīyamupaviśya juhvāṃ pañcagṛhītaṃ gṛhītvā kṛṣṇājinamupastha ādhāya mayīndra indriyaṃ jyaiṣṭhyaṃ śraiṣṭhyaṃ dadhātviti juhoti | kṛṣṇājinaṃ pra vā''payate | srugavadhānaṃ vā kurute | haviṣo vā'tha peṣaṇam | punardīkṣāyā evainannidhatte | putrāya vainadbrahmacāriṇe vā dadyāt | yadi purastādaprāstaṃ bhavati | udayanīyāyāṃ vratamupaiti | anūbandhyāvapāyāṃ hutāyāṃ dakṣiṇasyāṃ vediśroṇyāṃ pariśrite yajamānasya keśaśmaśrūṇi vāpayate'tra dadāti yaddāsyanbhavati | vyākhyātaḥ svarurhṛdayaśūlo yūpopasthānaṃ ca | mithunau gāvau maitrāvaruṇyāmāmikṣāyāṃ dadāti | saktuhome hūyamāne'yaṃ no nabhasā pura ityagnimupatiṣṭhate | sa tvaṃ no nabhasaspata iti vāyuṃ devasaṃsphānetyādityam | anaḍvāhamanaḍuho vā hiraṇyamudavasānīyāyāṃ dadāti | yathāśakti pūrṇāhutau | apavṛtte ṣoḍaśinaḥ stotre tamevāśvamaśvatarīṃ vā dakṣiṇāṃ dadāti ||18|| iti hiraṇyakeśisūtre daśamapraśne pañcamaḥ paṭalaḥ | 10.6 atha daśamapraśne ṣaṣṭhaḥ paṭalaḥ | dakṣiṇāṃ pratigrahīṣyanpratigṛhya vā saptadaśakṛtvo'pāniti | barhiṣā pratīyādgāṃ vā'śvaṃ vā | annena puruṣam | gandhena ca priyodyena ca talpam | barhiḥ pratyuttiṣṭhati barhirvai dakṣiṇāyāḥ priyaṃ dhāma priyo dakṣiṇāyā bhavatyenaṃ dakṣiṇā''gacchati | devā vai varuṇamayājayansa yasya yasyai devatāyai dakṣiṇāmanayattāmavlīnātte'bruvanvyāvṛtya pratigṛhṇāma tathā no dakṣiṇā na vleṣyatīti te vyāvṛtya pratyagṛhṇantato vai tāndakṣiṇā nāvlīnādya evaṃ vidvānvyāvṛtya dakṣiṇāṃ pratigṛhṇāti nainaṃ dakṣiṇā vlīnātīti| vyāvṛtya pratigrahaṇam | tāntrīṇāṃ dakṣiṇānāṃ darśayati || 19 || devasya tyā savituḥ prasave'śvinorbāhubhyāṃ pūṣṇo hastābhyāṃ pratigṛhṇāmi rājā tvā varuṇo nayatu devi dakṣiṇe'gnaye hiraṇyaṃ tenāmṛtatvamaśyāṃ vayo dātre bhūyānmayo mahyamastu pratigrahītre ka idaṃ kasmā adātkāmaḥ kāmāya kāmo dātā kāma: pratigrahītā • kāmaṃ samudramāviśa kāmena tvā pratigṛhṇāmi kāmaitatta eṣā te kāma dakṣiṇottānastvā''ṅgīrasaḥ pratigṛhṇātu somāya vāso gnāstvā'kṛntannapaso'tanvata varūtra yo'vayannavadhiyo apṛñcata rudrāya gāṃ varuṇāyāśvaṃ prajāpataye puruṣaṃ manave talpaṃ tvaṣṭre'jāṃ pūṣṇe'viṃ nirṛtyā aśvataragardabhau himavato hastinaṃ gandharvāpsarābhyaḥ sragalaṃkaraṇe viśvebhyo devebhyo dhānyaṃ vāce'nnaṃ brahmaṇa odanaṃ samudrāyāpa uttānāyā''ṅgīrasāyāno vaiśvānarāya rathaṃ vaiśvānaraḥ pratnathā nākamāruhaddivaḥ pṛṣṭhaṃ bhandamānaḥ sumanmabhiḥ sa pūrvavajjanayajjantave dhanaṃ samānamajmā pariyāti jāgṛviriti vaiśvānaryarcā rathaṃ pratigṛhṇāti | sarveṣāṃ sāvitramekaikasyā''dito dadhāti tenāmṛtatvamaśyāmityanuṣaṅgamantataḥ || 20|| iti hiraṇyakeśisūtre daśamapraśne ṣaṣṭhaḥ paṭalaḥ | 10.7 saṃvatsaraṃ caturṇāmeko nāśnīyāditi caturhotṛṇāmupayogavrataṃ bhavati | yaḥ kāmayeta bahu syāṃ prajāyeteti so'raṇyaṃ paretya darbhastambe daśahotāramūnayā pūrṇayā vā srucā juhuyāt | yaḥ prajayā paśubhirnaiva prabhavedvarāsiṃ paridhāya taptaṃ pibandvādaśa rātrīradhaḥ śayīta dvādaśyāṃ prātaḥ prāṅudetya prāṇyāpānyāprāṇandaśahotāraṃ vyākhyāyendraṃ gaccha svāhetyapānyāt | devānāṃ patnībhiḥ putrakāmo yajeta saṃvatsaram | caturbhiryajurbhirantarā tvaṣṭāraṃ devānāṃ ca patnībhiḥ putrakāmeṇa hotavyaṃ saṃvatsaraṃ cenna jāyeta tadanādṛtya caturhotrā yājayet | rājānamaparuddhaṃ saṅgrāme saṃyatte khile'cchadirdarśe caturgrahītenā''jyena caturhotrā pūrvāmāhutiṃ juhoti graheṇottarāmapi vā caturhotāraṃ manasā'nudrutya pūrveṇa graheṇārdhaṃ juhotyardhamuttareṇa yattatra vinderaṃstato dakṣiṇā syācchatameke samāmananti | caturhotrā yājayetprajākāmam | tasya sa eva homakalpaḥ| varo dakṣiṇā| pañcahotrā yājayetpaśukāmam | caturgrahītenā''jyena pañcahotrā pūrvāmāhurti juhoti graheṇottarāmapi vā svayaṃ kṛṇvānaḥ sugama [pra]yāvaṃ tigmaśṛṅgo vṛṣabhaḥ śośucānaḥ | pratnaṃ sadhasthamanu paśyamānā ā tantumagnirdivyaṃ tatāna || tvaṃ na tanturuta seturagne tvaṃ panthā bhavasi devayānaḥ | tvayā'gne vaudumbarīṃ srucaṃ pūrayitvā naktoṣāsā, agne sahasrākṣeti saṃhitābhyāṃ svayamātṛṇṇāyāmekāhutiṃ juhoti ||8| ūrṇāvantaṃ prathamaḥ sīda yonimityucyamāne suparṇo'si garutmānpṛthivyāṃ sīdati tisṛbhiḥ svayamātṛṇṇāyāmagniṃ pratiṣṭhāpayati dvābhyāṃ vā || 9 || preddho agne dīdihi puro na ityaudumbarīṃ samidhamādadhāti | vidhema te parame janmannagna iti vaikaṅkatīṃ saviturvareṇyasya citrāmiti śamīmayīm | śamīmayīṃ pūrvāmeke samāmananti | vaikaṅkatīmuttarām || (kha011) || 12.5.10 || agne tamadyāśvāmityakṣarapaṅktyā juhoti || 11 || juhūṃ sruvaṃ ca saṃmṛjya caturgrahītenāṣṭagṛhītena dvādaśagṛhītena vā srucaṃ pūrayitvā sapta ta iti pūrṇāhutiṃ juhoti || 12 || tāṃ juhvadiha so'stviti digbhyo'gniṃ manasā dhyāyati || 13 || vaiśvānarīyasya tantraṃ prakramayati | tatra yāvat kriyate tadvyākhyāsyāmaḥ || 14 || vedaṃ kṛtvā'gnīnparistīrya pāṇī prakṣālyolaparājīṃ stīrtvā yathārthaṃ pātrāṇi prayunakti || 15|| na praṇītāḥ praṇayati || 16|| nirvapaṇakāle vaiśvānaraṃ dvādaśakapālaṃ nirupya sapta mārutāntsaptakapālānnirvapati || 17|| tūṣṇīmupacaritā mārutā bhavanti || 18 || yajurutpūtābhiḥ saṃyauti | abhivāsita āpyalepaṃ ninīya | saṃpreṣeṇa pratipadyate || 19|| yadanyadidhmābarhiṣaḥ patnīsaṃnahanācca tatsaṃpreṣyati ||12.5.20|| yatprāgājyagrahaṇāttatkṛtvā dhruvāyāmeva gṛhṇāti ||21|| prokṣaṇīrabhimantrya brahmāṇamāmantrya vediṃ prokṣya prokṣaṇyavaśeṣaṃ ninīya pavitre apisṛjya dhruvāṃ sruvaṃ ca sādayati || 22 || eṣā'sadaditi mantraṃ saṃnamati || 23 || viṣṇvasi vaiṣṇavaṃ dhāma prājāpatyamityājyamabhimantrayate | (kha012)|24 vaiśvānaramāsādya mārutānāsādayati || 25|| uccairvaiśvānarasyā''śrāvayati || 26 || sarvahutamaparyāvartayañjuhoti || 27|| īdṛṅcānyādṛṅcetyāsīno hastenopāṃśu mārutānsarvahutāngaṇena juhoti || 28 || pūrvaṃ pūrvaṃ gaṇamanudrutyottareṇottareṇa juhoti || 29 || svatavāṃśca praghāsī ca sāṃtapanaśca gṛhamedhī ca krīḍī ca sākī corjiṣī cetyuttamaṃ gaṇamanudrutya prathamena juhoti || 12.5.30 || indraṃ daivīrviśo maruto'nuvartamāna iti hutvopatiṣṭhate || 31|| yadi kāmayata viśā kṣattraṃ hanyāmiti grāmye'nuvākyasya gaṇasya trīṇi catvāri vā padānyanū(pādānanū )cyāraṇye'nuvākyasya śeṣeṇa juhoti || 32|| evaṃ tribhirādito yathāsamāmnātaṃ grāme'nuvākyasya yathā pūrvairevaṃ tribhiruttarairgaṇaiḥ ||33|| yadi kāmayeta kṣattreṇa viśaṃ hanyāmityāraṇye'nuvākyasya ṣaṭsu padāntarāleṣu ṣaḍgaṇānopya grāmeṣu vākyaṃ japitvā''raṇyena vākyaśeṣaṃ juhoti || 34|| evaṃ tribhirādito yathāsamāmnātaṃ grāme'nuvākyena yathā pūrvairevaṃ tribhiruttarairgaṇaiḥ || 35 || na saṃpreṣyati | na saṃmārṣṭi | nānūyājānyajati || 36 || yaṃ kāmayeta kṣatriyaṃ pra svādāyatanāccyaveteti tasyāraṇye'nuvākya(ka)sya gaṇasyāgniṣṭhaṃ rathavāhanaṃ vā vyaṅgayedityayajñasaṃyuktaḥ kalpaḥ || (kha013) ||37|| iti satyāṣāḍhahiraṇyakaśisūtre dvādaśapraśne pañcamaḥ paṭalaḥ || 5|| 12.6 atha dvādaśapraśne ṣaṣṭhaḥ paṭalaḥ || vasordhārāṃ juhoti | ājyenaudumbaryā srucā'gnāviṣṇū sajoṣasetyanudrutya vājaśca me prasavaśca me iti saṃtatāmā mantrasamāpanāt ||1|| yaṃ kāmayeta prāṇānasyānnādyaṃ vicchindyāmiti vigrāhaṃ tasya juhuyāt | yaṃ kāmayeta prāṇānasyā nādyaṃ saṃtanuyāmiti saṃtatāṃ tasya juhuyāt ||2|| yadājyamucchiṣyeta tasminbrahmaudanaṃ paktvā caturo'dhvaryūnbhojayettebhyaścatasro dhenūrdakṣiṇā dadyāt ||3|| catuḥśarāvamodanaṃ paktvā tadvyañjanaṃ bhojayati || 4 || vājaprasavīyaṃ juhoti | sapta grāmyā oṣadhayaḥ saptā''raṇyāḥ | pṛthagannāni dravīkṛtya vājasyemaṃ prasavaḥ supava iti caturdaśabhirṛgbhiraudumbareṇa sruveṇaikaikayarcā'nnamannaṃ juhoti || 5 || pituṃ nu stoṣaṃ mahodharmāṇaṃ taviṣīm | yasya trito vyojasā vṛtraṃ viparvamardayat || svādo pito madho pito vayaṃ tvā vavṛmahe | asmākamavitā bhava | upa naḥ pitavācara śivaḥ śivābhirūtibhiḥ || mayobhuradviṣeṇyaḥ sakhā suśevo advayāḥ | tava tye pito rasā rajāṃsyanuviṣṭhitāḥ || divi vātā iva śritāḥ | tava tye pito dadatastava svādiṣva(ṣṭha)te pito || prasvātyā (dyā)no rathā(sā)nāṃ tuvigrīvā iverate | tve pito mahānāṃ devānāṃ mano hitam || akāri cāru ketunā tavāhimavasā'vadhīt | yadado pito ajaganvivasva parvatānām || atrā cinno madho pito'raṃ bhakṣāya gamyāḥ | yadapāmoṣadhīnāṃ pariṃśamā riśāmahe || vātāpe pīva idbhava | yatte soma gavāśiro yavāśiro bhajāmahe || vātāpe pīva idbhava | karambha oṣadhe bhava pīvo vṛkka udārathiḥ vātāpe pīva idbhava | taṃ tvā vayaṃ pito vacobhirgāvo na havyā suṣūdima || devebhyastvā sadhamādamasmabhyaṃ tvā sadhamādamiti hutvā hutvā pātryāṃ saṃpātamavanayet || (kha014 )|| 6|| apivā yasyānnasyāgre juhuyāttasyedhmaṃ kuryāt || 7 || yajamānāyatana audumbaryāmāsīnamāgnimanvārabdhaṃ kṛṣṇājine prasave'śvinorbāhubhyāṃ pūṣṇo hastābhyāṃ bṛhaspatiṃ sāmrājyenābhiṣiñcāmīti brāhmaṇam || 11 || indraṃ sāmrājyenābhiṣiñcāmīti rājanyam | agniṃ sāmrājyenābhiṣiñcāmīti vaiśyam ||12|| purastātpratyaṅtiṣṭhanpaścātprāṅmukhamāsīnaṃ śīrṣato'bhiṣicyā''mukhādanvavasrāvayati || 13 || kṛṣṇāyai śvetavatsāyai payasā dadhnā vaudumbarīṃ srucaṃ pūrayitvā naktoṣāsetyāhutiṃ juhoti||14|| ṛtāṣāḍṛtadhāmeti ṣaḍbhiḥ paryāyairvāsedaśagṛhītena dvādaśa rāṣṭrabhṛto juhoti ||15|| paryāyamanudrutya tasmai svāheti pūrvāmāhutiṃ juhoti||16|| tābhyaḥ svāhetyuttarām || bhuvanasya pata iti rathamukhe pañcā''hutīrjuhoti ||(kha015) || daśa vā paryāyai rathyasyā''havanīye dhāryamāṇaṃ rathaśiro'bhi juhoti | rathaśirasā juhotītyekeṣām || 17|| samudgahītaṃ rathamadhvaryorāvasathaṃ haranti | anunayanti trīnaśvāṃścatura ityekeṣām ||18|| tānsarathānadhvaryave dadāti || 19|| samudro'si nabhasvānityañjalinā trīnvātanāmāni juhoti || 12.6.20 || kṛṣṇājinapuṭena vā || 21 || agna udadhe yāta iṣuryuvā nāmeti pañcabhiḥ paryāyaiḥ pradakṣiṇamanuparikrāmanpratidiśaṃ pañcā''jyāhutīrjuhoti | madhya uttamena prāṅmukhaḥ | samīcī nāmāsi prācī digiti ṣaḍbhiḥ paryāyairdadhnā madhumiśreṇa ṣaṇmahāhutīrjuhoti | yathā sarpāhutīryāste agne sūrye ruca iti tisro ruco juhoti || 22 || suvarṇagharmasvāheti pañcārkāhutīrhutvā || 23 || vedistaraṇaprabhṛtīni karmāṇi pratipadyate || 24 || mamāgna ityetenānuvākena pratimantramiṣṭakābhirdhiṣṇiyāṃścinoti | ekaikena mantreṇaikaikaṃ dhiṣṇiyamu(ma ) pavarjayati | aṣṭāvāgnīdhrīya upadadhātyaśmā navama ityekeṣām || 25 || dvādaśa caturviṃśatiṃ vā hotrīya ekādaśaikaviṃśatiṃ vā praśāstrīye ṣaṇmārjālīye'ṣṭāvitareṣu (khaṃ016)|| tava śriye vyajihīta parvato gavāṃ gotramudasṛjo yadaṅgiraḥ| . indreṇa yujā tamasā parīvṛtaṃ bṛhaspate nirapāmaubjo arṇavam | bṛhaspate atiyadaryo arhāt | evā pitra iti tisṛbhirbrāhmībhirbrahmasadane yamo dādhāra pṛthivīṃ yamo viśvamidaṃ jagat | yamāya sarvamittasthe yatprāṇādvāyurakṣitam | yathā pañca yathā ṣaḍyathā pañcadaśarṣayaḥ || yamaṃ yo vidyātsa brūyādyathaika ṛṣirvijānate || trikadrukebhiḥ patati ṣaḍurvīrekamidbṛhat | gāyatrī triṣṭup chandāṃsi sarvā tā yama āhiteti tisṛbhiryāmībhirmārjālīye tveṣaṃ vayaṃ rudraṃ yajñasādhavaṃ kukavimavase nihvayāmahe | āre asmaddaivyaṃ heḍo asya tu sumatimidvayamasyā vṛṇīmahe || aśyāma te sumatiṃ devayajyayā kṣayadvīrasya tava rudra mīḍhvaḥ | sumnāyannidviśo asmākamā ca rāriṣṭa vīrā juhavāma te haviḥ|| mṛḍā no rudrota no mayaskṛdhīti tisṛbhī raudrībhiścātvāle havyaṃ prīṇīhi havyaṃ śrīṇīhi havyaṃ paca havyaṃ śrapaya havyamasi havyāya tvā havyebhyastvā havye ṣaṣṭhaḥ paṭalaḥ || 6 || 12.7 atha dvādaśapraśne saptamaḥ paṭalaḥ | paśukāla ekayūpa ekādaśa paśūnupākaroti ekādaśasu vā ||1|| agniṃ yunajmi śavasā ghṛteneti tisṛbhiḥ prāta:savane'gnimabhimṛśati || 2 || dakṣiṇākāle hiraṇyapātraṃ madhoḥ pūrṇaṃ śatamānasya kṛtaṃ citraṃ devānāmityavekṣya madhyaṃdine'śvenāvaghrāpya brahmaṇe dadāti || 3 || adhvaryave kalyāṇīrdakṣiṇā dadyāt || 4 || yadasyānyāścinuyāyattaṃ dakṣiṇābhirna rādhayedagnimasya vṛñjīta || 5|| upākṛte yajñāyājñi (jñī)yasya stotra ekayā prastuta ekasyāṃ vā gītāyāṃ samudre te hṛdayamiti dvābhyāmagnimabhimṛśati || 6|| sautrāmaṇyā yajeta | maitrāvaruṇyā cā''mikṣayā ||14|| agniṃ citvā saṃvatsaraṃ na kaṃcana pratyavarohenna pakṣiṇo'śnīyāt || 15 || yāvajjīvaṃ varṣati | na dhāvenna rāmāmupeyānna dvitīyaṃ citvā'nyasya striyamupeyāt || 16 || na tṛtīyaṃ citvā kāṃcanopeyādbhāryāṃ vopeyāt || 17 || agniṃ citvā ya etasminsaṃvatsare na viroceta | sa kratumārabhamāṇa ekacitīkamagniṃ cinvīta ||18|| salilāya tvā sarṇīkāya tvetyaṣṭau nānāmantrāḥ || 19 || yathārthaṃ lokaṃpṛṇāḥ | atha purīṣam ||12.7.20|| agniṃ citvā ya etasminsaṃvatsare na pratiṣṭhetsa kratumārabhamāṇa ekacitīkamagniṃ cinvīta saṃyacca pracetāśceti pañca nānāmantrāḥ | yathārthaṃ lokaṃpṛṇāḥ | atha purīṣam || 21 || punaścitiṃ vyākhyāsyāmaḥ | sā triṣvartheṣu śrūyate śra( te'sra )vaṇārthe vā samṛddhyarthe vā saṃtānārthe vā ||22|| śra( asra )vaṇārthāṃ vyākhyāsyāmaḥ | yadīṣṭyā yadi paśunā yadi somena yajeta || 23 || yatraivāsya pūrvo'gniścitaḥ syāttadaparamanvavasāya yajeta || 24 || apivā yenarṣaya ityaṣṭau nānāmantrā aṣṭau ca lokaṃpṛṇāḥ | atha purīṣam || 25 || śvobhūte'ṣṭau nānāmantrā ekādaśa lokaṃpṛṇāḥ | atha purīṣam | śvobhūte etā nānāmantrā dvādaśa ca lokaṃpṛṇāḥ | atha purīṣam | atha samṛddhyarthāṃ vyākhyāsyāmaḥ | agniṃ citvā ya etasminsaṃvatsare nardhnoti | sa kratumārabhamāṇastricitīkamagniṃ cinvīta | salilāya tvā sarṇīkāya tvetyaṣṭau nānāmantrā ekādaśa ca lokaṃpṛṇāḥ | atha purīṣam | śvobhūta etāśca nānāmantrā dvādaśa ca lokaṃpṛṇāḥ | atha purīṣam | śvobhūta etāśca nānāmantrāstrayodaśa ca lokaṃpṛṇāḥ | atha purīṣam | saṃtānārthāyāṃ tu tṛtīyamagniṃ cinvānastṛtīyasyāṃ citau yenarṣaya ityaṣṭau ca nānāmantrā aparimitāśca śyenacitaṃ cinvīta suvargakāma iti | vakrapakṣo vyastapucchaḥ śyenākṛtirbhavati ||3|| kaṅkacitaṃ cinvīta yaḥ kāmayeta śīrṣaṇvānamuṣmim̐lloke syāmiti | kaṅkākṛtirnirāyatagrīvaḥ śīrṣaṇvānbhavati || 4|| alajacitaṃ cinvīta catuḥsītaṃ pratiṣṭhākāma iti catasraścatasraḥ sītāḥ saṃhitāḥ kṛṣati || 5|| praugacitaṃ cinvīta bhrātṛvyavāniti śakaṭākṛtirbhavati || 6|| ubhayataḥpraugaṃ cinvīta yaḥ kāmayeta prajātānbhrātṛvyānnudeyam̐ pratijaniṣyamāṇānityubhayataḥ śakaṭākṛtirbhavati | yathā vimukhe śakaṭe || 7 || rathacakracitaṃ cinvīta bhrātṛvyavāniti parimaṇḍalo bhavati || 8|| droṇacitaṃ cinvītānnakāma iti dvayāni tu khalu droṇāni caturaśrāṇi parimaṇḍalāni ca tatra yāthākāmī || 9|| paścātsvarurbhavatyanurūpatvāyeti || 12.8.10 || samūhyaṃ cinvīta paśukāma iti samūhanniveṣṭakā upadadhāti || 11 || dikṣu cātvālātkhātvā tebhyaḥ purīṣamabhyūhatītyekeṣām || 12 || paricāyyaṃ cinvīta grāmakāma iti madhyamāṃ svayamātṛṇṇāṃ pradakṣiṇamiṣṭakāgaṇaiḥ paricinoti ||13 || saparicāyyopacāyyaṃ cinvīta grāmakāma iti paricāyyenoktaḥ ||14|| śmaśānacitaṃ cinvīta yaḥ kāmayeta pitṛloka ṛdhnuyāmiti caturaśraḥ parimaṇḍalo vā | yathā mahāpaitṛkī vedirityekeṣām | tryaśrirityekeṣām ||(kha020)|15|| tāpaścitaṃ stotrāya hotṛcamasamukhyāṃścamasānunnayati | stutaśastre bhavataḥ | śastraṃ pratigīrya prājāpatyānāṃ mukhya grahamadhvaryurādatte | ṛtvija itarān || 28|| surāgrahāṇāṃ mukhyaṃ pratiprasthātā vājasṛta purastātpañcarātre māsi dīkṣeta || 2|| yathā'syāṃ parasminsaṃvatsare taiṣyāṃ paurṇamāsyāmabhiṣecanīyāyokthyāya dīkṣā pravatsyatīti ||3|| jyotiṣṭomenāgniṣṭomena prathamaṃ yajeta || 4 || pañcāpavargo bhavati || 5 || aṃśunā te aṃśuriti somamabhimantrya tūṣṇīṃ phalāni abhi tyaṃ devamiti mītvā somam | tūṣṇīṃ phalāni | prajābhyastvetyādi somaṃ te krīṇānīti japitvā gavā te tasyā ātmā dvābhyāṃ rājasūyasyeti vacanāt | dvābhyāṃ śatābhyāṃ krayaḥ | śatadvayasya saptasomānāṃ saptadhā vibhāgaḥ | ekaikasyāṣṭāviṃśatiḥ, ekaikasya śatasahasraṃ sarveṣu rājasūyikeṣu someṣu samaśaḥ prativibhajyānvahaṃ dadāti || 6 || tathā dakṣiṇā nayet || 7|| yathā'syāhāni svakālāni syuḥ| śeṣamanudiśet || 8|| rājasūyeṣṭipaśubandhānāmanvahaṃ codanāt ||9|| teṣāṃ dakṣiṇāpṛthaktveneṣṭipṛthaktvaṃ pratīyāt || 13.3.10 || anyaddiśāmaveṣṭeḥ pṛthakdākṣiṇāni tānyekatantrāṇi bhavanti || 11 || śvobhūta ānumataprabhṛtibhiranvahaṃ yajeta || 12 || anumatyai puroḍāśamaṣṭākapālaṃ nirvapatīti yathāsamāmnātam | piṃṣannānumataṃ paścāduttarataśca vyavaśātayati || 13 || ye pratyañcaḥ śamyāyā avaśīyante taṃ nairṛtamekakapālaṃ kuryāt || 14 || upadhāyā''numatasya kapālāni nairṛtasya kapālamupadadhāti || 15 || āsādyā(dyā'')numanaṃ vopasamādhāya juṣāṇā nirṛtirvetu svāheti || (kha08).|| visraṃsikāyāḥ kāṇḍābhyāṃ sarvahutaṃ naiṛtaṃ juhoti || 19 || aṅguṣṭhābhyāmeṣa te nirṛte bhāga iti vā ||13.3.20|| vāso'bhinnāntaṃ dakṣiṇā kṛṣṇaṃ vāsaḥ kṛṣṇadaśam || 21 || apaḥ pariṣicyāpratīkṣamāyanti || 22 || svāhā namo ya idaṃ cakāreti punaretya gārhapatye juhoti ||23|| a(ā)numatena pracarati ya udañco'vaśīyante tānudakparetya śuktyā valmīkavapāmuddhatyedamahamayuṣyā''muṣyāyaṇasya kṣetriyamavayaja iti śuktyā valmīkavapāyāṃ juhoti | tāmapidadhātīdamahamamuṣyā''muṣyāyaṇasya kṣetriyamapidadha iti śuktyā valmīkavapayā vā || 24 || ādityaṃ caruṃ nirvapatīti taduttarāsvāsāmuttamā || 25|| āgrayaṇeṣṭistayeṣṭvā śvobhūte sarasvatyai caruṃ nirvapati | sarasvate caruṃ mithunau gāvau dakṣiṇā||26|| śvobhūte cāturmāsyānyālabhate | taiḥ saṃvatsaraṃ yajate ||27|| na śunāsīrīyaṃ pratisamasyāti 28|| śvobhūta indraturīyaprabhṛtibhiranvahaṃ yajate || 29|| āgneyamaṣṭākapālaṃ nirvapatīti yathāsamāmnātam | caturhavirindraturīyam | tatsaṃgrāme nirvapet ||13.3.30|| etasyā eva rātrerniśāyāṃ pañcedhmīyena yajeta || 31 || niśāyāmapāmārgahomena caranti || 32 || sāyaṃhute'gnihotre'pāṃ nyayanādapāmārgānāhṛtya tānsaktūnkṛtvā dakṣiṇāgnerekolmukaṃ dhūpayati || 33 || parācīnamuttarāparamavāntaradeśaṃ hṛtvā svakṛta iriṇe pradare vopasamādhāya ||(kha09)||devasya tvā savituḥ prasave'śvinorbāhubhyāṃ pūṣṇo hastābhyāṃ rakṣaso dakṣiṇā | yadvaste taddakṣiṇā || 35 || etenaiva yajeta yaḥ pāpmano bibhīyātpañcedhmīyena carati | caturdhā''havanīyaṃ pratidiśaṃ vyūhati | madhye pañcamam | pṛthagidhmānupasamādhāya ye devāḥ puraḥsada iti pradakṣiṇamanuparikrāmanpratidiśaṃ catasra āhutīrjuhoti | madhye pañcamīm | samūḍhaṃ rakṣa iti madhya idhmānabhisamuhyāgnaye rakṣoghne svāheti pañcagṛhītena pañcottarā rathaḥ pañcavāhī dakṣiṇā | praṣṭivāhī vā || 36|| tenaiva yajeta yo rakṣobhyo bibhīyātpiśācebhyo vā | taṃ ca yatkāmayate taddadyāt || 37 || śvobhūte devikāhavirbhiryajeta || 38 || dhātre puroḍāśaṃ dvādaśakapālaṃ nirvapatīti yathāsamāmnātam | mithunau gāvau dakṣiṇā vatsatarī vā || 39 || pravītā pravīyamāṇetyekeṣām || 13.3.40 || tābhiḥ prajākāmaḥ paśukāmo vā yajeta || 41 || āmayāvinaṃ yājayedvā dhātāraṃ madhyataḥ kṛtvā prajākāmaḥ putrairdhātāramuttamaṃ kṛtvā''mayāvī paśunā yajate || 42 || śvobhūte triṣaṃyuktairanvahaṃ yajate || 43 || āgnāvaiṣṇavamekādaśakapālaṃ nirvapatīti yathāsamāmnātaṃ prathamaṃ triṣaṃyuktaṃ tena yajñakāmo yajeta | agnīṣomīyamekādaśakapālaṃ nirvapatīti yathāsamāmnātaṃ madhyamaṃ triṣaṃyuktaṃ vīrajanaṃ samāmananti | somāpauṣṇaṃ caruṃ nirvapatīti yathāsamāmnātamuttamaṃ triṣaṃyuktaṃ tena paśukāmo yajeta | vaiśvānaraṃ dvādaśakapālaṃ nirvapatīti tena grāmakāmo yajeta | vāruṇaṃ yavamayaṃ carumiti sarvataḥprādeśamātro vāruṇaścarurbhavati | yogyo'śvo vyuptavaho vā dakṣiṇā | samānatantrau vaiśvānaravāruṇāveke samāmananti| (kha010)||44|| iti satyāṣāḍhahiraṇyakeśisūtre trayodaśapraśne tṛtīyaḥ paṭalaḥ || 13.4 atha trayodaśapraśne caturthaḥ paṭalaḥ | śvobhūte trayodaśa ratninām̐ havīṃṣi ||1|| yajamānasyā''ptānāṃ gṛheṣvanvahaṃ nirvapati ||2|| yasya yasya gṛhe nirvapati tasya tasya gṛhādiṣṭipariveṣaṇaṃ dakṣiṇā ca || 3 || bārhaspatyaṃ caruṃ nirvapati brahmaṇo gṛhe | śitipṛṣṭho dakṣiṇeti yathāsamāmnātam | purohitasyaikeṣām || 4|| bhagāya caruṃ vā vātāyai gṛhe vicittagarbhā paṣṭhauhī dakṣiṇā ||5|| nairṛtaṃ carumiti sarvato'ṅguṣṭhamātro nairṛtaścarurbhavati ||6|| aṅguṣṭhaparvamātro vā sarvahutaṃ nairṛtaṃ juhoti || 7 || takṣarathakārāvekasmingṛhe samavanīyā''gneyamaṣṭākapālaṃ nirvapati sarvāyasāni dakṣiṇā govikartrakṣāvāpāvekasmingṛhe samavanīya vaiṣṇavaṃ trikapālamiti vatsaḥ śvetaśabalo dakṣiṇā | vaiṣṇavaṃ trikapālaṃ trayodaśaṃ takṣarathakārayorgṛhe | sarvāyasāni dakṣiṇā | takṣṇo rathakārasya vetyeke || 8 || senānyo gṛhe samavanīyā''gneyamaṣṭākapālaṃ nirvapatīti hiraṇyaṃ dakṣiṇā || 9 || raudraṃ gāvīdhukaṃ carumakṣāvāpasya gṛhe śabala udvāro dakṣiṇā | arvāpārāva(sirvālāvṛ)taḥ kesarapāśā vā govyucchatī(nī)rajjuḥ || 13.4.10 || adhvane svāheti pālākalasya gṛhe juhoti || 11 || anṛtadūtaṃ bruvate | dhanurvetravītaṃ dakṣiṇā || 12 || trayaścarmamayā bāṇavanto dakṣiṇā || 13 || aindramuttamaṃ yajamānasya gṛhe nirvapati | anvahameke bruvate | indrāya sutrāmṇe puroḍāśamekādaśakapālaṃ (prati ) nirvapati | indrāyāṃhomuce | yanno rājā vṛtrahā rājā bhūtvā vṛtraṃ vadhyāditi sūktavākasyā''śīḥṣu hotā'nuvartayati || 14 || svayamavapannāyā aśvatthaśākhāyai maitraṃ | amathitapūrve dṛtī, āne vā hatau | śvetavatsayuktā śvetā gauḥ | tatsvayaṃmṛta saṃyogena parivahati prāpayati | tatsvayaṃmathitamātape viṣanti | tatvayaṃ vilīnamājyaṃ bhavati | iti | nirvapaṇakāle bṛhaspataye nirupya mitrāya nirvapatīti | yathā vā triṣphalīkṛteṣu vibhāgamantreṇa karṇāṃścākarṇāṃśca | taṇḍulānvivicanti | kṣodiṣṭhāṃśca sthaviṣṭhāṃścetyekeṣām || 22 || ye karṇāḥ sa payasi bārhaspatyaḥ | ye'karṇāḥ sa ājye maitraḥ sa yadā śṛtaḥ syādatha taṃ maitrapātramupariṣṭādavadadhāti || 23 || tasminpavitre'va dhāya svayaṃvilīnamāsiñcati || 24 || tasminpavitravatyājye sthavīyastaṇḍulānāvapati || 25 || tāvuttarādharau saha śṛtau karoti || 26 || dharmamātraṃ śrapaṇamardhaṃ svayaṃdinaṃ barhiḥ svayaṃkṛta idhmo nimnamadhyavasyati | sā svayaṃkṛtā vedirbhavati | vedyāḥ || 28|| pracaraṇakāle bārhaspatyena pracarya maitreṇa pracarati || 29|| itarathā vā | śitipṛṣṭho bārhaspatyasya dakṣiṇā| aśvo maitrasya | vyuptavaho vā | sā caiva śvetā śvetavatsā dakṣiṇā ||(kha012)|| dadhadratnāni suvidāno agne gopāya no jīvase jātaveda iti yājyānuvākye || (kha04)||86|| iti satyāṣāḍhahiraṇyakaśisūtre pañcadaśapraśne prathamaḥ paṭalaḥ || 15.2 atha pañcadaśapraśne dvitīyaḥ paṭalaḥ | yasmādbhīṣā niṣīdasi tato no abhayaṃ kṛdhi | prajābhyaḥ sarvābhyo mṛḍa namo rudrāya mīḍhuṣa ityabhimantrayeta ||1|| yadyagnihotryupasṛṣṭopasannā vā niṣīdedudasthāddevyaditirviśvarūpyāyuryajñapatāvadhāt | indrāya kṛṇvatī bhāgaṃ mitrāya varuṇāya cati tāmutthāpya dugdhvā brāhmaṇāya dadyāt || 2 || yasyānnaṃ nādyādapi vaināṃ daṇḍena vipiṣyāvipiṣya votthāpyā''tmankurvīta sūyavasādbhagavatī hi bhūyā atho vayaṃ bhagavantaḥ syāma | addhi tṛṇamaghnye viśvadānīṃ piba śuddhamudakamācarantīti darbhastambamālu(lo)pya grāsayet || 3 || yadi duhyamānā vāśyeta yadi vā lohitaṃ duhīta vyutkrāmatetyuktvā dakṣiṇāgniṃ pariśritya tasminnetaṃ śrapayitvā tasminneva juhuyāt | tāṃ brāhmaṇāya dadyādyamanabhyāgamiṣyanmanyeta || 4|| yadadya dugdhaṃ pṛthivīmasakta yadoṣadhīrapyasaradyadāpaḥ| payo gṛheṣu payo aghniyāsu payo vatseṣu payo astu tanmayītyenadabhimantrya yadi duhyamānaṃ skandetsamudraṃ vaḥ prahiṇomītyetayā'dbhirupaninīya tadeva yādṛkkīdṛgghutvā'nyāṃ dugdhvā punarjuhuyāt || 5 || api vā tāṃ caiva duhyādanyāṃ vā yadi bhindyādanyām̐ sthālīṃ nirṇijyāthānyāṃ duhyādudakaṃ tvanuparāsicyam || 6|| yadi dugdhaṃ skandedyadi hriyamāṇaṃ yadyadhiśrīyamāṇaṃ yadyadhiśritaṃ yadyudvāsyamānaṃ yadyudvāsitamanyāmabhiduhyāt || 7 || atha yadyunnītaṃ skandedyadi dviryadi trirna tadādriyetetyekeṣām | caturthamunnīyamānaṃ skandetsthālyām̐ śeṣamānīya tataścaturgṛhītaṃ gṛhītvā vāruṇīmṛcamanūcya vāruṇyarcā juhuyāt || (kha05) ||8|| yadyunnītaṃ skandetpunarabhyunnīya hotavyamathā''jyena vāruṇīmṛcamanūcya vāruṇyarcā juhuyāt || 9|| yadyuddrutasya skandedyattato hutvā punareyadyajñaṃ vicchindyādyatra skandettaṃ niṣadha punargrahṇīyāttadeva yādṛkkīdṛgghutvā'nyāṃ dugdhvā punarjuhuyāt ||15.2.10|| yadi prācīnaṃ hriyamāṇaṃ skandetprajāpaterviśve bhṛti tanvā( nvāṃ )hutamasītyabhimantryāthā''jyena vāruṇīmṛcamanūcya vāruṇyarcā juhuyāt || 11 || yadi puraḥ parāhṛtaṃ skandedanūddhṛtya punarabhyunnīya hotavyamathā''jyena vāruṇīmṛcamanūcya vāruṇyarcā juhuyāt || 12|| yadi pura upasannamahutaṃ skandettadeva yādṛkkīdṛkca hutvā'nyāṃ dugdhvā punarjuhuyāt || 13 || askāndyauḥ pṛthivīmaskānṛṣabho yuvā gāḥ | skannemā viśvā bhuvanā skanno yajñaḥ prajanayatu | askānajani prājanyā skannājjāyate vṛṣā | skannātprajaniṣīmahītyagnihotraṃ skannamabhimantryādbhirupaninayet || 14 || yadi sāyaṃ skandedā hotoḥ prātarnāśnīyāt | yadi prātaḥ skandedā hotoḥ sāyaṃ nāśnīyāt || 15|| divyā vā etamaśanirabhyavaiti yasyāgnihotraṃ śiriśi(śaraśa)rā bhavati | samoṣāmumiti brūyādyaṃ dviṣyāt || 16 || yasyāgnihotre'dhiśrite śvā'ntarā dhāvedgārhapatyādbhasmā''dāyedaṃ viṣṇurvicakrama iti vaiṣṇavyarcā''havanīyāddhvaṃsaṃyannuddravedetayaiva bhasmanā śunaḥ padamupavapati || 17 || yasyānāhṛtamagniḥ sūryo'bhinimrocedyatra dīpyamānaṃ parāpaśyettata āhṛtyainaṃ praviśānīti vaiṣa ādhīyate || 18|| iti dakṣiṇāgneranugatasyā''dhānakalpaḥ ||19|| yasyānuddhṛtamagniṃ sūryo'bhinimrocet ||(kha06)|| agnihotraṃ pūrvaṃ hareyuḥ | athāgnimuddhareyuḥ | api vā darbheṇa hiraṇyaṃ prabadhya pūrvaḥ pratipadyetānvaṅbrāhmaṇa ārṣeyo bahuvidagnimuddharet | anvaṅṅagnihotreṇānudravedagniṃ pratiṣṭhāpyāgnihotramupasādyā''tamitoraprāṇannāsitvā varaṃ dattvā hutvā bhūrbhuvaḥ suvarityupatiṣṭheta vāruṇaṃ caruṃ nivapet || doṣāvastarnamaḥ svāheti juhuyāt || 15.2.20 || yadi sāyamagnihotrasyartumati nayetprātarvastarnamaḥ svāheti juhuyāt || 21 || yadi prātaragnihotrasyartumati nayetkālasamāpa(pāda)nīyametābhyāṃ mantrā'bhyāṃ hutvā nityamagnihotraṃ juhoti || 22 || sāyamagnihotramupasādya bhūrbhuvaḥ suvariti purastāddhotorvadati hutvā ca prātaragnihotramupasādyā''tamitoraprāṇannāsitvā varaṃ dattvā hutvā bhūrbhuvaḥ suvarityupatiṣṭhetānugamayatyāhavanīyamanvagniruṣasāmagramakhyadityanyaṃ praṇīyehaiva kṣemyā edhi mā prahāsīnmā'mumāmuṣyāyaṇamityupatiṣṭheta | maitraṃ caruṃ nirvapet || 23 || sauryamekakapālameke samāmananti || 24 || tasyāṃ saṃsthitāyāmanaśnantau vāgyatāvetadaharjāyāpatī agnimindhānāvāsāte || 25 || dvayoḥ payasā sāyamagnihotraṃ juhuyāt | pūrvamadhiśrityottaramānayet || 26 || yasyānuddhṛtamagniṃ sūryo'bhyudiyāccaturgrahītamājyaṃ gṛhītvā pūrvaḥ pratipadyetānvaṅbrāhmaṇa ārṣeyo bahuvidagnimuddharet | anvaṅṅagnihotreṇānudravedagniṃ pratiṣṭhāpyāgnihotramupasādya || (kha07) ||purastātpratyaṅṅāsīna uṣāḥ ketunā juṣatāṃ yajñaṃ devebhirinvitaṃ devebhyo madhumattamaṃ svāhetyetaccaturgrahītaṃ hutvā nityamagnihotraṃ juhuyāt || 27 || tasya sa eva homakalpaḥ | sā prāyaścittiḥ| yatprātarṛtāvatīte || 28 || etāvannānā | nātrānugamayatyāhavanīyam || 29 || yasyāhutamagnihotraṃ sūryo'bhyudiyādunnīyā''tamitoraprāṇannāsitvā hutvā bhūrityupatiṣṭheta | varo dakṣiṇā || 15.2.30 || yadyante syādunnīya prāṅudādravetsa upasādyā''tamitorāsīta yadā tāmyedatha bhūḥ svāheti juhuyāt || 31 || yasya hoṣyāmīti pravṛtte hutaagnihotraṃ sūryo'bhyudiyāddhutvā tadathotsādya punarādheya ityekeṣām || 32 || yasyobhāvanugatau sūryo'bhyudiyāt | apivā'stamiyāt | yadivā'raṇyoḥ samārūḍho naśyetpunarādheyameva | tatra prāyaścittam || 33 || agnaye tantumate'ṣṭākapālaṃ nirvapedyasyāgnihotraṃ vicchidyeta dvyahe tryahe vā || 34 || svayaṃ kṛṇvānaḥ sugamaprayāvaṃ tigmaśṛṅgo vṛṣabhaḥ śośucānaḥ | pratnaṃ sadhasthamanupaśyamāna ātantumagnirdivyaṃ tatāna || tvaṃ nastanturuta seturagne tvaṃ panthā bhavasi devayānaḥ | tvayā'gne pṛṣṭhaṃ vayamāruhemāthā devaiḥ sadhamādaṃ mademeti yājyānuvākye || 35 || (kha08)|| iti satyāṣāḍhahiraṇyakeśisūtre pañcadaśapraśne dvitīyaḥ paṭalaḥ | 15.3 atha pañcadaśapraśne tṛtīyaḥ paṭalaḥ | yasyā''havanīye'nudvāte gārhapatya udvāyedāhavanīyamudvāpya gārhapatyasyāvakṣāṇāni saṃnidhāyetaḥ prathamaṃ jajñe agniriti manthedāhavanīyaṃ praṇīyāgne samrāḍiṣe rathyai ramasva sahase dyumnāyorje'patyāya samrāḍasi svarāḍasi suṣadā sīda sārasvatautvotsau samindhātāmityupasamindhe'gnaye tapasvate janadvate pāvakavate'ṣṭākapālaṃ nirvapet ||1|| āyāhi tapasā janeṣvagne pāvako arciṣā | upemāṃ suṣṭutiṃ mama || ā no yāhi tapasā janeṣvagne pāvaka dīdyat | havyā deveṣu no dadhaditi yājyānuvākye || 2|| etadevā''havanīye'nugate prāyaścittam | nātra gārhapatyamanugamayatyagnaye jyotiṣmate'ṣṭākapālaṃ nirvapati ||3|| na tapasvate || 4|| yadi sāyamahute'gnihotre pūrvo'gniranugacchedagnihotramadhiśrityonnīyetyekeṣām | agninā pūrveṇoddhṛtyāgnihotreṇānudra(nūddra)vedyo brāhmaṇo bahuvitso'gnimuddharet | yatpunarādhānamādāyī syāttaddadyāt || 5|| yadi prātarahute'gnihotre'paro'gniranugacchedanugamayitvā pūrvaṃ mathitvā'paramuddhṛtya juhuyāt || 6|| yadi tvareta pūrvamagnimanvavasāya tataḥ prāñcamuddhṛtya juhuyāt || 7|| jāmi tu tadyo'sya pūrvo'gnistamaparaṃ karoti || anyatraivāvasāyāgniṃ mathitvoddhṛtya juhuyāt | śvo'gnaye tapasvate janadvate pāvakavate'ṣṭākapālaṃ nirvapet || (kha09)||8|| yasyāparo'gniranugacchedityekeṣām ||9|| na kālamavadhārayāti | tato'trāgniṃ mathitvoddhṛtyābhimantrayata itaḥ prathamaṃ jajñe agnirityetayā'gne samrāḍiṣe rayyai ramasva sarase dyumnāyorje'patyāya samrāḍasi svarāḍasi suṣadā sīda sārasvatau tvotsau prāvatāmityupasamindhe'gnaye jyotiṣmate puroḍāśamaṣṭākapālaṃ nirvapedvāruṇaṃ yavamayaṃ carum || 15.3.10|| yasya pūrvo'gniranugacchedityekeṣām | na kālamavadhārayati | tebhya evāvakṣāṇebhyo'dhimanthitavyaḥ | atha yadi na tādṛśānīvāvakṣāṇāni syuḥ | bhasmanā'raṇī saṃsparśya manthitavyaḥ svādevainaṃ yonerjanayati || agnaye tapasvate janadvate pāvakavate'ṣṭākapālaṃ nirvapet|| yasyāgniranugacchedityekeṣām | na kālamavadhārayati| tebhya evāvakṣāṇebhyo'dhimanthitavyo'tha yadi śalkedhv (ddha)stṛṇedvo(ddho)vā syādbhasmanā'raṇī saṃsparśya manthitavyaḥ svādevainaṃ yonerjanayati| agnaye tapasvate janadvate pāvakavate'ṣṭākapālaṃ nirvapet || 11|| anugateṣṭervā sthāna etā āhatīrjuhoti || || (kha010)|| mitrāya svāhā varuṇāya svāhā somāya svāhā sūryāya svāhā'gnaye tapasvate janadvate pāvakavate svāhā'gnaye śucaye svāhā'gnaye jyotiṣmate svāhāsgnaye vratapataye svāheti vyāhṛtibhirvihṛtābhiḥ samastābhiśca || 12 || athaikeṣāṃ vijñāyate yadi prāgagnihotrakālādāhavanīyo'nugacchedanyaṃ praṇayet || 13 || yadi homakāle prāṇa udānamapyagāditi gārhapatye juhuyāt || 14 || yadi gārhapatya udānaḥ prāṇamapyagādityāhavanīye || 15|| yadi dakṣiṇāgnirvyāna udānamapyagāditi gārhapatye || 16 || yadi sarve'nugaccheyuragniṃ mathitvā yāṃ diśaṃ vāto vāyāttāṃ diśamāhavanīyaṃ praṇīya vāyave svāheti juhuyāt || 17 || yadi nivāte'nugaccheyuragniṃ mathitvā vihāraṃ sādhayitvā'pareṇā''havanīyamupaviśya svayamagnihotraṃ pibet ( agnihotrapratyāmnāyo bhavatīti vijñāyate | )|| 18 || yadyastamite juhuyāt | punarevāstamite juhuyāt ||19|| yadi mahārātre juhuyāt | punarevoṣasi juhuyāt ||15.3.20|| agnaye'gnivate puroḍāśamaṣṭākapālaṃ nirvapedyasyāgnāvagnimabhyuddhareyuḥ || 21|| bhavataṃ naḥ samanasāvityabhimantrayeta || 22 || agnaye jyotiṣmate puroḍāśamaṣṭākapālaṃ nirvapet | yasyāgniruddhṛto'hute'gnihotra udvāyedapara ādīpyānuddhṛtya ityāhustattathā na kāryaṃ yadbhāgadheyamabhipūrva uddhriyate kimaparo'bhyuddhriyeteti tānyevāvakṣāṇāni saṃnidhāyetaḥ prathamaṃ jajñe agniriti manthet || 23 || trayastriṃśatantavo ye vitatnira iti juhuyāt || 24 || yadi kṛṣṇaśakunirdhvaṃsayannuparyuparyagnihotramatīya( tipa )te( t ) | yasyāgnihotre'dhiśrite haviṣi vā nirupte puruṣaḥ śvā ratho'no vā'ntarā'gnī vīyāt ||(kha011)|| gaurvarāha eḍako vā | tatrāpo'nvatiṣicya gāmanvatyā''vartayet( vardhatāṃ bhūtirdadhnā ghṛtena muñcatu yajño yajñapatimaṃhasaḥ svāheti ) || 25 || gārhapatyādbhasmā''dāyedaṃ viṣṇurvicakrama iti vaiṣṇavyarcā''havanīyāddhvaṃsayannuddravedetayaiva bhasmanā padamapi vapati | vartma ca lopayetpadaṃ ca || 26|| yadyano ratho vā'ntarā'gnī vīyādityekeṣām | na kālamavadhārayati | anugamayatyā havanīyaṃ yadagne pūrvaṃ prabhṛtaṃ padaṃ hi te raśmīnanvātatāna | tatra rayiṣṭhāmanusaṃbharaitaṃ saṃ naḥ sṛja sumatyā vājavatyā | tvamagne saprathā asi juṣṭo hotā vareṇyaḥ | tvayā yajñaṃ vitanvata ityanyaṃ praṇīyāgnaye pathikṛte puroḍāśamaṣṭākapālaṃ nirvapet | atho'ntikādbarhirāharedanaḍvāndakṣiṇā || 27 || etāmeva nirvapet | stotre mūḍha etāṃ śastra etām || 28 || yasya vā'gnibhiragnīnvyaveyuryo vā vyaveyāt || 29 || etāṃ jane pramītasya || 15.3.30|| tasyābhivānyavatsāyaiḥ payasā jane pramītasyāgnihotraṃ juhuyād yāvadasyāgnibhiḥ śarīrāṇi saṃsparśayeyuḥ | ya udañco darbhāstāndakṣiṇāgrānstṛṇāti | prācīnāvītyagnihotraṃ dohayatyadhastātsamidhaṃ dhārayati || 31|| upari hi devebhyo dhārayantīti vijñāyate || 32 || apo mṛnmayāna(nya)bhyavaharanti || 33 || dadatyevā''yasāni || 34 || brāhmaṇāya yajñāyudhāni dadyāt || 35 || amaiva putrasya dṛṣat || 36|| yadyapramītaṃ pramīta iti śṛṇuyādagnaye surabhimate puroḍāśamaṣṭākapālaṃ nirvapet || 37 || yadi pūrvasyāmāhutyāṃ hutāyāṃ yajamāno mriyeta dakṣiṇa uttarāmāhutiṃ ninayet || 38 || bhasmotkaraṃ vā gamayet || (kha012) || 39|| iti satyāṣāḍhahiraṇyakeśisūtre pañcadaśapraśne tṛtīyaḥ paṭalaḥ | 15.4 atha pañcadaśapraśne caturthaḥ paṭalaḥ | yadyājyamanutpūtaṃ skandecchindaddeyaṃ varo deya ityekeṣām | yadyutpūyamānaṃ skandecchindatprāṇi dadyāt || yadyutpūtaṃ citraṃ deyam || 1|| yadasya gṛhe puṣkalaṃ syāttaddadyāt || 2 || yadi sruggataṃ bhūpataye svāheti tatprāñcaṃ prādeśaṃ nidadhyāt | bhuvanapataye svāheti dakṣiṇataḥ | bhūtānāṃ pataye svāheti pratyañcaṃ bhūtāya svāhetyudañcam | bhūrbhuvaḥ suvarityūrdhvaṃ saṃ tvā siñcāmīti tatsaṃsiñcatyabhimantrayate vā || 3|| yajñasya tvā pramayā'bhimayā pratimayonmayā parigṛhṇāmīti parigṛhṇāti || 4 || devāñjanamaganyajña ityekeṣāmanantaramājyādvadati || 5 || bhūpataye svāhā bhuvanapataye svāhā bhūtānāṃ pataye svāheti skannamanumantrayeteti sarvahaviṣāmanavayavena śrūyate ||6|| yadi kapālaṃ naśyedāśvinaṃ dvikapālaṃ nirvapeddyāvāpṛthivyamekakapālam | bhārgavo hotā bhavati | ekahāyano dakṣiṇā ||7|| yadi bhidyeta gāyatryā tvā śatākṣarayā saṃdadhāmīti tatsaṃdhāyābhinno gharma ityabhimantryāpo'bhyāvahṛtyāthānyatkapālaṃ saṃskṛtya tadvā piṣṭvā'nyayā mṛdā karaṇīyayā kṛtvā gharmo devāṃ apyetviti kapāleṣvapi sṛjati || yadi prāgupadhānādbhidyeta || 8 || atha yadyupahitānāmetenaiva mantreṇopadadhyāt || 9|| vaiśvānaraṃ dvādaśakapālaṃ nirvapedyadi patnī saṃyājayankapālamabhi juhuyāt || 15.4.10 || etāmeva nirvapetputre jāta etāmeva nirvapedyo darśapūrṇamāsayājī sannamāvāsyāṃ vā paurṇamāsīṃ vā'tipāda(ta)yet || 11 || etāmeva nirvapedyadaniṣṭvā''grayaṇena navasyāśnīyāt || 12 || ānīto vā eṣa devānāṃ ya āhitāgniradantyasya devā annam | yadakṛtvā''grayaṇaṃ navāsyāśnīyāddevebhyo(vānāṃ) bhāgaṃ pratiklṛptamadyādārtimārchet || 13 || mārutaṃ trayodaśakapālaṃ nirvapedyasya putrau yamau jāyetāṃ gāvau vā || (kha0 13) || 14 || nirvīryatāṃ vai jātaḥ puruṣa āśāste'paśutāṃ gauḥ || 15 || gāyatrī puronuvākyā bhavati | triṣṭugyājyā || 16 || vaiṣṇavaṃ trikapālameke samāmananti || 17 || āgnāvaiṣṇavamekādaśakapālaṃ nirvapedyasyā( dya)nyama(syā)gniṣu yājayeyuryo vā yajeta || 18 || raudraṃ vāstumayaṃ caruṃ nirvapedyatra paśupatiḥ paśūñchamayeta || 19 || etayā niṣādasthapatiṃ yājayet || 15.4.20 || kṛṣṇājinaṃ vā kūṭaṃ vā'karṇo vā gardabho dakṣiṇā| hariṇo vā hariṇapṛṇākā vā śyāmākapātro vā| dve vākyāmbū śūrpe śayyāṃ vā | sā hi tasyeṣṭiḥ || 21 || yo brahmacārī striyamupeyātsa gardabhaṃ paśumālabheta || 22 || bhūmāvekakapālaṃ paśupuroḍāśaṃ śrapayati || 23 || apsvavadānaiścareyuḥ || 24 || nairṛtaḥ prājāpatyo vā | rakṣodevata ityekeṣām | yamadevata ityekeṣām || 25 || yasya haviḥ kṣāyati taṃ yajñaṃ nirṛtirgṛhṇāti yadā taddhaviḥ saṃtiṣṭheta | atha tadeva haviḥ punarnirvapet || 26|| yajño yajñasya prāyaścittiryaducchiṣṭaṃ syāt || tena saṃsthāpayet | yaṃ dviṣyāttasmai tāṃ dakṣiṇāṃ dadyāt | tameva nirṛtyā grāhayati || 27 || yathākathā ca kṣāyetprāyaścittameva syāt || 28 || yadi vā'vadānebhyo na prabhavet || 29 || yadyaprattadaivataṃ havirvyāpadyetāthānyattadaivataṃ havirabhyudāharet || 15.4.30 || tatra srugādānaprabhṛtayo mantrā āvarteran || 31 || (yāvadante vā vyāpadyeta || 32 || yadi tu prattadaivatamājyena śeṣaṃ saṃsthāpayet || 33 || yasya sarvāṇi havīṃṣi || (kha0 14)|| naśyeyurvā duṣyeyurvā'pahareyurvā''jyena devatāḥ pratisaṃkhyāya yajeta || 34 || athānyāmiṣṭimanulbaṇāṃ tanvīta | yajño hi yajñasya prāyaścittiḥ || 35|| apo vyāpannaṃ havirabhyavaharatīti vijñāyate || 36 || yadāryāṇāmabhojanīyaṃ syānna tena yajeta ||37|| yaddhavirduḥśṛtaṃ yamadevatyaṃ tadyamameva gacchatīti saṃsthāpya tadanvāhāryapacane catuḥśarāvamodanaṃ paktvā caturo brāhmaṇānbhojayet || 38 || teṣāṃ bhārgava ekaḥ prāśitṝṇāṃ syāttebhyaḥ samāno varo deyaḥ | sā prāyaścittiḥ || 39 || yo'dakṣiṇena yajñena yajeta | sa yajñaḥ prakṣāmo'nāyu(ru)rvarā pratiṣṭhitā deyā sā prāyaścittiḥ || 15.4.40|| yadyādiṣṭāṃ dakṣiṇāmantariyādurvarāṃ dadyātsā prāyaścittiḥ || 41 || yadyabhāgāṃ devatāmāvāhayedājyenaināṃ yathoḍhāṃ yajeta | purastādvā sviṣṭakṛtaḥ || 42 || yadi bhāginīṃ nā''vāhayedyadopasmarettadupotthāya manasā''vāhayedyadvo devā atipāda(ta)yānītyāhutiṃ juhuyāt ||43|| yasya havyaṃ niruptaṃ skandedājyaṃ vā gṛhītaṃ citraṃ deyam | varo deya ityekeṣām ||44|| yasyai devatāyai gṛhītamahutaṃ skandedyadasya gṛhe puṣkalaṃ syāttaddadyāt || 45 || yadyāhutī viparihareyurmano jyotirjuṣatāmityāhutiṃ juhuyāt || (kha0 15)|| 46|| yasya devate avadāne vā yājyānuvākye vā viparihareyustvaṃ no agne sa tvaṃ no agna ityetābhyāṃ saṃtatiṃ juhuyāt | sarvatrāntarite viparīte ca || 47|| yadi bahiṣparidhyāhutiḥ skandedāgnīdhraṃ brūyādetāṃ saṃkṛṣya juhudhīti | tāṃ so'ñjalinā saṃkṛṣya juhuyānmā yajamāno riṣanmā patnī mā yajño mā yajñapatiḥ svāheti tasmai pūrṇapātraṃ dadyāt || sā prāyaścittiḥ||48|| yadi puroḍāśaṃ udvā patetsa vā vijeta tamantarvedyāsādya kimutpatasi kimutproṣṭhāḥ śāntaḥ śānterihā''gahi | aghoro yajñiyo bhūtvā sīda sadanaṃ svaṃ mā sīda sadanaṃ svaṃ mā hiṃsīrdeva preṣita ājyena tejasā''jyasva mā naḥ kiṃcana rīriṣo yogakṣemasya śāntyā asminnāsīda barhiṣīti tametena yajuṣā'bhimantrayedabhivā''ghārayet ||49|| bhūtvā prabhavati yajamāno yasyaitāṃ yajñe prāyaścittiṃ kurvanti || (kha0 16) || 15.4.50 || iti satyāṣāḍhahiraṇyakaśisūtre pañcadaśapraśne caturthaḥ paṭalaḥ | 15.5 atha pañcadaśapraśne pañcamaḥ paṭalaḥ | agniṃ naro dīdhitibhiraraṇyorhastacyutī janayanta praśastam | dūredṛśaṃ gṛhapatimatharyum | agninā'gniḥ samidhyate sapta te agne mano jyotirjuṣatāṃ trayastriṃśadyanme manasaśchidraṃ yadvāpo(co)yacca me hṛdaḥ| ayaṃ devo bṛhaspatiḥ saṃ tatsiñcatu rādhasā || viśvakarmā haviridaṃ juṣāṇaḥ saṃtānairyajñaṃ samimaṃ tanotu | yā vyuṣṭā uṣaso yāśca yājyāstāḥ saṃdadhāmi haviṣā ghṛtena | ayāścāgne | tvaṃ no agne | satvaṃ no agne | bhadraṃ karṇebhiḥ śṛṇuyāma devā bhadraṃ paśyemākṣabhiryajatrāḥ | sthirairaṅgaistuṣṭu vāṃsastanūbhirvyaśema devahitaṃ yadāyuḥ | svasti na inrot vṛddhaśravāḥ svasti naḥ pūṣā viśvavedāḥ svasti nastārkṣyo ariṣṭanemiḥ svasti no bṛhaspatirdadhātu | pṛṣadaśvā marutaḥ pṛśnimātaraḥ śubhaṃyāvāno vidatheṣu jagmayuḥ | agnijihvā manavaḥ sūracakṣaso viśve no devā avasāgamanniha | śataminnu śarado anti devā yatrā naścakrā jarasaṃ tanūnām | putrāso yatra pitaro madanti mā no madhyā rīriṣatā''yurgantoḥ| preddho agna ityeṣā | śrutkarṇāya kavaye medhyāya vacobhirnākamupayāmi śaṃsan | yato bhayamabhayaṃ tatkṛdhī no'gne devānāmava heḍa yukṣva | agniṃ vo devamagnibhiḥ sajoṣā yavi(ji)ṣṭhaṃ dūtamadhvare kṛṇudhvam | yo marte(rtye)ṣu nidhruvirṛtāvātapurmūrdhā ghṛtānnaḥ pāvako ghṛtapratīko ghṛtayoniragnirghṛtaiḥ samiddho ghṛtama syānnam | ghṛtapruṣastvā sarito vahanti ghṛtaṃ pibantsuyajā yakṣi devān || āyurdā agna imo agne sapta te agne mano jyotirjuṣatāṃ trayastriṃśadyanme manasacchidraṃ viśvakarmā yunajmi tvā'gniṃ yunajmīndhānāstvā || (kha0 17 ) || agnirna īḍita īḍitavyairdevaiḥ pārthivaiḥ pātu | vāyurna īḍita īḍitavyairdevairāntarikṣaiḥ pātu sūryo na īḍita īḍitavyairdevairdivyaiḥ pātu | viṣṇurna īḍita īḍitavyairdevairdiśyaiḥ pātu | agniryajurbhiḥ pūṣā svagākāreṇa ta imaṃ yajñamavantu te māmavantvanu va ārabhe'nu mā rabhadhvaṃ svāhetyetaistribhiranuvākairavijñātaprāyaścitte some trayastriṃśatamāhutīrjuhoti || 1 || trayastriṃśataṃ yajñatanūrāgnīdhre ||2|| pṛthivi bhūvari sinīvālyurandhra ācitte manaste bhuvo vivasta iti vasatīvarīṣu savanīyāsu vā viṣiktāsu saptā''hutīrjuhoti || 3 || somasyā''jyamasi haviṣo havirjyotiṣāṃ jyotirviśveṣāṃ devānāṃ bhāgadheyī sthetyabhimantrya saṃ vaḥ siñcantu marutaḥ samindraḥ saṃ bṛhaspatiḥ | saṃ vo'yamagniḥ siñcatvāyuṣā • ca balena ca | sarvamāyardadhātu me || māndā vāśāḥ| āpo bhadrāḥ|.āditpaśyāmi| āpo hi ṣṭhā mayo bhuvo yo vaḥ śivatamo rasastasmā araṃ gamāma va ityetābhiḥ saptabhiḥ sam̐siñcedabhi vā mantrayeta || 4 || yadi prātaḥsavane purā homātsomo'tiricyeta taṃ camaseṣvabhyunnayeyurupa juhuyurvā ||5|| hute'tiriktasyā''śayitvā stutaśastravantaṃ kuryuḥ | sā prāyaścittiḥ || 6 || hotṛcamasamukhyāṃścamasānunnīya bṛhataḥ stotramupākaroti || 7 || gaurdhayati marutāmiti dhayadvatīṣu stuvīran || 8 || asti somo ayaṃ suta iti vaitāsvaindrāvaiṣṇavībhihoṃtre stuyuḥ || 9 || aindrāvaiṣṇavaṃ hotā'nuśaṃsati || 15.5.10 || etadeva mādhyandine savane'tirikte prāyaścittam||11|| baṇmahāṃ asi sūryeti sauryeṣu bṛhatā gauravītena vā stuvīran | etadeva tṛtīyasavane'tirikte prāyaścittam | vaiṣṇavīṣu śipiviṣṭavatīṣu bṛhatā gauravītena vā stuvīran || 12 || agniṣṭome somo'tiricyetokthyaṃ kurvīta || 13 || yadyukthye ṣoḍaśinaṃ yadi ṣoḍaśinyatirātraṃ yadyatirātre | (dvirātraṃ yadi dvirātra ekastotrameva )||14|| (tatra ) vaiṣṇavīṣu śipiviṣṭavatīṣu bṛhatā gauravītena vā stuvīran || 15|| yadi somau saṃsutau syātāṃ prathamāni catvāri saṃbhārayajūṃṣi hutvā mahati rātriyai prātaranuvākamupākuryāt | tasminparihita ehi yajamānetyukte'nvārabdhe yajamāne saṃveśāyopaveśāya gāyatriyā abhibhūtyai svāheti purastātprātaḥsavanasya juhuyāt || 16|| uttarāṇi catvāri saṃbhārayajūṃṣi hutvā saṃveśāyopaveśāya triṣṭubho'bhibhūtyai svāheti purastānmādhyaṃdinasya savanasya juhuyāt | uttarāṇi catvāri saṃbhārayajūṃṣi hutvā saṃveśāyopaveśāya jagatyā abhibhūtyai svāheti purastāttṛtīyasavanasya juhuyāt | uttarāṇi catvāri saṃbhārayajūṃṣi hutvā saṃveśāyopaveśāyānuṣṭubho'bhibhūtyai svāheti purastādanūvandhyāyā vapāyā juhuyāt | uttarāṇi catvāri saṃbhārayajūṃṣi hutvā saṃveśāyopaveśāya paṅktyā abhibhūtyai svāheti purastādudavasānīyāyā juhuyāt | samiddhe'gnau hūyante prāṇāpānau mṛtyormā pātaṃ prāṇāpānau mā mā hāsiṣṭamiti dve āhutī || 17|| purastātpāśukātsviṣṭakṛto juhotyetivatīḥ pratipado bhavanti | pretivantyājyāni || 18 || marutvatīḥ pūṣaṇvatīrvā pratipado bhavanti ||19|| yadyagniṣṭomaḥ somaḥ parastātsyādukthyaṃ kurvīta | yadyukthyaḥ ṣoḍaśinam | yadi ṣoḍaśyatirātram | yadyatirātro'ptoryāmama | yadyaptoryāmo dvirātrama | yadi dvirātrastrirātram | yadi trirātra ekastotrameva || 15.5.20 || abhijitkāryo'bhijityai | viśvajitkāryo viśvasya jityai | sarvastomaḥ sarvapṛṣṭhaḥ sarvasyā''ptyai sarvasyāvaruddhyai | krośānukrośe kārye vasiṣṭhasya nihave ubhe bṛhadrathaṃtare kārye | sajanīyaṃ śasyaṃ vihavyaṃ śasyamagastyasya kayā śubhīyaṃ śasyamindrasya niṣkevalyaṃ tāni śaṃsedabhivarta brahmasāma kuryāt | abhijitaṃ viśvajitaṃ vā yajñakratuṃ kuryāditi saṃpreṣyati || 21 || pūrvavatsaṃsthāpyaḥ | abhiṣutyaṃ vā dakṣiṇābhirvā varṣīyāṃsaṃ yajñakratuṃ kuryuḥ || 22 || yāvadrathānhya(dhvama)ntarā giriṃ bhidvā (ttvā) nadī tāvatā saṃsavaḥ samānajanapade saṃsavo nānājanapade saṃsavo nāvidviṣāṇayoḥ saṃsavo vidyata ityekeṣām || (kha019) || 23 || yadi dīkṣitānāmupratāpaḥ syānmahānāgnīdhrīyamupasamādhāya brāhmaṇaṃ dakṣiṇato niṣādyaikaviṃśatiyavāndarbhapuñjīlāṃśca pūrṇapātre'vadhāya brāhmaṇāya procyāpaḥ paribrūyāt-jīvā nāma stha tā imamamuṃ jīvayata jīvikā nāma stha tā imamamuṃ jīvayata saṃjīvā nāma stha tā imamamuṃ saṃjīvayateti pratibrūyāt || 24|| yā jātā oṣadhaya ityoṣadhisūktenaitābhiradbhirabhiṣiñcet || 25 || pāyayatyetāsāmapāṃ prāṇāpānau ta upāṃśvantaryāmau pātāmasau vyānaṃ va upāṃśu savanaḥ pātu vācaṃ ma aindravāyavaḥ pātu dakṣakratū te maitrāvaruṇaḥ pātu cakṣuṣī te śukrāmanthinau pātāṃ śrotraṃ ta āśvinaḥ pātvātmānaṃ ta āgrayaṇaḥ pātvaṅgāni ma ukthyaḥ pātvāyuṣṭe dhruvaḥ pātu vīryaṃ te'tigrāhyāḥ pāntvasāvityabhimṛśati || 26 || pratijapati prāṇāpānau ma upāṃśvantaryāmau pātāṃ vyānaṃ me upāṃśu savanaḥ pātu vācaṃ ma aindravāyavaḥ pātu dakṣakratū me maitrāvaruṇaḥ pātu cakṣuṣī me śukrāmanthinau pātāṃ śrotraṃ ma āśvinaḥ pātvātmānaṃ ma āgrayaṇaḥ pātvaṅgāni ma ukthyaḥ pātu vāyurme dhruvaḥ pātu vīryaṃ me'tigrāhyāḥ pāntviti pratijapite puṣṭipatau puṣṭiṃ prāṇai prāṇamapāne'pānaṃ vyāne vyānamudāna udānaṃ samāne samānaṃ vāci vācamasmai punardhehītyāhutiṃ juhoti || 27 || na punarbheṣajaṃ karoti || 28 || yadi mriyeta prāgavabhṛthādagnyavabhṛthaṃ kuryuḥ || 29 || avabhṛthaṃ vā gamayitvodāhṛtyāvabhṛthādagnibhirabhisamāhāraṃ daheyuḥ || 15.5.30 || etāvadekāhe || 31 || ahargaṇe tvāhara dahetyuktvā dakṣiṇāgneraṅgāraṃ nirvartya nirmanthyena vā daheyuḥ || 32 || dakṣiṇasyāṃ vediśroṇyāmasthikumbhaṃ nidadhāti || 33 || tisṛbhiḥ sārparājñībhirabhipratihṛtābhirudgātāraḥ stuvīran || 34 || itara ṛtvijo hotṛprathamāḥ prācīnāvītino yāmīranubruvantaḥ sārparājñīnāṃ kīrtayanto dakṣiṇānkeśapakṣānudgrathya savyānprasrasya dakṣiṇānūrūnāghnānāḥ savyānityekeṣām || 35|| triḥ prasavyaṃ mārjālīyamanuparīyuḥ || 36|| aindravāyavāgrā grahā maitrāvaruṇāgrā vā mārjālīyanyante bhakṣānupaninīyuḥ||37|| agna āyūṃṣi pavasa iti pratipadaṃ kurvīran || 38 || etāvadanāthe nāthavatastu dagdhvā'sthīnyupanahya yastasya svo nediṣṭhī syāttaṃ tasya sthāne dīkṣayitvā tena saha yajeran || 39 || saṃvatsare'sthīni yājayeyuḥ| agniṣṭomaḥ somo rathaṃtaraṃ gauravītaṃ vā sāma saptadaśaḥ stotro vyākhyāte grahāgre stotre'sthikumbhamupanidadhāti ||15.5.40 || yāmena sāmnā stuvate | dvādaśaśataṃ dakṣiṇā || (kha020) ||41|| iti satyāṣāḍhahiraṇyakeśisūtre pañcadaśapraśne pañcamaḥ paṭalaḥ|| 15.6 atha pañcadaśapraśne ṣaṣṭhaḥ paṭalaḥ | yadi satrāya dīkṣetāthāsya sāmyutthānaṃ jāyeta | somamaya(vi)bhajya viśvajitā'tirātreṇa sarvastomena sarvapṛṣṭhena sarvavedasadakṣiṇena yajeta ||1|| kṛtāntātkarmāṇi pratipadyate || 2 || avalikhyokhāyāstairanyāṃ mṛdaṃ saṃskṛtya kuryāt || 3|| avalikhya paśuśirasāṃ tūṣṇīkeṣvāśleṣayet || 4 || praṇīta āhavanīye tūṣṇīmagniṃ harati || 5|| saṃcite'gnāvuttiṣṭhato na sāmyutthāne'gnicayanaṃ vidyate || 6|| prācīnamudīcīnaṃ vodavasāya vihāraṃ sādhayitvā sarvapṛṣṭyā (ṣṭhayā) yajeta | sarvakratubhya āgūryāśakyamāne yaṣṭum | traidhātavīyayā satre tu viśvajitāti'rātreṇa || 7|| yadi sunvatāmāhavanīyo'nugacchedāgnīdhrātpraṇayeyurenaṃ yadyāgnīdhro gārhapatyādyadi gārhapatyo mantheyurenam || 8 || yasmāddārorudvāyettasyāraṇī kuryāt || 9|| kramuko bhavati || 15.6.10 || brahmaṇa udgātre hotre'dhvaryave ca caturo varāndadyāt || 11 || yadyakītaṃ somamapahareyuranyaḥ kreyaḥ || 12 || yadi krītaṃ yo nediṣṭhī syāttata āhṛtyābhiṣuṇuyāt || 13 || somāhārāya somavikrayiṇe vā kiṃciddadyāt || 14 || yadi taṃ na vindeyuḥ pūtīkānabhiṣuṇuyāt | yadi na pūtīkānatha phālgunāni | yadi na phālgunānyathārjunānyathā''dārān | yadi nā''dārānyā eva kāścā''rdrā oṣadhīrāhṛtyābhiṣuṇuyāt || (kha021) || 15 || pratidhukprātaḥsavane pūtīkāṃśca | dadhiṃ ca mādhyaṃdine savane pūtīkāṃśca | śṛtaṃ ca tṛtīyasavane pūtīkāṃśca || 16 || apivā pratidhuṣā prātaḥsavane sarvānsomācchrīṇāti | śṛtena mādhyaṃdine savane dadhnā tṛtīya savane nītamiśreṇa || 17 || agniṣṭomaḥ somaḥ syādrathaṃtarasāmā || 18 || ekāṃ gāṃ dakṣiṇāṃ dadyāttebhya eva||19|| purā dvādaśyāḥ saṃvatsare vā | tasmā eva kratave punardīkṣeta | tatra taddadyātpūrvasmindāsyantsyāt ta evainamṛtvijo yājayeyuḥ || 15.6.20 || atha yadi sadohavirdhānānyabhidahyerangrahānadhvaryuḥ spāśayet | stotrāṇyudgātā | śastrāṇi hotā|||21|| anabhidagdhe some kṛtāntātkarmaṇi pratipadyeran || 22 || kriyerannāvṛtā vetyāśvalāyanaḥ | kṛtāntāditi yāvatkarma kṛtaṃ tataḥ paraṃ tantramityarthaḥ | prāgvaṃśādimaṇḍapadāhe tu na devayajanāntaraṃ gamyate || 22 || dagdhe tatprāyaścittaṃ yadapahṛte || 23 || paścātra gā dakṣiṇā dadāti | pañca varānityekeṣām || 24 || yadi grāvā dīryeta dyutānasya mārutasya sāmnā stuvīran | brahmasāmnetyekeṣām || 25 || yadi prātaḥsavane kalaśo dīryeta vaiṣṇavīṣu śipiviṣṭavatīṣu stuvīran || 26|| yadi mādhyaṃdine dīryeta vaṣaṭkāranidhanaṃ sāma kuryuḥ | yadi tṛtīyasavana etadeva || 27|| yadi kalaśo dīryeta vaṣaṭkāranidhanaṃ brahmasāma kuryurityekeṣām| sarveṣāmanavayavena śrūyate||(kha022)|| || 28 || asave svāhā vasave svāhā vibhuve svāhā vivasvate svāhā gaṇaśriyai svāhā malimlucāya svāhā śūṣāya svāheti saptā''hutīrhutvendrasya graho'sya gṛhīto grāhyo devānāṃ pūrasi taṃ tvā prapadye saha grahaiḥ saha paśubhiḥ sahartvigbhiḥ saha saumyaiḥ saha sadasyaiḥ saha dākṣiṇeyaiḥ saha dakṣiṇābhiḥ saha yajñena saha yajñapatinā praviśāni saha yanme asti tenetyabhimantrya || 29 || saṃveśāya tvopaveśāya tvetyanusavanaṃ dīrṇe juhoti || 15.6.30|| yadi sarvaiḥ paryāyairastutamabhivyuccheta ṣaḍbhirhotre stuyuḥ| tisṛbhistisṛbhiritarebhyaḥ || 31 || yadi dvābhyāṃ paryāyābhyāmastutamabhivyuccheddhotre maitrāvaruṇāya cānyatarasya stuyuḥ | brāhmaṇācchaṃsine'cchāvākāya cānyatarasya || 32 || yadyekena pañcadaśabhirhotre stuyuḥ | tisṛbhistisṛbhiritarebhyaḥ || 33|| agne vivasvaduṣasa ityāśvinasya pratipadaṃ kurvīran || 34 || yasyā''śvine śasyamāne sūryo nodiyāt| sarvā api dāśatayyaḥ śaṃset | sauryaṃ paśuṃ bahurūpamapākuryāt | yasyā''śvine śasyamāne sūryo nā''virbhavatīti vijñāyate || 35 || yadi samanvārabdhānāṃ sarpatāmudgātā'pacchidyeta | yajñena yajamāno vyṛdhyetādakṣiṇaḥ sa yajñakratuḥ saṃsthāpyo'thānya āhṛtyaḥ || 36 || tatra taddadyādyatpūrvasmindāsyansyāt || 37|| ta evainamṛtvijo yājayeyuḥ| atha yadi prastotā'pacchidyeta yajñasya śiro'pacchidyeta brahmaṇe varaṃ dattvā || 38 || sa eva punarvartavyaḥ || 39 || atha yadi pratihartā'pacchidyeta paśubhiryajamāno vyṛdhyeta | punaryajñe sarvavedasaṃ dadyāt || 15.6.40 || yugapadapacchinnayorudgātuḥ prāyaścittāṃ kuryāt | pratihartuḥ sarvaprāyaścittaṃ juhuyāt || 41 || pūrvāparāpacchede yo jaghanyaḥ sarvaprāyaścittaṃ kuryāt || 42 || yadyudgātā jaghanyo'pacchidyeta punaryajñe sarvavedasaṃ dadyāt || 43 || yadyārbhave bandhuruta vā'nyabandhuḥ | mā no duścakṣā aghaśaṃsa īśatāhuto'yaṃ yajñamapyetu devā iti hutāhutau somau bhakṣayati || 19 || mā yajamānaṃ tamo'vidanmartvijo mā imāḥ prajāḥI mā yaḥ somamimaṃ pibātsaṃ barhīṃṣyanyemaṃ yajñaṃ viśve avantu devāḥ || payasvatīroṣadhaya ityetābhiḥ pṛṣadājyaṃ skannamabhimantryāpo'bhyavahṛtya pātraṃ nirṇijya punarniṣṭapya nidadhāti | tasmin hiraṇyaṃ agniṣṭatsarvaṃ śundhatu havyavāḍghṛtasūdana iti śaṃkunyavamṛṣṭaṃ tasyaitadeva prāyaścittaṃ nirlikhyate'tra pātram || 24|| yadavālikṣacchvapānmukhena nirṛte tava | aniṣṭatsarvaṃ śundhatu prajābhyaḥ sarvābhyo mṛḍa namo rudrāya mīḍhuṣa iti dvitīyāṃ vepamāne ||1|| yasmādbhīṣā nyaṣada iti dvitīyāṃ niṣaṇṇe || 2|| udusra tiṣṭha pratitiṣṭha mā riṣo memaṃ yajñaṃ yajamānaṃ ca rīriṣaḥ | suvarge yasmādbhīṣā'palāyiṣṭhā iti dvitīyāṃ palāyite'nāgacchatyanyaṃ tadrūpaṃ tadvarṇaṃ tadvayasaṃ tajjātīyaṃ taddaivatamupākṛtya tena saṃsthāpayet || 6|| tajjātīye'vidyamāne ajā avayo gāva ityanyonyasya pratinidhayo bhavanti || 7 || teṣvavidyamāneṣvājyena śeṣaṃ saṃsthāpayet ||8|| yasmādbhīṣā samajñāsthā iti dvitīyāmakāmasaṃjñapane ||9|| ya idamakastasmai svāheti sarvottamāṃ juhoti || 15.8.10 || na vā u vetanmriyase | āśānāṃ tvā viśvā āśāḥ | āpo hi ṣṭhā mayobhuva iti catasṛbhiḥ paśuṃ vyāpannamabhimantryāpo'bhyavahṛtyānyaṃ tadrūpaṃ tadvarṇaṃ tadvayasaṃ tajjātīyaṃ taddaivatamupākṛtya tena hṛdayaṃ te astu mama cittaṃ cittenānvehi mama vācamekamanā juṣasva bṛhaspatistvā niyunaktu mahyaṃ māmevānusaṃrabhasva mayi cittāni santu te mayi sāmīcyamastu te mahyaṃ vācaṃ niyacchatāditi || 9|| aśvināvubhāvādhattāṃ puṣkarasrajāviti tasya mukhena mukhaṃ saṃnidhāya japati 16 || athainaṃ paridadāti kaṣakāya tvā paridadāmyantakāya tvā paridadāmyaghorāya tvā paridadāmi gadāya tvā paridadāmi || āharantyasmai sarvasurabhi candanaṃ vā piṣṭaṃ tadabhyukṣya namo grahāya cābhigrahāya ca namaḥ śākajañjabhābhyāṃ namastābhyo devatābhyo yā abhigrāhiṇīriti devebhyaḥ prācīnamañjaliṃ kṛtvā
