mā kuru deveṣu priyaṃ mā brahmaṇi kuru | priyaṃ viśyeṣu śūdreṣu priyaṃ mā kuru rājasu svāhā| iyamoṣadhe trāyamāṇā sahamānā sahasvatī | sā mā hiraṇyavarcasaṃ karotu puruṣu priyaṃ brahmavarcasinaṃ mā karotu svāhetyetaireva pañcabhirasvāhākāraistriḥ pradakṣiṇamudapātre'nupariplāvya || (kha010) ||26|| virājaṃ ca svarājaṃ cābhiṣṭīryā ca no gṛhe | lakṣmī rāṣṭrasya yā mukhe tayā mā saṃsṛjāmasīti kuṇḍale pratiharate | dakṣiṇe karṇe dakṣiṇaṃ savye savyam || 27|| ṛtubhiṣṭvārtavairāyuṣe varcase saṃvatsarasya dhāyasā tena sannanugṛhṇāsīti kuṇḍale saṃgṛhṇīte || 28 || iyamoṣadhe trāyamāṇā sahamānā sahasvatī | sā mā hiraṇyavarcasaṃ karotu puruṣu priyaṃ brahmavarcasinaṃ mā karotvapāśo'sīti grīvāyāṃ maṇiṃ pratimuñcate || 29 || śubhike śubhamāroha śobhayantī mukhaṃ mama | mukhaṃ ca mama śobhaya bhūyāṃsaṃ ca bhagaṃ kuru | yāmāharajjamadagniḥ śraddhāyai kāmāyāsyai | imāṃ tāṃ pratimuñce'haṃ bhagena saha varcaseti dvābhyāṃ srajaṃ pratimuñcate || 19.3.30 || yadāñjanaṃ traikakudaṃ jātaṃ himavata upari | tena vāmāñje'haṃ bhagena saha varcasā mayi parvatapūruṣamiti traikakudenāñjanenāṅkte tasminnavidyamāne yenaiva kenacit || 31 || yanme manaḥ parāgatamityādarśe'vekṣate || 32 || devasya tveti vaiṇavaṃ daṇḍaṃ pratigṛhyendrasya vajro'syaśvinau mā pātamiti trirūrdhvamunmārṣṭi || 33|| vegavejayāsmaddviṣatastaskarānsarīsṛpāñchvāpadānrakṣāṃsi piśācānpauruṣeyādbhayānno daṇḍaṃ rakṣa viśvasmādbhayādrakṣa sarvato jahi taskarānanagnaḥ sarvavṛkṣeṣu jāyase tvaṃ sapatnahā | jahi śatrugaṇānsarvānsamantaṃ maghavāniveti triḥ pradakṣiṇamuparyupari śiraḥ pratiharate || 34 || pratiṣṭhe stho devate mā mā saṃtāptamityupānahāvadhyavarohati || 35 || prajāpateḥ śaraṇamasi brahmaṇaśchadiriti cchatraṃ pratigṛhṇāti || 36|| yo me daṇḍaḥ parāpatadvihāyaso'dhibhūmyām | imaṃ taṃ punarādade yamāyuṣe ca balāya ceti daṇḍaṃ punarādatte yadyasya hastātpatati || (kha011) || 37|| iti satyāṣāḍhahiraṇyakeśigṛhyasūtra ekonaviṃśapraśne tṛtīyaḥ paṭalaḥ| 19.4 athaikonaviṃśapraśne caturthaḥ paṭalaḥ | ānayantyasmai rathamaśvaṃ hastinaṃ vā || 1|| rathaṃtaramasi vāmadevyamasi bṛhadasyaṅkau nyaṅkāvabhita ityeṣā | ayaṃ vāmaśvinā ratho mā duḥkhe mā sukhe riṣat | ariṣṭaḥ svasti gacchatu vivighnannabhidāsataḥ | iha dhṛtiriha vidhṛtiriha rama iha ramatāmiti rathamātiṣṭhate | yadi rathena praviśati|| 2|| aśvo'si hayo'si mayo'sītyekādaśabhiraśvanāmabhiraśvaṃ yadyaśvena ||3|| indrasya tvāvajreṇābhyupaviśāmi vaha kālaṃ vaha śriyaṃ mā'bhivaha hastyasi hastiyaśasamasi hastivarcasamasi hastiyaśasi(sī) hastivarcasī bhūyāsamiti hastinaṃ yadi tena tadgacchati yatrāsmā apacitiṃ kariṣyanto bhavanti || 4 || saṃsravantu diśo mayi samāgacchantu sūnṛtāḥ| sarve kāmā abhiyantu naḥ priyā abhisravantu naḥ priyā iti diśa upatiṣṭhate || 5 || yaśo'si yaśo'haṃ tvayi bhūyāsamiti yo'syāpacitiṃ kariṣyanbhavati tamabhyāgacchansamīkṣate || 6|| athāsmā āvasathaṃ kalpayitvā'rgha iti prāha kuruteti pratyāha ||7|| kurvantyasmai trivṛtaṃ pāṅktaṃ vā dadhi madhu ghṛtamiti trivṛddadhi madhu ghṛtamāpaḥ saktava iti pāṅktaḥ kaṃse dadhyānīya madhvānayati ||8|| hrasīyasyānīya varṣīyasā'pidhāyānūcīnāni pṛthagādāpayati kūrcaṃ pādyamarghyamācamanīyaṃ madhuparka iti ||9|| anvaṅṅanusaṃvrajitā so'nupakiṃcayā vācaikaikaṃ prāha kūrca iti kūrcam || 19.4.10 || tasminprāṅmukha upaviśati rāṣṭrabhṛdasyācāryāsandī mā tvadyoṣamiti || 11 || athāsmai pādyamiti prāha || 12 || tenāsya śūdraḥ śūdrā vā pādau prakṣālayati savyamagre brāhmaṇasya dakṣiṇamitarayoḥ|| (kha0 12)|| 13 || virājo doho'si mayi dohaḥ padyāyai virāja iti yo'sya pādau prakṣālayati tasya hastāvabhimṛśya || 14|| ātmānaṃ pratyabhimṛśati mayi teja indriyaṃ vīryamāyuḥ kīrtirvarco yaśo balamiti || 15 || athāsmā arghyamiti prāha || 16|| tatpratigṛhṇātyā mā gan yaśasā saṃsṛja tejasāvarcasā payasā ca | taṃ mā kuru priyaṃ prajānāmadhipatiṃ paśūnāmiti || 17|| samudraṃ vaḥ prahiṇomyakṣitāḥ svāṃ yonimapigacchata | acchidraḥ prajayā bhūyāsaṃ mā parā secimatpaya iti śeṣaṃ ninīyamānamanumantrayate || 18|| āthāsmā ācamanīyamiti prāha || 19 || amṛtopastaraṇamasītyapa ācāmati || 19.4.20 || athāsmai madhuparka iti prāha || 21 || taṃ sāvitreṇobhābhyāṃ hastābhyāṃ pratigṛhya pṛthivyāstvā nābhau sādayāmīḍāyāḥ pada iti pṛthivyāṃ pratiṣṭhāpya yanmadhuno madhavyaṃ paramamannādyaṃ rūpam | tenāhaṃ madhuno madhavyena parameṇa rūpeṇa paramamadhavyo'nnādo bhūyāsamityaṅguṣṭhenopamadhyamayā cāṅgulyā triḥ pradakṣiṇaṃ saṃyujya tejase tvā śriyai yaśase balāyānnādyāya prāśnāmīti triḥ prāśya yo'sya rātirbhavati tasmā ucchiṣṭaṃ prayacchati || 22 || sarvaṃ vā prāśyāmṛtāpidhānamasītyapa ācāmati || 23 || athāsmai gauriti prāha || 24 || tasyāḥ karmotsargo vā || 25 || gaurdhenurbhavyā mātā rudrāṇāṃ duhitā vasūnāṃ svasā''dityānāmamṛtasya nābhiḥ | pra ṇu vocaṃ cikituṣe janāya mā gāmanāgāmaditiṃ vadhiṣṭa | pibatūdakaṃ tṛṇānyattu | omutsṛjatetyutsarge saṃśāsti || 26 || gaurasyapahatapāpmā'papāpmānaṃ jahi | mama cāmuṣya ca hataṃ me dviṣantaṃ hato me dviṣankuruteti kriyamāṇāyām || 27 || utsarge'nyena māṃsenānnaṃ saṃskṛtyāthāsmai bhūtamiti prāha tatsubhūtaṃ virāḍannaṃ tanmā kṣayi tanme'śīya tanma ūrjaṃ dhāstatsubhūtamityuktvā'thā''ha brāhmaṇānbhojayateti || 28 || teṣvasmai bhuktavatsvanusaṃvṛjinamannamāhārayati ||29|| tatpratigṛhṇāti dyauste dadātu pṛthivī pratigṛhṇātu pṛthivī te dadātu prāṇaḥ pratigṛhṇātu | prāṇastvā'śnātu prāṇaḥ pibatviti || 19.4.30|| indrāgnī me varcaḥ kṛṇutāmiti yāvatkāmaṃ prāśya yo'sya rātirbhavati tasmā ucchiṣṭaṃ prayacchati || 31 || yaṃ kāmayeta na vicchidyateti yasminbhūtaṃ ca bhavyaṃ ca sarve lokā iha śritāḥ | tena tvā'haṃ pratigṛhṇāmi tvāmahaṃ brahmaṇā tvā mahyaṃ pratigṛhṇāmyasāvityācamya || (kha0 13 ) || 32 || bhuktavato dakṣiṇaṃ hastaṃ gṛhṇīyāt || 33 || yamamātyamantevāsinaṃ preṣyaṃ vā kāmayeta dhruvo me'napāyī syāditi sa pūrvāhṇe snātaḥ prayatavastro'haḥkṣānto brāhmaṇasaṃbhāṣo . niśāyāṃ tasyā''vasathaṃ gatvā jīvaśṛṅge prasrāvya triḥ pradakṣiṇamāvasathaṃ pariṣiñcanparikrāmetpari tvā girerahamidaṃ paribhrātuḥ pariṣvasuḥ | pari sarvebhyo jñātibhyaḥ pariṣīdaḥ kleṣyasi | śaśvatparikupilena saṃkrāmeṇāvicchidā ūlena parimīḍho'si parimīḍho'syūleneti || 34 || anigupte jīvaśṛṅgaṃ vidadhāti || 35 || yasmā amātyā antevāsinaḥ preṣyā voddraveyustānparikrośedanupauhvadanupahvayennivarto yo nyavīvṛdhaḥ | aindro vaḥ parikrośaḥ parikrośatu sarvadā | yaditi māmiti manyāyadhvaṃ māyā devā avattaram | indraḥ pāśo navaḥ siktvā mahyaṃ punarudājatviti || 36 || yo'tha svāgāraṃ praviśya saidhrakīṃ samidhamādhāyā''vartana vartayetyākarṣaṇena juhoti ||(kha014) ||37|| athāto dāraguptiṃ sthūrādṛḍhācūrṇāni kārayitvā jārī suptāyai yonimupavapedindrāya yāsyaśephamalikamanyebhyaḥ puruṣebhyo'nyatra maditi || 38 || athātaḥ paṇyasiddhiḥ || 39|| paṇyasyāpādāya juhoti yadvo devāḥ prapaṇaṃ carāma devā dhanena dhanamicchamānāḥ | tasminsomo rucamādadhātvagnirindro bṛhaspatirīśānaśca svāheti ||19.4.40|| athātaḥ krodhavinayanam || 41 || yā ta eṣā rarāṭyā tanūrmanyormṛdvasya nāśinī| tāṃ devā brahmacāriṇo vinayantu sumedhasaḥ | yata etanmukhe mataṃ rarāṭamudiva vidhyasi | ava dyāmiva dhanvino hṛdo manyuṃ tanomi te | ahardyauśca pṛthivī ca vidhe krodhaṃ nayāmasi | garbhamaśvataryā iveti kruddhamabhimantrayate || 42 || athātaḥ saṃvādābhijayanam ||43|| niśāyāmantarāgāreṣvagnimupasamādhāya vyāhṛtiparyantaṃ kṛtvā kaṇairājyamiśrairjuhoti | ava jihva nijihvikāva tvā haviṣā yaje | yathā'hamuttaro vadāmyadharovada sauvada svāheti || 44 || athainaṃ saṃnidhāvabhijapati ā te vācamāsyādade manasyāṃ hṛdayādadhi | aṅgādaṅgātte vācamādade yatra yatra nihitā vāktāṃ ta ādade | rudranīlaśikhaṇḍavīrakarmaṇi karmaṇīmaṃ me pratisaṃvādinaṃ vṛkṣamivāśaninā jahi | adhovadādharovadādhastādbhūmyāvada | adhopratiriva kūṭena nijasya nihito mayā | tatsatyaṃ yadahaṃ bravīmyadharo matpadyasvāsāviti ||45|| hiraṇyabāhuḥ subhagā jitākṣyalaṃkṛtā madhye devānāmāsīnā'rthaṃ mahyamavocatsvāheti sabhāmālabhya japati || 46|| mama pare mamāpare mameyaṃ pṛthivī mahī | mamāgniścendraśca divyamarthamasādhayanniveti pariṣadamabhivīkṣate'bhyeva japati || ( kha0 15)||47|| iti satyāṣāḍhahiraṇyakeśigṛhyasūtra ekonaviṃśapraśne caturthaḥ paṭalaḥ | 19.5 athaikonaviṃśapraśne pañcamaḥ paṭalaḥ | darśe candramasaṃ dṛṣṭvā'pa ācamyāpo dhārayamāṇa āpyāyasva saṃ te navo navo bhavati jāyamāno yamādityā aṃśumāpyāyayantīti catasṛbhirupatiṣṭhate || 1|| mayi dakṣakratū iti jañjabhyamāno japati ||2|| sigasinasi vajro namaste astu mā mā hiṃsī'riti sicā'dhikṣipto japati || 3|| tasya tantumācchidya mukhavātena pradhvaṃsayet || 4|| ye pakṣiṇaḥ patayanti bibhyato nirṛtaiḥ saha | te mā śivena śamena tejasondantu varcaseti vayasā'dhikṣipto japati ||5|| tadanyena hastātpramṛjyādbhiḥ prakṣālayīta divo nu mā bṛhato antarikṣādapāṃ stoko abhyapatacchivāya | samindriyeṇa manasā'hamāgāṃ brahmaṇā guptaḥ sukṛtā kṛteneti japedyadyenamavijñāto'pāṃ stoko'bhicchādayet || 6|| yad vṛkṣāgrādabhyapatatphalaṃ yadvā'ntarikṣāttadu vāyureva | yatrā vṛkṣastanu vai yatra vāsa āpo bādhatāṃ nirṛtiṃ parācairiti japedyadyenamavijñātaṃ phalamabhipatet || 7 || namaḥ pathiṣade vāteṣave rudrāya namo rudrāya pathiṣada iti catuṣpathamavakramya japati || 8|| namaḥ paśuṣade vāteṣave rudrāya namo rudrāya paśuṣada iti śakṛddhatau || 9|| namaḥ sarpasṛte vāteṣave rudrāya namo rudrāyeti sarpasṛte || 19.5.10 || namo'ntarikṣasade vāteṣave rudrāya namo rudrāyāntarikṣasada iti || 11 || yadyenaṃ saṃvartavāta āgacchet | namo'psuṣade vāteṣave rudrāya namo rudrāyāpsuṣada iti || 12 || nadīmudanvatīmavagāhya japati namastatsade vāteṣave rudrāya namo rudrāya tatsada iti || 13 || citraṃ deśaṃ devayajanaṃ vanaspatiṃ vā''kramya japati || 14 || sūryābhyudito'hani nāśnīyādvāgyato'hastiṣṭhet || 15 || sūryābhinimrukto rātrāvevam || 16 || na yūpamupaspṛśedyadyupaspṛśedduriṣṭaṃ yajñasya pratimuñcīta yadyekamupaspṛśedeṣa te vāyo iti brūyādyadi dvāvetau tau vāyū iti yadi bahūnete te vāyava iti || 17 || anihūtaṃ parihūtaṃ pariṣṭutaṃ śakunairuditaṃ ca yat | mṛgasya śatamakṣṇayā tadviparaṣadbhyo bhayāmasītyadhvānamabhipravrajañjapati || 18 || udgāteva śakune sāma gāyasi brahmaputra iva savaneṣu śaṃsasi | svasti naḥ śakune astu śivo naḥ sumanā bhavetyanabhipretaṃ śakunaṃ prati japati || 19|| yadetadbhūtānyanvāviśya daivīṃ vācaṃ vadasi | dviṣato naḥ parā vadatānmṛtyo mṛtyave nayetyekasṛkam || 19.5.20 || athāsmā ubhayata ādīptamulmukaṃ tāṃ diśaṃ prati nirasyati | agne agninā saṃvadasva mṛtyo mṛtyunā saṃvadasvetyapa upaspṛśya || 21 || athainamupatiṣṭhate vibhūrasi pravāhaṇa ityetenānuvākena || (kha016) || 22 || yadīṣito yadi vā svakāmī bhayeḍako vadati vācametām | tāmindrāgnī brahmaṇā saṃvidānau śivāmasmabhyaṃ kṛṇutaṃ gṛheṣviti sālāvṛkīm||23|| prasārya sakthau patasi savyamakṣi nipeṣi ca | meha kasya ca nāma maditiśakunim || 24 || hiraṇyapakṣaḥ śakunirdevānāṃ vasatiṃgamaḥ | grāmaṃ pradakṣiṇaṃ kṛtvā svasti no vada kauśiketi piṅgalām || 25|| punarmāmaitvindriyaṃ punarāyuḥ punarbhagaḥ | punarbrāhmaṇa maitu mā punardraviṇamaitu meti | athaite dhiṣṇiyāso agnayo yathāsthānaṃ kalpantāmihaiva svāhā | punarma ātmā punarāyurāgātpunaḥ prāṇaḥ punarākūtamāgāt | vaiśvānaro raśmiābhirvāvṛdhāno'ntastiṣṭhatu me mano'mṛtasya ketuḥ svāhā | yadannamadyate sāyaṃ na tatprātaravati kṣudhaḥ | sarvaṃ tadasmānmā hiṃsīrnahi taddadṛśe divā svāhetyanabhipretaṃ svapnaṃ dṛṣṭvā tilairājyamiśrairjuhoti || 26|| athaitānyadbhutaprāyaścittāni bhavanti kuptvā kapota upāvikṣanmadhvagāra upāvikṣadgaurgāmadhaiṣītsthūṇā vyaraukṣīdvalmīka udaikṣīdityevaṃrūpāṇi || 27 || sa pūrvāhṇe snātaḥ prayatavastro'haḥkṣānto brāhmaṇasaṃbhāṣo'ntarāgāre'gnimupasamādhāya vyāhṛtiparyantaṃ kṛtvā juhotīmaṃ me varuṇa tattvā yāmi tvaṃ no agne sa tvaṃ no agne tvamagne ayāsi prajāpate yadasya karmaṇo'tyarīricamiti cātraike jayābhyātānānrāṣṭrabhṛta ityupajuhvati yathāpurastādbrāhmaṇānannena pariviṣya puṇyāhaṃ svastyayanamiti vācayitvā || (kha0 17||)|| 28 || indrāgnī vaḥ prasthāpayatāmaśvināvabhirakṣatām | bṛhaspatirvo gopālaḥ pūṣā vaḥ punarudājatviti gāḥ pratiṣṭhamānā anumantrayate | pūṣā gā anvetu na iti ca || 29|| imā yā gāva āgamannayakṣmā bahusūvarīḥ | nadya iva sravantu samudra iva niṣiñcantviti gā āyatīḥ pratīkṣate || 19.5.30 || saṃsthāḥ stha saṃsthā vo bhūyāsthācyutāḥ stha mā mā cyoḍhvaṃ mā'haṃ bhagavatībhyaścyauṣīriti saṃsthitāḥ||31|| ūrjā vaḥ paśyāmyūrjā mā paśyateti goṣṭhagatāḥ sahasrapoṣaṃ vaḥ puṣyāsamiti ca || 32 || ato gavāṃ madhye'gnimupasamādhāya vyāhṛtiparyantaṃ kṛtvā payasā juhotyuddīpyasva jātavedopaghnaṃ nirṛtiṃ mama | paśūṃśca mahyamāvaha jīvanaṃ ca diśo diśa svāhā | mā no hiṃsījjātavedo gāmaśvaṃ puruṣaṃ jagat | abibhradagna āgahi śriyā mā paripātaya svāhā | apāmidaṃ nyayanaṃ namaste harase śociṣa iti ca || 33 || imaṃ me varuṇa tattvā yāmi tvaṃ no agne sa tvaṃ no agne tvamagne ayāsi prajāpate yadasya karmaṇo'tyarīricamiti cātraike jayābhyātānānrāṣṭrabhṛta ityupajuhvati yathāpurastāt || (kha0 18 ) || 34 || iti satyāṣāḍhahiraṇyakeśigṛhyasūtra ekonaviṃśapraśne pañcamaḥ paṭalaḥ || 19.6 athaikonaviṃśapraśne ṣaṣṭhaḥ paṭalaḥ | samāvṛtta ācāryakulānmātāpitarau bibhṛyāttābhyāmanujñāto bhāryāmupayacchetsajātāṃ nagnikāṃ brahmacāriṇīmasagotrāmahnaḥ pañcasu kāleṣu prātaḥ saṃgave madhyaṃdine'parāhṇe sāyaṃ vaiteṣu yatkārī syātpuṇyāha eva kurute'gnimupasamādhāya paridhiparidhānāntaṃ kṛtvā vadhūmānīyamānāṃ samīkṣate sumaṅgalīriyaṃ vadhūrimāṃ sameta paśyata | saubhāgyamasyai dattvāyāthāstaṃ viparetaneti dakṣiṇataḥ patiṃ bhā(tyurbhā)ryopaviśatyācāntasamanvārabdhāyāṃ pariṣiñcati yathāpurastāt || 1|| vyāhṛtiparyantaṃ kṛtvā juhoti | agniraitu prathamo devatānāṃ sau'syai prajāṃ muñcatu mṛtyupāśāt | tadayaṃ rājā varuṇo'numanyatāṃ yatheyaṃ strī pautramaghaṃ naro'dātsvāhā | imāmagnistrāyatāṃ gārhapatyaḥ prājāmasyai nayatu dīrghamāyuḥ | aśūnyopasthā jīvatāmastu mātā pautramānandamabhiprabudhyatāmiyaṃ svāhā | mā te gṛhe niśi ghoṣa utthādanyatra tvadrudatyaḥ saṃviśantu | mā tvambike śūraavidhiṣṭhā jīva patnī patiloke virāja prajāṃ paśyantī sumanasyamānāṃ svāhā | dyauste pṛṣṭhaṃ rakṣatu vāyurūrū aśvinau ca stanaṃ dhayataste putrānsavitā'bhirakṣu | āvāsasaḥ paridhānādbṛhaspatirviśve devā abhirakṣantu paścātsvāhā| aprajastāṃ pautramṛtyuṃ pāpmānamuta vā'gham | śīrṣṇaḥ srajamivonmucya dviṣadbhyaḥ pratimuñcāmi pāpaṃ svāhā | devakṛtaṃ brāhmaṇaṃ kalpamānaṃ tena hanmi yoniṣadaḥ piśācān | kravyādo mṛtyūnadharānpādayāmi dīrghamāyustava jīvantu putrāḥ svāhā || 2 || imaṃ me varuṇa tattvā yāmi tvaṃ no tvā viśvasya bhūtasya prajāyāmasyagrataḥ | gṛhṇāmi te suprajāstvāya hastaṃ mayā patyā jaradaṣṭiryathā'sat | bhago aryamā savitā puraṃdhirmahyaṃ tvā'durgārhapatyāya devā iti || 8|| tāmagreṇa hotā madhyato dvirādatte'dhvaryurvā'nyatarallepena cābhighārite vinigṛhṇāti cāṅgulibhiḥ || 52|| vijñāyate ca na prasṛtaṃ hastaṃ dhārayedyatprasṛtaṃ hastaṃ dhārayetprabhraṃśukā asmātpaśavaḥ syuḥ || 53 || abhinigṛhyevā''sītātheḍāmupahvayate || 54 || mukhena saṃmitopahūtaṃ rathaṃtaramityupāṃśūktvopahūtāṃ ho ityata uccairitarat || 55|| yaṃ kāmayetāpaśuḥ syāditi parācīṃ tasyeḍāmupahvayate | yaṃ sviṣṭakṛdityanavānamuttamamanūyājaṃ yajatyamatsate vā samata iti vijñāyate || 62 || sūktā brūhīti saṃpreṣita idaṃ dyāvāpṛthivī bhadramabhūditi sūktavākaṃ pratipadyate | sūktavāke yathoktadevatā bhārgavacyāvanāpnavānaurvajāmadagnyeti jamadagnivadurvavadapnavānavaccyavanavadbhṛguvaditi tryārṣeyamu haike bhārgavaurvajāmadagnyeti jamadagnivadurvavadbhṛguvadityeṣa evāvikṛto jāmālyaitiśāyanavirohitamāṇḍavyāvaṭamaṇḍubaidaretavāhaprācīnayogyānāmathā''rṣṭiṣeṇānāṃ pañcārṣeyo bhārgavacyāvanāpnavānārṣṭiṣeṇānūpetyanūpavadṛṣṭiṣeṇavadapnavānavaccyavanavadbhṛguvaditi | tryārṣeyamu haike bhārgavārṣṭiṣeṇānūpetyanūpavadṛṣṭiṣeṇavadbhṛguvaditi || atha vītahavyā yāskavādhūlamaunamaukarajātavāhāsteṣāṃ tryārṣeyo bhārgavavaitahavyasāvedaseti savedovadvītahavyavadbhṛguvaditi || atha mitrayuvasteṣāmekārṣeyo vādhryaśveti hotā vadhryaśvavadityadhvaryuḥ || 10 || 7 || itīme bhṛgavo vyākhyātāḥ || 8 || athāto'ṅgirasāmayāsyā gautamāsteṣāṃ tryārṣeya āṅgirasāyāsyagautameti gotamavadayāsyavadaṅgirovaditi | athautathyā gautamāsteṣāṃ tryārṣeya āṅgirasautathyagautameti gotamavadutathyavadaṅgirovaditi | athauśijā gautamāsteṣāṃ tryārṣeya āṅgirasauśijakākṣīvateti kakṣīvadvaduśijavadaṅgirovaditi | atha vāmadevā gautamāsteṣāṃ tryārṣeya āṅgirasavāmadevabārhaduktheti bṛhadukthavadvāmadevavadaṅgirovaditi || 9|| atha bharadvājānāṃ tryārṣeya āṅgirasabārhaspatyaḥ bhāradvājeti bharadvājavadbṛhaspativadaṅgirovaditi | eṣa evāvikṛtastuthyāgniveśyorjayānānāṃ sarveṣāṃ ca stambhastambaśabdānām | atharkṣāṇāṃ pañcārṣeya āṅgirasabārhaspatyabhāradvājavāndanamātavacaseti maṃtavacovadvandanavadbharadvājavadbṛhaspativadaṅgirovaditi | tryārṣeyamu haika āṅgirasavāndanamātavacaseti | matavacovadvandanavadaṅgirovaditi | atha dvayāmuṣyāyaṇānāṃ kulānāṃ yathā śauṅgaśaiśirayo rasakātyākṣiletyakṣilavatkatavadaṅgiārovaditi | | || 11 || atha gargāṇāṃ trayārṣeya āṅgirasagārgyaśainyeti śinivadgargavadaṅgirovaditi | bhāradvājamu haike'ṅgirasaḥ sthāne bhāradvājagārgyaśainyeti śinivadgargavadbharadvājavaditi | atha kapīnāṃ tryārṣeya āṅgirasamāhayyavaurukṣayyetyurukṣayyavanmahayyuvadaṅgirovaditi tarasvāṃstilo viduḥ śāluḥ patañjalirbhūyasīrdaṃdvakīrjalandvaḥ | kaperaṣṭavidhāḥ evāvikṛto vāmarathyasumaṅgalabījavāpānām || 12 ||11|| atha viśvāmitrāṇāṃ devarātāścikitakālabavamanutantubabhruyajñavalkaulontyermaribṛhadagnisāṃśityavārakitārakāyaṇaśālāvatāsteṣāṃ tryārṣeyo 13 || atha śaṇḍilānāṃ dvyārṣeyo daivalāsiteti | asitavaddevalavaditi | tryārṣeyamu haike kāśyapadevalāsiteti asitavaddevalavatkaśyapavaditi | dvyārṣeyāstveva nyāyena || 13 || ekārṣeyā vāsiṣṭhā amāvāsyāyāṃ niśi pariśritya nirvapet | kṛṇuṣva pājaḥ prasitimiti pañcadaśa sāmidhenīranvāha nityayā paridadhāti | ayā te agne samidhā vidhemeti yājyānuvākye | pare saṃyājye || 22.2.10 || agnaye rudravate puroḍāśamaṣṭākapālaṃ nirvapedabhicaranniti | śaramayaṃ barhirbaibhītaka idhmo lohitoṣṇīṣā lohitavasanā nivītā ṛtvijaḥ pracaranti | sarvāsvabhicaraṇikāsvevam || 3|| tvamagne rudra iti annavate'nnādāyānnapataya ityetāsāmukṣānnāya vaśānnāya vadmā hīti yājyānuvākye || 15 || agnaye pavamānāyeti trirhaviragna āyūṃṣi pavasa iti yājyānuvākyāḥ || 16|| agnaye putravata iti dvihaviryastvā hṛdā kīriṇā yasmai tvamiti yājyānuvākyāḥ || 17|| agnaye rasavate'jakṣīre carumityetāsāmagne raseneti yājyānuvākyāḥ || 18 || vaiśvānaraṃ dvādaśakapālamiti trihaviḥ patanīyena karmaṇā kṛtenābhiśasyamānasya dvādaśa vaiśvānaryastāsāṃ vaiśvānaro na ūtyetyaṣṭau yājyānuvākyā dve dve tisṛṇāmava te heḍo varuṇeti vāruṇasya dadhikrāvṇo akāriṣamiti dadhikrāvṇaḥ || 19 || udvāsaneṣṭāvāgneyasyāgnirmūrdhā bhuva iti yājyānuvākye || 22.2.20 || vaiśvānaraṃ dvādaśakapālaṃ nirvapenmārutaṃ saptakapālaṃ grāmakāmaḥ || 21 || āhavanīye vaiśvānaramadhiśrayati | gārhapatye mārutam || 22 || alaṃkṛtya vaiśvānaramāsādayati | anūcyamānāsu sāmidhenīṣu māruto maruto yaddhava iti yājyānuvākye ||23|| ādityaṃ caruṃ saṃgrāmamupagrayāsyannityaditirna uruṣyatu mahīmū ṣu mātaramiti yājyānuvākye || 24 || vaiśvānaraṃ dvādaśakapālaṃ nirvapedāyatanaṃ gatveti yatra yuyutsamānā bhavanti || 25 || vaiśvānaraṃ dvādaśakapālaṃ nirvapetsanimeṣyanyayā rajjvottamāṃ gāmajettā bhrātṛvyāya prahiṇuyāditi bhrātṛvyamayīṃ vā'bhidadhyādgoṣṭhe vā nyaset ||4||26|| iti satyāṣāḍhahiraṇyakeśisūtre dvāviṃśapraśne dvitīyaḥ paṭalaḥ | 22.3 atha dvāviṃśapraśne tṛtīyaḥ paṭalaḥ| . aindraṃ caruṃ nirvapetpaśukāma ityetasyānuvākasyeṣṭīnāṃ yājyānuvākyā indraṃ vo viśvatasparītyeṣo'nuvākaḥ || 1|| indrāyānvṛjava ityanvaha māsā iti || 2 || indrāṇyai caruṃ nirvapedyasya senā'saṃśiteva syādadhṛtevetyartho balbajānidhma upasaṃnahya sahedhmenābhyādadhyāduttamā dhāyyā | revatī puronuvākyā bhavati śakvarī yājyā proṣvasmai purorathamiti || 3 || āgnāvaiṣṇavamekādaśakapālaṃ nirvapedabhicarantsarasvatyājyabhāgetyājyahavirityatho bārhaspatyaścaruriti trirhavirdve dve puronuvākye kuryāt | agnāviṣṇū sajoṣasā''gnāviṣṇū ityāgnāvaiṣṇavaṃ syāt | pra ṇo devyā no divaḥ pāvīravī kanyeti sārasvatasya | bṛhaspate juṣasva na iti bārhaspatyasya || 4 || etayaiva yajetābhicaryamāṇa āgnāvaiṣṇavo'yaṃ yajño nopanamedāgnāvaiṣṇavo ghṛte caruścakṣuṣkāmasyāgnāviṣṇū agnāviṣṇū ityeva yājyānuvākye || 5 || maitrāvaruṇamekakapālaṃ nirvapedā no mitrāvaruṇeti maitrāvaruṇasya || 6|| tiṣyāpūrṇamāse somāraudro brahmavarcasakāmasya pariśrite yājayanti | śvetāyai śvetavatsāyai dugdhaṃ mathitamājyaṃ bhavati | ājyaṃ prokṣaṇamājyena mārjayante tūṣṇīkena | prokṣaṇamārjane | mānavī ṛcau dhāyye kuryāt | makṣū devavata ityetāsāṃ dve| pañca somāraudrīyaṃ somārudreti sarvāsāṃ yājyānuvākye || 7|| yadi bibhīyādduścarmā bhaviṣyāmīti somāpauṣṇaṃ caruṃ nirvapetsomāpūṣaṇā imau devāviti yājyānuvākye || 8 || somāraudre jyogāmayāvinaḥ || 5 || hotā'naḍvāhaṃ dakṣiṇāṃ dadāti | somāraudraṃ caruṃ nirvapedyaḥ kāmayeta sve'smā āyatane bhrātṛvyaṃ janayeyamiti bhrātṛvyakṣetre yajeta | vediṃ parigṛhya dakṣiṇamardhamuddhṛtya tadevārdhena barhiṣastṛṇīyādardhamidhmasyābhyādadhyāt || 9|| aindramekādaśakapālaṃ nirvapenmārutaṃ saptakapālaṃ grāmakāmaḥ || 22.3.10|| āhavanīya aindramadhiśrayati | gārhapatye mārutam || 11 || alaṃkṛtyaindramāsādayati anūcyamānāsu sāmidhenīṣu mārutam || 12 || indraṃ vo viśvatasparīndraṃ naro maruto yaddhavaṃ iti yājyānuvākyāḥ ||13|| etāmeva nirvapedyaḥ kāmayeta kṣattrāya ca viśe ca samadaṃ dadhyāmityaindrasyāvadyanbrūyādindrāyānubrūhītyaindrī puronuvākyā''śrāvya brūyānmaruto yajeti mārutī yājyā mārutasyāvadyanbrūyānmarudbhyo'nubrūhīti mārutī puronuvākyā''śrāvya brūyādindraṃ yajeti aindrī yājyā || 14 || etāmeva nirpedyaḥ kāmayeta kalperanniti yathādevatamavadāya yathādevataṃ yajeta || 15|| ऎndramekādaśakapālaṃ nirpedvaiśvadevaṃ dvādaśakapālaṃ grāmakāma iti || 16|| aindrasya pūrvamavadānamavadāya vaiśvadevasyāvadyedupariṣṭāduttaramaindrasyendrāya viśvebhyo devebhyo'nubrūhīndraṃ viśvāndevānyajati saṃpreṣyati bhareṣvindramiti yājyānuvākye || 17 || upādhāyyapūrvayaṃ vāso dakṣiṇā || 18 || (dviguṇānsaṃjñānyāṃ saṃgacchadhvaṃ samāno mantraḥ samānī vaḥ saṃjñānaṃ naḥ saṃjñānaṃ me iti pañca homāṣṭīkāḥ| atra dhūnutha dyāṃ pravepayanti parvatānityupahomau) ṭīkājī ( dviguṇaṃ jī) tu prayāṇe citrāntamityekeṣāṃ mārutasya priyā vo nāma huve turāṇāmiti || 19|| saṃjñānye samavadāya pracaredagnaye vasumate somāya rudravata indrāya marutvate varuṇāyā''dityavate'nubrūhyagniṃ vasumantaṃ somaṃ rudravantamindraṃ marutvantaṃ varuṇamādityavantaṃ yajeti saṃpreṣyati | āgniḥ prathamo vasubhiriti yājyānuvākye | nānā vā pracaryāḥ samānī yājyānuvākye uttare saṃyājye||6||22.3.20|| ādityebhyo bhuvadvadbhyaścarumiti yajño devānāṃ pratyetīti yājyānuvākye || 21|| avaruddho vā'varudhyamāno vā'bhyathārayadvatīṃ nirupyā''ste yāvadenaṃ nāparundhyurdhāsyanva ādityāsa iti yājyānuvākye || 22 || aparudhyamāno'dite'numanyasveti || 23 || aparoddhuḥ padyādāya gacchati || 24 || yāṃ janatāṃ gacchedyastatra mukhyapravādo bhavati || 25|| tasya gṛhādvrīhīnāharecchuklāṃśca kṛṣṇāṃśca | vicinuyādye śuklāḥ syustamādityaṃ caruṃ nirvapet || 26 || ye kṛṣṇāstānkṛṣṇājina upanahya prajñātānnidhāyopapreta marutaḥ sudānava enā viśpatinā'bhyamuṃ rājānamiti yajamānamabhyeti satyā''śīriti padaikadeśaṃ yajamānasyottare vāsasi nivapatīha mana ityurasi śeṣaṃ tyānnu kṣatriyāniti yājyānuvākye || 27|| yadi nāvagacchedimamahamādityebhyo bhāgaṃ nirvapāmyamuṣmādamuṣyai viśo'vagantorityaparoddhurnāma gṛhṇāti tasyaiva viśaḥ || 28 || yadi nāvagacchedāśvatthānmayūkhāntsapta madhyameṣāyāmupahanyādidamahamādityānbadhnāmīti trīnprācaścatura udīcaḥ || 29 || yadi nāvagacchedetamevā''dityaṃ caruṃ nirvapedidhme'pi mayūkhānsaṃnahyedanavagataḥ || 22.3.30 || kṛṣṇānāṃ vāruṇaṃ caruṃ nirvapati | anavagato vā''dityaṃ nirupya vāruṇaṃ nirvapedimaṃ me varuṇa tattvā yāmīti yājyānuvākye | tvaṃ no agna iti saṃyājye || 31 || . iti satyāṣāḍhahiraṇyakeśisūtre dvāviṃśapraśne tṛtīyaḥ paṭalaḥ | 22.4 atha dvāviṃśapraśne caturthaḥ paṭalaḥ | prājāpatyāṃ śatakṛṣṇalāṃ nirvapedāyuṣkāmaḥ||1|| śataṃ hiraṇyakṛṣṇalāni kākiṇyā māṣeṇa vā saṃmitāni | auṣadhakalpo yatprāgavahananāttatkṛtvā pavitrāntarhita ājya āvapati| dha(gha)rmamātraṃ śrapaṇam | pracaraṇakāle'ṣṭau devatāyā avadyati | catvāri sviṣṭakṛti | dve prāśitre'ṣṭāviḍāyām | caturdhākaraṇakāle sarvāṇi prāśitre samopyaikadhā brahmaṇa upaharati | tāni brahmā bhakṣayati | bhakṣāya nayatītareṣām || 2|| sauryaṃ caruṃ nirvapedadhastādupariṣṭācca rukmābhyāṃ parigṛhyā''sādayati | tasya prayāje prayāje kṛṣṇalaṃ juhoti | apohya rukmau caruṇā pracarati| udu tyaṃ citramiti yājyānuvākye | etāveva rukmau dakṣiṇā ||3|| āgneyamaṣṭākapālaṃ nirvapediti trihaviḥ sa pratnavaditi yājyānuvākyāḥ || 4|| somendraṃ śyāmākaṃ caruṃ nirvapetsomavāminaḥ somātipavitasyardūdareṇā''pāntamiti yājyānuvākye || 5|| agnaye dātra iti trirhavisteṣāṃ prājāpatyaṃ saṃsṛṣṭahavistṛtīyam | dadhi madhu ghṛtamāpo dhānā iti dadhi madhu ghṛtamāpastaṇḍulā ityeteṣāmājyavikāro madhūdake saṃsṛṣṭe mukhye svādharmyabhūyastvādājyavikāro balīyānagne dā dāśuṣe rayimityāgneyasya| mā no mardhīrā tū bharetyaindrasya | ghṛtaṃ na pūtamubhe iti prājāpatyasya || 6|| jñavibhraṣṭasyā''gneyādīni trīṇyupakramyāśaknuvanyajñavibhraṣṭaḥ| āgneyasya ca saumyasya caindre samāśleṣayediti saṃhitāni havīṃṣyadhiśrayatītyarthaḥ | lepau vā'sminsamāśleṣayet | sapatnavaditi yājyānuvākyāḥ || 7 || dvāvagnīṣomīyau | nānātantrāvagnīṣomā savedaseti yājyānuvākyāḥ || 8|| somāya vājine śyāmākasyā''pyāyasva saṃ ta iti || 9 || brāhmaṇaspatyasya gaṇānāṃ tvā gaṇapatiṃ havāmaha iti || 22.4.10|| tāṃ yaḥ kāmayeta brahmanviśaṃ vināśayeyamiti ||8|| sarvaṃ brāhmaṇaspatyaṃ bhavati | maruto yaddhava iti yājyānuvākye || 11|| aryamṇe caruṃ nirvapetsuvargakāmo'ryamā''yāti ye te iti || 12 || yo rājanya ānujāvaraḥ syāttasmā etamaindramānuṣūkamekāśadaśakapālaṃ nirvapadaindrasyānuṣūkasya budhnādagramiti ||13|| (yo brāhmaṇānujāvaraḥ syāttasmā etaṃ bārhaspatyamānuṣūkaṃ caraṃ nirvapet | ) bārhaspatyasya pra yo jajña iti || 14 || pāpayakṣmagṛhītasyā''dityaścaruramāvāsyāyāṃ aśvo japo yamādityā iti yājyānuvākye || 15 || tridhātuṃ nirvapedindrāya rājña ityekādaśasūttāneṣu kapāleṣvadhiśrayati paritapanāntaṃ kṛtvā tasminnuttaraṃ jyāyāṃsamadhiśrayati | yathāśṛtānalaṃkṛtya sādayati | pracaraṇakāle madhyātprathamāṃ devatāṃ yajati | dakṣiṇārdhāddvitīyāmuttarārdhāttṛtīyāṃ sarveṣāmabhigamayannavadyati | acchaṃbaṭkāraṃ yāvatā hi na prāpnuyāttāvatā ca vaṣaṭ kuryāt | prācyāṃ diśi tvamindrā'(ndo')si rājeti tisra ṛco vyatyāsamanvāha | prathamāmanūcya madhyamayā yajeta | madhyamāmanūcyottamayā yajeta | uttamāmanūcya prathamayā yajeta | evaṃ sarvā anuvākyāḥ sarvā yājyā bhavanti || 16 || sarvapṛṣṭhāṃ nirvapedindrāya rāthaṃtarāyeti dvādaśasūttāneṣu kapāleṣvadhiśrayati | pracaraṇakāle pūrvārdhātprathamāṃ devatāṃ yajati | evamitarāḥ pradakṣiṇaṃ samantaṃ paryavadyatīti vijñāyate | abhi tvā śūra nonuma iti ṣaḍṛco vyatyāsamanvāha vijñāyate ca na bṛhatyā vaṣaṭ kuryādyadbṛhatyā vaṣaṭ kuryādantaṃ chandāṃsi gamayedanuvākyāyāścatvāryakṣarāṇi na yājyāyāmadhyūhya yajatyanuṣṭubhaṃ ca vā etatpaṅktiṃ ca saṃpādayanti manyāmahe || 9|| indrāya rāthaṃtarāyānubrūhītyukte abhi tvā śūra nonumo'dugdhā iva dhenavaḥ | īśānamasya jagataḥ suvardṛśamīśānamomityanūcyendra tasthuṣastvāmiddhi havāmahe iti yajatīndrāya bārhatāyānubrūhītyukte tvāmiddhi havāmahe sātā vājasya kāravaḥ | tvāṃ vṛtreṣvindra satpatiṃ narastvāṃ kāṣṭhomityanūcya svarvato'bhi tvā śūra nonuma iti yajati | indrāya vairūpāyānubrūhītyukte yadyāva ityanūcya pibā somāmiti yajati | indrāya vairājāyānubrūhītyukte pibā somamityanūcya yadyāva iti yajati | indrāya śākvarāyā nubrūhītyukte revatīrna ityanūcya proṣvasmai purorathamiti yajati | indrāya raivatāyānubrūhītyukte proṣvasmai purorathamiti( tyanūcya ) revatīrna iti yajati | aśvarṣabho vṛṣṇivastaḥ sā dakṣiṇā|| 17|| vṛṣatvāyaitayaiva yajetābhiśasyamānaḥ|| 18|| cakṣuṣkāmasyā''gneyādīni trīṇyudagne śucayastava vi jyotiṣodu tyaṃ citramiti yājyānuvākyā: | samānī āgneyābhyāṃ caturdhākaraṇakāle sauryāntrīnpiṇḍānkṛtvodu tyaṃ jātavedasaṃ sapta tvā harito rathe citraṃ devānāmiti pratimantraṃ piṇḍānyajamānāya prayacchati | tānyajamānaḥ prāśnāti || 19|| vaiśvadevīṃ sāṃgrahaṇīṃ nirvapedgrāmakāma iti | pṛṣatyāḥ pṛṣadvatsāyai dugdhe vatsāyai caruṃ ghṛta ityekeṣām | dhruvo'si dhruvo'haṃ sajāteṣu bhūyāsamiti paridhīnparidadhāti | viśve devā viśve devā iti yājyānuvākye | āmanamasyāmanasya devā ityāmane tisa āhutīrjuhoti | aprakṛtānāmanirdiṣṭakālānāṃ karmaṇāṃ pradhānānantaryamityātreyaḥ | antamāgantūnīti bādarāyaṇaḥ || 10 || 22.4.20 || 4 || iti satyāṣāḍhahiraṇyakaśisūtre dvāviṃśapraśne caturthaḥ paṭalaḥ | 22.5 atha dvāviṃśapraśne pañcamaḥ paṭalaḥ | yo jyogāmayāvī syādyo vā kāmayeta sarvamāyuriti | tasmā etāmiṣṭiṃ nirvapet | āgneyādīni pañca pātrasaṃsādanakāle khādiraṃ catuḥsraktipātraṃ prayunakti | sauvarṇaṃ ca pravṛttaṃ śatamānasya kṛtam | atho khalu yāvatīḥ samā eṣyanmanyeta tāvanmānaṃ syāditi vijñāyate || 1|| yannavamaittannavanītamabhavadityājyamavekṣyā''jyagrahaṇakāle tūṣṇīmāditaḥ khādire caturgṛhītaṃ gṛhītvā'thetarāsu gṛhṇāti | sādanakāla uttareṇa dhruvāṃ sādayati | tasminpravṛttamavadadhāti | āyuṣṭa āyurdā agna āpyāyasva saṃ te'va te heḍa uduttamaṃ pra ṇo devyā no divo'gnāviṣṇū agnāviṣṇū iti yājyānuvākyāḥ||2|| aśvinoḥ prāṇo'sīti catura upahomāñjuhoti ||3|| yatkhādira ājyaṃ tadagreṇā''havanīyaṃ paryāhṛtya dakṣiṇenā''havanīyamantarvedi nidadhāti || 4 || tadyajamāno'vekṣate ghṛtasya dhārāmamṛtasya panthāmiti ||5|| athāsya brahmā dakṣiṇaṃ hastaṃ gṛhṇāti | brahmaṇa itara ṛtvijo hastamanvārabhya yajamānaṃ paryāhuḥ pāvamānena tvā stomeneti || 6|| athaitadyajamāno hiraṇyādghṛtaṃ niṣpibatīmamagna āyuṣe varcase kṛdhīti niṣpibantamabhimantrayate || 7|| uddhṛtya pravṛttaṃ prakṣālya dakṣiṇe karṇe yajamānaḥ pradakṣiṇamābadhnāti | āyurasi viśvāyurasīti || 8|| athāsyādhvaryurdakṣiṇaṃ hastaṃ sāṅguṣṭhaṃ gṛhṇātyagnirāyuṣmāniti ṣaḍbhiḥ paryāyaiḥ || 9|| sviṣṭakṛtprabhṛti || 11|| siddhaṃ saṃtiṣṭhate || 22.5.10 || ṛtvijo'śvapratigrahe vāruṇī| yāvato'śvānpratigṛhṇīyāttāvato vāruṇāṃścatuṣkapālānnirvapedekamatiriktamimaṃ me varuṇa tattvā yāmīti yājyānuvākye || 11 || yadyaparaṃ pratigrāhī syātsauryamekakapālaṃ nirvapet | udu tyaṃ citramiti yājyānuvākye || 12 || apo'vabhṛthamavaiti sāmavarjamanūyājāntam | imaṃ me varuṇa tattvā yāmīti yājyānuvākye || 13 || aponaptrīyaṃ caruṃ punaretya nirvapedapāṃnapātsamanyā yantīti yājyānuvākye || 14 || pāpmagṛhītasyaindrāvaruṇamekakapālaṃ nirvapet || 15 || aindrāvaruṇīṃ payasyāntaṃ payasyāyāmavadhāya pracchādyā''sādayati ||16|| athāsmātpayasyāṃ pratidiśaṃ vyūhati yā vāmindrāvaruṇā yatavyā tanūrityetaireva punaḥ samūhatyamuktamiti mantrāntsaṃnamati ||17 || indrāvaruṇā yuvamadhvarāya, ā no mitrāvaruṇā pra bāhavā iti yājyānuvākye || 18 || yo vāmindrāvaruṇāviti payasyāyā upahomāḥ ||19|| agnaye pravata iti trihaviḥ praprāyamagniriti yājyānuvākyāḥ || 22.5.20 indrāyāṃhomuca iti trīṇyaṃhomuce viveṣa yanmā vi na indrendra kṣattramindriyāṇi śatakrato'nu te dāyīti yājyānuvākyāḥ || 21|| agnaye saṃvargāya puroḍāśamaṣṭākapālaṃ nirvapet | taṃ śṛtamāsannametena yajuṣā'bhimṛśedojo'si saho'sīti | yukṣvā hi devahūtamāniti pañcadaśa sāmidhenīranvāha nityayā paridadhāti | kuvitsu na iti yājyānuvākye | uttare saṃyājye || 22 || prājāpatyo gārmutaścaruḥ prajākāmasya prajāpate, sa veda putra iti yājyānuvākye || 23 || somāpūṣaṇeti somāpauṣṇasya || 24 || citrāpūrṇamāse nirvapetpaśukāmasyā''gneyādīni saptāgninā rayimaśnavaditi yājyānuvākyāḥ | agne gobhirna āgahītyupahomāḥ || 25|| puṣkaleṣu nakṣatreṣūdavasāya || 12 || 26 || iti satyāṣāḍhahiraṇyakeśisūtre mahāvīrasaṃmitāvraskau methī trīn mayūkhān ṣaṭ śakalāṃstrayodaśa vaikaṅkatānparidhīn kāṇṭakīṃ ca samidhaṃ vaiṇavāni gharmendhanāni khādirāṇi pālāśānyaudumbarāṇyarkamayāni śamīmayāni vā ||5|| ( kṛṣṇājinaṃ ) trīṇi kārṣṇājināni dhavitrāṇi śuklakṛṣṇalomāni teṣāṃ vaiṇavā bāhumātrā daṇḍā bhavantyaudumbarā vā rajatasuvarṇau rukmau pṛthakśatamānau mauñjāni vyākhyāsyāmo dvau vedau tayoranyataraḥ 3)|| brahmanpravargyeṇa pracariṣyāmo hotargharmamabhiṣṭuhyagnīdrauhiṇau puroḍāśāvādhiśraya pratiprasthātarvihara prastotaḥ sāmāni gāyeti saṃpreṣyati || 7|| brahmāyajuryuktaṃ sāmabhirākta khaṃ mahāvīraṃ deva puraścara saṃghyāsaṃ tvetyaparivāsitena vedena saṃmārṣṭi prāṇāya svāhā vyānāya svāheti sruveṇā''havanīye sapta prāṇāhutīrjuhotyekādaśa vottamasya śeṣeṇa devastvā savitā madhvā'naktviti mahāvīramanakti taṃ nidhāyānyasmai vā pradāya pṛthivīṃ tapasastrāyasvetyaparasminkhare rājataṃ rukmaṃ nidhāya dvayānmuñjapralavānādāyārcirasīti dakṣiṇeṣāmagrāṇi gārhapatya ādīpayati śocirasīti teṣāmagrairuttareṣāṃ mūlāni jyotirasīti teṣāṃ mūlairdakṣiṇeṣāṃ mūlāni tapo'sīti teṣāṃ mūlairuttareṣāmagrāṇi tānvyatyastānuparirukme nidhāya ||1|| saṃsīdasveti teṣu mahāvīraṃ sādayatyañjantītyājyenānaktyabhimantrayate vā'nādhṛṣyā purastādityetaiḥ pratimantraṃ pratidiśamasaṃspṛśanyajamāno mahāvīraṃ prāñcaṃ prādeśaṃ dhārayati manoraśvāsi bhūriputretyuttarataḥ vaikaṅkataiḥ paridhibhiḥ paridhatto mā asīti prāñcāvadhvaryurnidadhāti | pramā asītyudañcau pratiprasthātā | evameva pūrveṇādhvaryuruttareṇa pratiprasthātā| antarikṣasyāntardhirasītyadhvaryureva grasitāmamuñcatāmityucyamāne daśa prācīrdaśa bhāsi dakṣiṇetyetamanuvākaṃ yajamānaṃ vācayatyapnasvatīmaśvinā vācamasme ityucyamāne rucito gharma ityupottiṣṭhannāha yathetaṃ triranabhidhūnvantaḥ pratipariyanti ||6|| tasminkāle pratiprasthātā pratyetya pavitrāṇyādāyāgreṇā''havanīyaṃ paryāhṛtya samrāḍāsandyāṃ nidadhāti svāhā tvā sūryasya raśmibhya iti prātaḥ svāhā tvā nakṣatrebhya iti sāyaṃ paṭalaḥ | 24.4 atha caturthaḥ paṭalaḥ | agnīdrauhiṇau puroḍāśāvāsādayeti saṃpreṣyatyaniṣṭabdhayorāgnīdhra upastīrṇā(ryā)bhighārayati tau rohiṇau puroḍāśāvāsādayati dakṣiṇaṃ uṣṇīṣamasītyadhvaryurgharmadughamabhidadhāti vāyurasyaiḍa iti vatsaṃ pūṣā tvopāvasṛjatviti vatsamupasṛjati yaste stanaḥ śaśaya ityadhvaryurgharmadughamabhimantrayata usra gharmaṃ śiṃṣeti vatsaṃ nidāya pibennāsya rāma ucchiṣṭaṃ pibet || 7 || agniṣṭome pravṛṇakti nokthye pravṛñjyādviśvajiti sarvapṛṣṭhe pravṛṇakti na prathamayajñe pravṛñjyātpravṛñjyādvā durbrāhmaṇasya pravṛjyādbrahmavarcasakāmasya yo'nūcānaḥ | śrotriyastasya kāmaṃ pravṛñjyāt || 8 || (khaṃ0 10)|| iti caturviṃśapraśne pañcamaḥ paṭalaḥ | 24.6 adha ṣaṣṭhaḥ paṭalaḥ | pravargyamudvāsayiṣyannajāmagnīdhe dadāti paṣṭhauhīṃ brahmaṇe dhenuṃ hotre rukmāvadhvaryave || 1 || samopyāparaṃ kharaṃ pūrvasminnupanyūhati methīṃ mayūkhānviśākhadāmāni cā''dāyāpareṇā''havanīyaṃ paryāhṛtya samrāḍāsandyāṃ nidadhāti samrāḍāsandīmagreṇā''havanīyaṃ nidhāyaudumbaryāṃ sruci caturgṛhītaṃ gṛhītvā gharma yā te divi śugityāsyadaghne juhoti gharma yā te'ntarikṣe śugiti nābhidadhne gharma yā te pṛthivyāṃ śugiti jānudaghne || 2 || etasminkāle pratiprasthātā'hatena vāsasā pariśrite patnīmudānayatyanuno'dyānumatiranvidanumata ityupaniṣkrāmantyanuharanti kharau dakṣiṇata ucchiṣṭakharamagreṇa prāgvam̐śaṃ samrāḍāsandīṃ pratiṣṭhāpya prastotaḥ sāma gāyeti saṃpreṣyati saha panyā triḥ sarvasāmno nidhanamupayanti madhyadeśe dvitīyaṃ prāpya tṛtīyaṃ sarvatra saṃpreṣyati || 3 || apareṇottaravediṃ nidhāya prastotarvārṣāhāraṃ sāma gāyeṣṭāhotrīyaṃ sāma gāyeti saṃpreṣyatīṣṭāhotrīyasya sarve sāmno nidhanamupayanti na vārṣāhārasya || 4 || yadyupariṣṭātpariṣiñcedatra vārṣāhāraṃ codayet ||5|| udakumbhamādāya valgurasi śaṃyudhāyā iti triḥ pradakṣiṇamuttaravediṃ pariṣiñcanparyeti || 6|| catuḥsraktirnābhirṛtasyetyuttaravedyāṃ kharāvupanivapatyapa dveṣo apa hvara iti mārjālīyadeśa ucchiṣṭakharaṃ pāṇī prakṣālyottaravedyāṃ hiraṇyaṃ nidhāya deva puraścara saghyāsaṃ tveti tasminpracaraṇīyaṃ mahāvīramupāvaharatyevamitarau dakṣiṇottarau vā tūṣṇīmitarāṇyādityasyaiva rūpaṃ karoti || 7 || mahīnāṃ payo'sīti pracaraṇīya ājyamānayati vanaspatīnāmoṣadhīnāṃ rasa iti madhu vājinaṃ tvā vājino'vanayāma iti dadhyevamitarayoḥ || 8 || api vā''jyena prathame madhu dvitīye dadhi tṛtīye ||9|| gharmaitatte'nnametatpurīṣamiti dadhnā madhumiśreṇa yāni pātrāṇyāsecanavanti tāni saṃpūrayatyabhyukṣatītarāṇyariktatāyā iti vijñāyate || 24.6.10||(kha011)|| atha yadi puruṣākṛtiṃ cikīrṣetsamānameteṣāmupāvaharaṇaṃ tacchiro bhavati tasminnenamacchinnāgraṃ prāñcaṃ nidadhāti śikhāyai rūpam || 11 || abhito dogdhre karṇayoḥ prokṣaṇīdhānīṃ mukhasya nāsikayoḥ srucāvakṣṇorhiraṇyaśakalāvājyasruvāvājyasthālīṃ grīvāṇāṃ dhṛṣṭī jatṛ(trū )ṇāmabhitaḥ śaphāvam̐sayorabhito rauhiṇavaṇyau bāhvormethīṃ pṛṣṭhīnāmabhito dhavitre pārśvayormadhye tṛtīyamuraso'bhrim̐ śroṇyorabhito mayūkhau sakthyormadhye tṛtīyaṃ meḍhrasya rauhiṇakapāle pāṣṇyormadhya upayamanamudarasya tasminsarvaṃ rajjumayamavadadhātpātrā(tyāntrā)ṇāṃ rauhiṇapiṣṭalepena pradhvam̐sayati majjāṃ vedaṃ visrasyānuprakirati snāyūnāmavakābhidhūpatṛṇairiti pracchādayati māṃsasya dadhnā madhumiśreṇāvokṣati lohitasya kṛṣṇājinena prācīnagrīveṇottaralomnā prorṇoti tvaco lomnā samrāḍāsandīṃ visrasyopariṣṭānnidadhāti samrājyarūpaṃ karoti || 12|| 13 || yadyabhicaredidamahamamuṣyā''muṣyāyaṇasya śucā prāṇamapi dahāmīti yaṃ dviṣyādyatra sa syāttasyāṃ diśyudumbaraśākhāyāmudvāsayet || 14 || yatra darbhā upadīkasaṃtatāḥ syustadudvāsayedvṛṣṭikāmasyottaravedyāṃ nityakalpaṃ bruvate nainamudvāsitaṃ vayāṃsi paryāsīrannā'gnipraṇayanāt || 15 || athainamupatiṣṭhante rantirnāmāsi divyo gandharva ityacikradadvṛṣā haririti yajamānaḥ sumitrā na iti mārjayitvodvayaṃ tamasamparītyādityamupasthāyānavekṣamāṇāḥ pratyetyodu tyaṃ citramiti dvābhyāṃ gārhapatya āhutīrhutvemamū ṣu tyamasmabhyamityāhavanīyamupatiṣṭhante gārhapatyaṃ vā ||16|| (kha012)|| iti satyāṣāḍhahiraṇyakeśipravargyasūtre caturviṃśapraśne ṣaṣṭhaḥ paṭalaḥ || 24.7 atha saptamaḥ paṭalaḥ | yadi gharmaḥ skandedaskāndyauḥ pṛthivīmityāhutī juhuyāt || 1|| yadi gharmeṇa caratsu purastādvidyudāpatedyā purastādvi dyudāpatadityāhutiṃ juhotyevamitarāsu dikṣu yathāliṅgam ||2|| prāṇāya svāhā pūṣṇe svāhetyanuvākābhyāmanājñāta prāyaścitte gharme caturdaśā''hutīrjuhotyaṣṭādaśetyekeṣām ||3|| udasya śuṣmāditi gharmeṣṭakāmupadadhāti yāste agna ārdrāyonaya iti kulāyinīmagnirasi vaiśvānaro'sītyaiḍakī citiḥ||4|| yadi gharmeṇa caratsu mahāvīraḥ padyeta bhūrbhuvaḥ suvarityenamabhimantryordhva ū ṣu ṇa ūtaya iti dvābhyāmutthāpayedyadi bhidyeta vidhuṃ dadrāṇamiti saṃdadhyādyadṛte cidabhiśriṣa ityāśleṣayedyadanyanmāṃsānmāṣebhyaśca || 5|| yadi gharmamatiparīyurna vā pratiparīyuḥ punarūrjā saha rayyeti dvābhyāṃ pratiparīyuḥ || 6|| mā no gharma vyathito vivyatho na iti gharme vyathite'ṣṭāvāhutīrjuhoti || 7 || api vā gharmameva vyathitametāsāṃ catasṛbhirupatiṣṭhate ||8|| yadi gharmeṇa caratsvādityo'stamiyādudvayaṃ tamasasparītyaparasyāṃ dvāri darbheṇa hiraṇyaṃ prabadhyodu tyaṃ citramiti dvābhyāmupasthāya pracarecchvobhūte vayaḥ suparṇā ityudyantamādityamupatiṣṭhate ||9|| yadi gharmadhugdohakāle nā''gacchedanyāṃ duhīta || 24.7.10|| yadi na duhīta dṛtiṃ stanaṃ kṛtvā pinvayet ||11|| yadi dadhi syādbārhaspatyaṃ śaṃset || 12 || yadi paya pravṛñjanairvikalperanbhūrbhuvaḥ suvarityanuvākena || (kha013) dadhidharmaṃ bhakṣayanti || 21 || yāste agne ghorāstanuva iti ghorāstanvo yaṃ dviṣyāttametābhiranvīkṣeta dhuniśca śamyāyāṃ ca mānārtheṣu yāthākāmī śabdārthasya viśayitvāt || 43 || yajamānamātrī catuḥsraktirbhavatīti paitṛkyā vedervijñāyate || 44 || tadekarajjvoktaṃ pañcadaśikenaivāpāyāmyārdhena tataḥ śroṇyaṃsānnirharet || 45 || navāratnistiryaksaptaviṃśatirudagāyatamiti sadaso vijñāyate || 46|| aṣṭādaśetyekeṣām | tadekarajjvoktaṃ paścadaśikenaivāpāyamyārdhapañcamaiḥ śroṇyaṃsānnirharet ||47|| adhyātmikānyogānanutiṣṭhennyāyasaṃhitānanaiścārikān || 1|| ātmalābhānna paraṃ vidyate || 2|| tatrā''tmalābhīyān ślokānudāhariṣyāmaḥ ||3|| pū: prāṇinaḥ sarva eva guhāśayasyāhanyamānasya muhyeccintayankavirātmānaṃ caiva sarvatra yaḥ paśyetsa vai brahmā nākapṛṣṭhe virājati || 9 || nipuṇo'ṇīyānvisorṇāyā yaḥ sarvamāvṛtya tiṣṭhati varṣīyāṃśca pṛthivyā dhruvaḥ sarvamārabhya tiṣṭhati sa indriyairjagato'sya jñānādanyo'nanyasya jñeyātparameṣṭhī vibhājastasmātkāyātprabhavanti sarve sa mūlaṃ śāśvatikaḥ sa nityaḥ || 26.6.10|| doṣāṇāṃ tu nirghāto yogamūla iha jīvite nirhṛtya minvanti || 13|| tasya pūrvārdhe madhye paścārdhe vā pālāśīṃ methīṃ nighnanti triviṣūkām || 14 || purastādeva śūdrotpanno brahmabandhurvā saṃvāditopaviśati || 15|| yā strī mukhyatamā tāmāha vasatiṃ mayā saha pṛcchati || 16|| na dadāmītītarā pratyāha || 17 || evaṃ dvitīye karoti || 18 || ekarātrāya dadāmīti tṛtīye || 19|| yāvadrātraṃ vā dhaviṣyantaḥ syuḥ || 29.1.20|| etasyāṃ vāci medhyāmūle śarīrāṇi nidadhāti || 21 || śatātṛṣṇaṃ ca kumbhaṃ triviṣūke || 22|| tasya bilaṃ carmaṇā kuśaiḥ pariṇaddhaṃ bhavati || 23 || tasmindadhi vājinamiśramānayati vaiśvānare haviridaṃ juhomīti || 24 || vikṣarantamabhimantrayate-drapsaścaskandemaṃ samudramiti dvābhyām || 25 || catvāro brahmacāriṇo'nye vā brāhmaṇāḥ prayatā dakṣiṇānkeśapakṣānudgrathya savyānprasrasya dakṣiṇānūrūnāghnānāścarmā''ghnanta: sigbhirabhidhūnvantastriḥ prasavyaṃ pariyantyajinamedhyajiname(dhyajiname)dhīti ||26|| evamamātyāḥ striyaśca ||27|| uttarābhiḥ sigbhirmantravarjaṃ pūrvavatparikramaṇam || 28 || saṃpravadanti vīṇāḥ śaṅkhānnālīkāntū (kāṃstu)ṇāpaṇavānnṛtyagītavāditrāṇīti || 29 || prātarmadhyaṃdine'parāhṇe (ityevaṃ rātrestriraparapakṣasya) tisro rātrīḥ [ dhuvanti ] || 29.1.30 || pañca sapta navaikādaśa vā'rdhamāsaṃ māsaṃ vatsaramu haike dhuvantyannaṃ ca yathāśakti deyaṃ tathā dravyāṇi || 31 || uttame'hani dravyatyāga ityeke || 32|| etasminnevāgnau tṛṣṇīmupacaritānpañca carūṃ śrapayanti || 33 || teṣāmabhighāraṇāni ghṛtaṃ śritaṃ kṣīraṃ dadhi madhvityapūpābhirdhānā bhavanti || 34 || apararātre gacchantyagniḥ prathamo'rdho(tho)dakumbho'naḍvāñcharīrāṇi saṃbhārā iti yena cānyenārthī bhavati || 35|| na hīnamanvāhareyurantarā grāmaṃ śmaśānaṃ caitamagnimindhāna āste || 36 || (kha02)| vyuṣṭāyāṃ hariṇyā palāśaśākhayā śamīśākhayā vā śmaśānāyatanaṃ saṃmāryṭbhapeta vīteti || 37 || dakṣiṇata: śākhāmudasitvā'pa upaspṛśyoddhatyāvokṣya savitaitāni śarīrāṇīti sīraṃ yunakti ṣaḍgavaṃ dvādaśagavaṃ caturviṃśatigavaṃ vā || 38|| yāvadgavaṃ sīraṃ tāvanti śatānīṣṭakānāṃ mānā(ni) bhavantīti vijñāyate || 39|| tasyāścaturviṃśena bhāgeneṣṭakāḥ karoti pādeṣṭakāśca || 40|| vāraṇaṃ kāṣṭhamayam || 41 || mauñjaṃ rajjumayam || 42 || vacanādanyat || 43|| śunaṃ vāhā iti dvābhyāṃ prasavyāvṛttāḥ ṣaṭ parācī: sītāḥ kṛṣati || 44 || udyamya lāṅgalaṃ sīte vandāmaha iti sītāḥ pratyavekṣate || 45 || savitaitāni śarīrāṇīti madhye kṛṣṭasyāsthikumbhaṃ nidadhāti || 46 || vimucyadhvamaghniyā devayānā iti dakṣiṇeṃ'se balīvardānvimucya tāndakṣiṇenotsṛjyādhvaryave dadāti || 47 || udapātreṇodumbaraśākhayā'vokṣati pra vātā vā-ntīti || 48|| pātryāṃ sarvoṣadhīḥ saṃyutya vapati yathā yamāyeti ||49|| citaḥ stha paricita ityaparimitābhiḥ śarkarābhiḥ pariśrityā''pyāyasva sametu ta iti sikatā vyūhati ||29.1.50|| uttarayā triṣṭubhā rājanyasya ||51|| jagatyā vaiśyasya ||52|| vidhṛtiloṣṭānpratidiśamanvīkṣamāṇa upadadhātyutte tanomītyetaiḥ pratimantraṃ tilamiśrābhirdhānābhistriḥ pradakṣiṇaṃ parikiratyeṇīrdhānā iti || 53|| abhivānyāyai dugdhasyārdhaśarāve saktūṃstriḥ prasavyamanārabhyopamathitamāmapātrasthaṃ dakṣiṇata upadadhātyeṣā te yamasādana iti || 54|| samūlaṃ barhirdakṣiṇāgraṃ stṛṇātīdaṃ pitṛbhyaḥ prabharemeti || 55 || pālāśānparidhīnparidadhāti mā tvā vṛkṣāviti pūrvāparāvuttarayā dakṣiṇottarau ||56|| madhye naleṣi( ṣī )ko nidadhāti nalaṃ plavamiti || 57 || purāṇena sarpiṣā śarīrāṇi susaṃtṛptāni saṃtṛpyotarata āsīno'nanvīkṣamāṇo darbheṣvasthīni nivapati savitaitāni śarīrāṇīti || 58 || yathā'ṅgamaṅgāni saṃnidhāyāthainamupatiṣṭhate ṣaḍḍhotā sūryaṃ te cakṣuriti || 59|| bhuktabhogena vāsasā'sthikumbhaṃ nimṛjyoparyupari śiro dakṣiṇā vyudasyati paraṃ mṛtyo anu parehi panthāmiti || 29.1.60|| athāsya kapālāni susaṃbhinnāni saṃbhinatti yathaiṣūdakaṃ na tiṣṭhet || 61 || bhuktabhogena vāsasā śarīrāṇi pracchādyodapātreṇodumbaraśākhayā'vokṣati śaṃ vāta iti ||62|| (kha03) | iṣṭakā: pratidiśama( na )nvīkṣamāṇā upadadhāti pṛthivyāstvā loke sādayāmītyetaiḥ pratimantraṃ madhye pañcamīṃ tāṃ dakṣiṇena ṣaṣṭhīm || 63 || evaṃ carūnapūpavānghṛtavāniti pratimantram ||64|| atilābhirdhānābhistriḥ prasavyaṃ parikiratyetāste svadhā amṛtāḥ karomīti || 65|| oṣadhīstambānpratidiśamananvīkṣamāṇā(ṇa) upadadhāti tvāmarjuneti pratimantram || 66 || teṣāṃ mantraliṅgairdravyaniyamaḥ || 67 || lokaṃ pṛṇeti lokaṃpṛṇā upadadhāti || 68 || uttarayā purīṣeṇānu[vi]kirati || 69|| śmaśānasya mātrā dvyaṅgulaṃ tryaṅgulaṃ caturaṅgulaṃ prādeśo vitastirjānudaghnamūrudaghnaṃ [sphigdaghnaṃ] vaiṣottamā mātrā śmaśānasya || 29.1.70 || uttamāṃ mātrāṃ mā(nādhyā)pnuyāt || 71 || yāvatpu( tīṃ pu)rastāttato'nantarāṃ paścāt || 72 || api vā dvyaṅgulaṃ purastātsamaṃ paścādityeke || 73 || udapātreṇodumbaraśākhayā vā'vokṣati śaṃ vāta iti || 74|| .ārohaṇaṃ japati || 75 || upasthānenopatiṣṭhata idameveti || 76 || vāraṇaśākhāṃ purastānnidadhāti varaṇa iti || 77|| vidhṛtiloṣṭamuttarato vidhṛtirasīti || 78 || śamīśākhāṃ paścācchami śamayeti yavaṃ dakṣiṇato yaveti || 79 || athainamupatiṣṭhate pṛthivīṃ gacchāntarivakṣaṃ gaccheti || 29.1.80 || jaghanenaṃ citaṃ karṣvādi proktaṃ pravakṣye vidhimuttamam | māsi māsi tu kartavyo hyantakāya balistathā || medhākāmo'rthakāmo vā putrakāmastu vai dvijaḥ | yāmye'hani sanakṣatre sarvānkāmānsamaśnute || saṃvatsarasya kārtikyāṃ baliṃ kurvīta yatnataḥ | akurvanyastu kārtikyāṃ narake tu nimajjati || tasmātkurvīta kārtikyāṃ sarvakāmastu vai dvijaḥ| tilaprasthasya kartavyaṃ guḍamiśraṃ tathā haviḥ | ekena na tu kartavyaḥ kartavyo bahubhiḥ saha ||1|| havirudvāsyābhimantrya havirādāya namo brahmaṇe prajāpataye devebhyaḥ( ṛṣibhyaḥ ) pitṛbhyo yamāyetyuktvā grāmātprācīmudīcīṃ vā diśamupaniṣkramyāniriṇavaddeśe nadītīre same vā'nyasmiñchucau deśe tasya (tasmin) diksraktiṃ vediṃ karoti ||2|| tasyāṃ ( uttara ) pañcottaravedyāṃ(yo) diksraktayo bhavanti || 3|| dakṣiṇena karakūpaṃ khātvottareṇāgniṃ pratiṣṭhāpya darbhaiḥ sottaravediṃ saṃpracchādayati || 4 || prāgagrairdarbhairviṣṭaraṃ nidhāya prastaraṃ cā''yātu devaḥ sumanābhirūtibhiryamo ha veha prayatābhiraktā | āsīdatāṃ suprayate ha barhiṣyūrjāya jātyai mama śatruhatyomiti yamamāvāhya yame iva yatamāne yadaitaṃ pra vāṃ bharanniti ca || 5|| imaṃ yama prastaramiti tisṛbhiḥ prastaramabhimantrya sapavitrapāṇyarghya(snāna )pādyācamanīyodakāni dattvā sārvasurabhi gandhapuṣpadhūpadīpairnaivedyaṃ ca yathopalabdhaṃ dadāti || 6|| kṛṣṇāḥ pratisarāḥ kṛṣṇasūtraṃ ca madhyamenānta (nti )mena vā palāśaparṇena juhoti yamāya svāhā | antakāya svāhā | dharmāya svāhā | adharmāya svāhā | antāya svāhā | anantāya svāhā | vaivasvatāya svāhā | mṛtyave svāhā | viṣṇave svāhā | bhūḥ svāhā | bhuvaḥ svāhā | suvaḥ svāhā | bhūrbhuvaḥ suvaḥ svāheti vyāhṛtiparyantaṃ havirjuhoti || 7|| (kha01)| athārkaparṇānyaudumbaraparṇāni vā nidhāya madhyamāyāmuttaravedyāṃ yamāya havirnivedayante yamāya somaṃ sunuta yamāya juhutā haviḥ | yamaṃ ha yajño gacchatyagnidūto araṃkṛtomiti || 8|| pratīcyāmuttaravedyāṃ yamāya ghṛtavaddhavirjuhota pra ca tiṣṭhata | sa no deveṣvā yamaddīrghamāyuḥ prajīvasomiti | prācyāmuttaravedyāṃ yamāya madhumattamaṃ rājñe havyaṃ juhotana idaṃ nama ṛṣibhyaḥ pūrvajebhyaḥ (pūrvebhyaḥ ) pathikṛdbhyomiti | dakṣiṇasyāmuttaravedyāṃ śvabhyāṃṃ havirnivedayante yau te śvānau yamarakṣitārau caturakṣau pathirakṣī nṛcakṣasā tābhyāmenaṃ paridehi rājan svasti cāsmā anamīvaṃ ca dhehyomiti | uttarasyāmuttaravedyāṃ yamadūtābhyāṃ havirnivedayanta uruṇasāvasu tṛpāvulañbalau yamasya dūtau carato janāṃ anu | tāvasmabhyaṃ dṛśaye sūryāya punardattā masumadyeha bhadromiti ||9|| yo'sya kauṣṭhyeti tisṛbhiryamagāthābhistriḥ pradakṣiṇaṃ parigāyanti || 29.2.10 || dakṣiṇena karakūpaṃ gatvā prācīnāvītaṃ kṛtvā savyaṃ jānvācya havirādāya iṣamiṣaṃ svadhā vaivasvato'bravīt || 22 || yamo yaṣṭāramitaḥ prayātamaṅke samādhāya piteva putram | suhṛdgatiṃ gamayati tatra lokānnivartate [na] cāsya chinatti panthānaṃ nivartate [na] cāsya cchinatti panthānamiti || 23 || iti satyāṣāḍhahiraṇyakeśiśrautasūtra (pitṛmedhāparaparyāye) ekonatriṃśapraśne dvitīyaḥ paṭalaḥ || 2 || 29.3 atha tṛtīyaḥ paṭalaḥ | athāta uttarapaitṛmedhikaṃ vyākhyāsyāmaḥ || 1 || yaṃ || hṛdayairhiraṇyaśakalān || 8|| saṃbhārayajurbhiḥ pātracayanam || 9|| jyotiṣmatībhirupoṣaṇam ||29.3.10|| nārāyaṇābhyāmupasthānam || 11 || brāhmaṇa ekahoteti cānumantraṇam || 12|| cittaṃ saṃtāneneti || 23 || (kha0 1)|| iti satyāṣāḍhahiraṇyakeśiśrautasūtre( pitṛmedhāparaparyāye ) ekonatriṃśapraśne tṛtīyaḥ paṭalaḥ || 3|| 29.4 atha caturthaḥ paṭalaḥ| athājasrāṇāṃ dvyahaṃ tryahaṃ ṣaḍahaṃ dvādaśāhaṃ vā dhārayedyāvadvā maraṇasaṃśayaṃ manyeta ||1|| asaṃśaye'jasraṃ viramyāgnaya āyuṣmate puroḍāśamaṣṭākapālaṃ nirvapecchatakṛṣṇalāṃ pañcahaviṣāṃ(ṣaṃ) vā yo jyogāmayāvītyuktam || 2|| | purastādāyuṣmatyā prāgiṣṭagamanādvihāraṃ sādhayet ) | prete'pi viharaṇameke samāmananti || 4|| ( tadanardhukaṃ prayājā iti vijñāyate | udagayane pramītāḥ sauryeṇa pathā devalokaṃ yānti dakṣiṇāyane saumyena pitṛlokamiti vijñāyate ) | udagayanāpūryamāṇapakṣe divā kratvante śreyo maraṇamityupadiśanti || 5|| yadi pūrvapakṣarātrau maraṇaṃ śaṅketa sāyamāhutiṃ hutvā tadaiva prātarāhutiṃ juhuyāt || 6 || yadyaparapakṣe sarvāsvāpatsu ) || 9 || yadīṣṭimadhye'vaśiṣṭeṣṭipradhānadevatābhyaścaturgṛhītenā''jyenaikakasyai devatāyai puronuvākyāmanūcya yājyayā juhuyāt || 29.4.10 || (kha0 1)| [atha ] yadi cāturmāsyamadhye yajñalopo ha bhavatīti vijñāyate || 13 || uktaṃ dīkṣitapramītaprāyaścittam || 14 || jāyāvarā ha vai nāma purā ṛṣaya āsaṃste'dhvanyaśrāmyante'rdhamāsāyārdhamāsāyāgnihotraṃ [na] juhuvustasmādyāyāvaradharmeṇā''mayāvyārto vā jananamaraṇayoradhvanyāpatsu vā'rdhamāsāyārdhamāsāyāgnihotraṃ juhuyāt || 15|| pratipadi sāyaṃ caturdaśa caturgṛhītānyunnayatyekā samitsakṛddhomaḥ sakṛtpātrāṇi(trani)mārjanaṃ sakṛdupasthānamevaṃ prātaretāvānvikāraḥ | śeṣaṃ prakṛtivat || 16|| pakṣatraye punarādheyam || 17 || agnīnsamāropayate dhārayate vaupavasathyādyaupavasathye'hani tāvatīratikrāmannanvārabheyātāmādyantayorvā yadi nānvārabheyātāṃ laukikāḥ saṃpadyeranvijñāyate ca )|| 19|| yadyāhitāgnirutsṛṣṭāgnirvicchinnāgnirvidhurāgnirvā pramīyeta na tamanyena tretāgnibhyo praviśati ( saha tena ) yamāhitāgnimanyena tretāgnibhyo dahanti || 22 || tasya prācīnāvītyagnyāyata nānyuddhatyāvokṣya yajamānāyatane pretaṃ nidhāya gārhapatyāyata nesraṇī saṃnidhāya manthati ye'syāgnayo juhvato māṃsakāmāḥ saṃkalpayante yajamānamāṃsaṃ jānantu te haviṣe sāditāya svargaṃ lokamimaṃ [pretaṃ ] nayantviti || 23 || tūṣṇīṃ vihṛtya dvādaśagṛhītena srucaṃ pūrayitvā tūṣṇīṃ hutvā prete'mātyā ityetadādi karma pratipadyate || 24 || (kha02)| yadyātmanyaraṇyorvā samārūḍheṣvagniṣu yajamāno mriyeta pūrvavadagnyāyatanāni kalpayitvā yajamānāyatane pretaṃ nidhāya gārhapatyāyatane laukikāgnimupasamādhāya pretasya dakṣiṇaṃ pāṇimabhisaṃgṛhya tatputro bhrātā vā pratyāsannabandhurupāvarohetyupāvarohayati | api vopāvaroha jātaveda imaṃ taṃ svargāya lokāya naya prajānan | āyuḥ prajāṃ rayimasmāsu dhehi pretāhutīścāsya juṣasva svāheti laukikāgnāvupāvarohayati | araṇyorvopāvarohya manthet | yadyaraṇyoḥ samārūḍhasyāgnernirvartamāne pretamanvārambhayitvaitaṃ mantraṃ japedviharaṇādi samānam || 25 || āhitāgniṃ jale pramītaṃ vopaśrutyāgnaye pathikṛte puroḍāśamaṣṭākapālaṃ nirvapetpūrṇāhutiṃ vā kuryātprācīnāvītī juhotītyeke || 26 || etasminneva vihāre paitṛmedhikaṃ karma pratipadyate || 27|| yadyetasminnahani śarīrāṇyāharanti yadyanyasminnahani tasyābhivānyavatsāyāḥ payasā'gnihotramityuktam ||28|| āhitāgniprajane pramītaṃ tailadroṇyāmavadhāya śakaṭenā''haranti nirmanthyena vā dagdhvā kṛṣṇājine'sthīni nidhāyāhatena vāsasā saṃveṣṭya dīrghavaṃśe prabadhyānadhonidadhānāḥ prayatā mṛnmayabhājanā āharanti || 29|| (kha03)| tāni grāmamaryādāyāṃ pratiṣṭhāpyāgnīnpaitṛmedhikabhāṇḍaṃ ca nirharanti nāsati yajamāne grāmamaryādāmagnīnatihareyuryadyatihareyurlaukikāḥ saṃpadyeranniti vijñāyate ca || 29.4.30|| pravasanyajamāno'gnibhyaḥ paridāya gṛhāneti yadi sīmāntare patnyabhinimrocedabhyudiyādvā laukikāḥ saṃpadyeran || 31|| yadyāhitāgniradhvānaṃ gacchetsahāgnitrayeṇa pārśvato'gnihotreṇānuvrajedāhitāgnirantaraṃ na vyaveyādyāvatyo grāmamaryādā nadyaśca tāvatīratikrāmantamanvārabheyātāṃ yadi nānvārabheyātāmagnayo laukikāḥ saṃpadyerantasmādgrāmamaryādāṃ nātiharanti || 32 || śarīrairagnīnsamānīya dahanavadavakāśaṃ joṣayitvā prete'mātyā ityetadādi karma pratipadyate || 33|| tayoryaḥ pūrvo mriyeta ( yajamānaḥ patnī vā) tasyāgnitretāyāṃ pitṛmedhaḥ saṃpadyate | yaḥ paścādaupāsanena || 34|| sahaiva pramīte sahaiva pitṛmedhaḥ || 35 || dārakarmaṇi yadyaśakta ātmārthamagnyādheyaṃ kuryāt | agnihotraṃ darśapūrṇamāsāgrayaṇārthaṃ ca śeṣāṇi karmāṇi na bhavanti || 36|| yadyāhitāgniḥ paśubhyo mriyetā'' gāvo agmanniti dve caturgṛhīte juhuyādyadyāhitāgniraśanihato mriyeta tasya prāyaścittaṃ mūrdhānaṃ divo aratiṃ pṛthivyā iti caturgṛhītaṃ juhuyādyadyāhitāgnirapsu mriyetemaṃ me varuṇa tattvāyāmīti dve caturgṛhīte juhuyāt || 37 || yadyāhitāgnirviṣadaṣṭo mriyeta namo astu sarpebhya iti tisṛbhiścaturgṛhītairjuhuyādyadyāhitānirdaṃṣṭribhyo mriyeta daṃṣṭrābhyāṃ malimlūniti dve caturgṛhītena juhuyādyadyāhitāgniḥ proṣitaḥ pramīto na prajñāyeta yāṃ diśamabhi prasthitaḥ syāttāmasyāgnibhiḥ kakṣaṃ daheyuḥ || 38|| api vā trīṇi ṣaṣṭi[śatāni] palāśavṛntānāṃ taiḥ kṛṣṇājine puruṣākṛtiṃ kṛtvā tāmasyāgnibhirdaheyuriti vijñāyate | palāśavalkaiḥ kuśairvā saṃdhiṣu saṃpraveṣṭya catvāriṃśatā śiraḥ prakalpayate | daśabhirgrīvāṃ viṃśatyorastriṃśatodaraṃ pañcaśatā pañcāśataikaikaṃ bāhuṃ tābhyāmeva pañcabhiḥ pañcabhiraṅgulīrupakalpayate saptatyā saptatyekaikaṃ pādaṃ tābhyāmeva pañcabhiḥ pañcabhiraṅgulīrupakalpayate | aṣṭābhiḥ śiśnaṃ dvādaśabhirvṛṣaṇam | (taiḥ kṛṣṇājine puruṣākṛtiṃ kṛtvā) snāpayitvā'laṃkṛtyāntarvedi kṛṣṇājinaṃ dakṣiṇāgrīvamadharalomā''stīrya tasminnenamuttānaṃ nipātya pattodaśenāhatena vāsasā pracchādya bāndhavāḥ paryupaviśanti (abhimṛśanti) ayamasyāsau yasya ta ime agnaya iti prete'mātyā ityetadādi karma pratipadyate || 39|| yadi tāni na vinderannavānāṃ darbhāṇāṃ yājñikānāṃ vā vṛkṣāṇāṃ taiḥ kṛṣṇājine puruṣākṛtiṃ kṛtvā ( tāmasyāgnibhirdaheyuriti vijñāyate | yadi tāni na vinderanbhūmyāḥ pāṃsūnuddhṛtya) madhunā sarpiṣā saṃsṛjya (taiḥ kṛṣṇājine puruṣākṛtiṃ kṛtvā tāmasyāgnibhirdaheyuriti vijñāyate) vidhinā dāhayet || 29.4.40|| yadyetasminkṛte'gnibhiḥ punarāgacchedghṛtakumbhādunmagnasya jātakarmaprabhṛti dvādaśarātraṃ vrataṃ caritvā tayaiva jāyayā'gnīnādhāya prājāpatyena paśunā vā yajeta ||41|| giriṃ gatvā'gnaye kāmāyeṣṭiṃ nirvapedāyuṣmatīṃ śatakṛṣṇalām | diśāmaveṣṭyā vā yajeta || 42 || ata ūrdhvamīpsitairyajñakratubhiryajeteti vijñāyata iti vijñāyate || 43 || (kha04)|| iti satyāṣāḍhahiraṇyakaśiśrautasūtra (pitṛmedhāparaparyāye) ekonatriṃśapraśne caturthaḥ paṭalaḥ || 4 || atha pariśiṣṭam | atha garbhiṇyāstiṣyakriyā ( yā) ūrdhvaṃ mṛtau tāṃ śmaśānaṃ nītvā dahanavadavakāśaṃ joṣayet ||1|| citāṃ kalpayitvā tasyāścitāyā apareṇa pariśrite karoti ||2|| tāmuttānāṃ kṛtvā tasyā vāmodaramālikhya hiraṇyagarbhaḥ samavartatāgra ityālokanaṃ ca kṛtvā kumāraṃ dṛṣṭvā tamabhimantrayate-jīvatu mama putro dīrghāyutvāya varcasa iti || 3 || atha bālaṃ snāpayeddhiraṇyamantardhāya jīvato grāmamāyāti || 4 || yaste stanaḥ śaśaya iti stanaṃ pradāya tasminnudara ājyāhutīrjuhoti-śatāyudhāya śatavīryāyeti pañca prāṇāya svāhā vyānāya svāhetyetāmyāmanuvākābhyāṃ juhoti || 5 || avraṇaṃ ca kuryātpretaṃ citāmāropya vidhinā dahet || 6 || ekonatriṃśapraśnaśca samāptaḥ||
